ThoughtDef::SoldMyLovedOne.label: loved one sold
ThoughtDef::SoldMyLovedOne.description: Someone I love got sold off to a trader like a crate of parts. I won't forgive whoever signed that deal.

ThoughtDef::SoldPrisoner.label: sold a captive into slavery
ThoughtDef::SoldPrisoner.description: I handed a prisoner over to be sold like salvage, not a person. The credits don't sit easy in my pocket.

ThoughtDef::TeetotalerVsAddict.label: teetotaler vs addict
ThoughtDef::TeetotalerVsAddict.description: I don't touch the stuff, and I can't stand watching someone else burn their life on it right in front of me.

ThoughtDef::ToxicFallout.label: toxic fallout
ThoughtDef::ToxicFallout.description: Sickly yellow ash sifts down like poisoned snow, sticking to everything it touches. My throat and skin burn wherever it lands.

ThoughtDef::TravelAnticipation.label: eager for the road
ThoughtDef::TravelAnticipation.description: I've been checking the sandcrawler's rigging and counting water rations for days. I'm ready to see what's past the dunes.

ThoughtDef::UndergrounderIndoors.label: likes walls overhead
ThoughtDef::UndergrounderIndoors.description: I like having a roof and walls between me and the open sand. Solid ground under my boots, not shifting dune.

ThoughtDef::UndergrounderUnderground.label: loves it underground
ThoughtDef::UndergrounderUnderground.description: Deep in the rock, away from the twin suns and the wind — this is where I do my best work.

ThoughtDef::WantToSleepWithSpouseOrLover.label: sleeping alone
ThoughtDef::WantToSleepWithSpouseOrLover.description: I should be curled up next to my spouse or lover tonight, not staring at an empty bunk.

ThoughtDef::WasImprisoned.label: was imprisoned
ThoughtDef::WasImprisoned.description: The clan locked me up for a stretch, like I was some beast to be caged. I haven't forgotten the feel of those bars.

ThoughtDef::WitnessedDeathAlly.label: watched an ally die
ThoughtDef::WitnessedDeathAlly.description: I watched one of my own go still. Breathing one moment, gone the next — I can still see it.

ThoughtDef::WitnessedDeathBloodlust.label: watched a killing, loved it
ThoughtDef::WitnessedDeathBloodlust.description: I watched someone die right in front of me. Sand and blood — my heart's still pounding from it.

ThoughtDef::WitnessedDeathFamily.label: watched kin die
ThoughtDef::WitnessedDeathFamily.description: I watched my own blood die in front of me. Nothing in this galaxy prepares you for that.

ThoughtDef::WitnessedDeathNonAlly.label: watched a stranger die
ThoughtDef::WitnessedDeathNonAlly.description: I watched someone die who wasn't one of mine. Alive one breath, gone the next — it still sits heavy.

ThoughtDef::VBE_AmbrandyAsIngredient.label: drank ambrandy cocktail
ThoughtDef::VBE_AmbrandyAsIngredient.description: That ambrandy mix went down smooth as polished chrome. Worth every credit.

ThoughtDef::VBE_CaffeineWithdrawal.label: caffeine withdrawal
ThoughtDef::VBE_CaffeineWithdrawal.description: My hands won't stop shaking and my skull's pounding like a busted vaporator pump. I need caf, now.

ThoughtDef::VBE_ConsumedGoStock.label: downed go-stock
ThoughtDef::VBE_ConsumedGoStock.description: That go-stock lit a fire under me. Tasted rough, worked exactly like it should.

ThoughtDef::VBE_ConsumedLuciferiumPowder.label: took luciferium powder
ThoughtDef::VBE_ConsumedLuciferiumPowder.description: That powder hit like a supercharge to every system I've got. I feel unstoppable.

ThoughtDef::VBE_ConsumedWakeupPowder.label: snorted wake-up powder
ThoughtDef::VBE_ConsumedWakeupPowder.description: One hit of that powder and I'm wired straight through. Sleep can wait.

ThoughtDef::VBE_DeluxeTobaccoHigh.label: smoked a cigar
ThoughtDef::VBE_DeluxeTobaccoHigh.description: Puffing on that cigar, I feel like I finally hauled in a real score instead of scrap.

ThoughtDef::VBE_DrankSoda.label: drank soda
ThoughtDef::VBE_DrankSoda.description: A cold, fizzy soda in this heat is a small mercy. I'll take it.

ThoughtDef::VBE_DrankTea.label: drank tea
ThoughtDef::VBE_DrankTea.description: A simple cup of tea, brewed slow, makes the whole day sit easier.

ThoughtDef::VBE_EnergyDrinkHigh.label: drank an energy drink
ThoughtDef::VBE_EnergyDrinkHigh.description: That drink hit my blood like a hyperdrive kicking in. I could run laps around the settlement.

ThoughtDef::VBE_GinAsIngredient.label: drank gin cocktail
ThoughtDef::VBE_GinAsIngredient.description: That gin mix went down clean and sharp. Good stuff, whoever brewed it.

ThoughtDef::VBE_HotCoffeeHigh.label: drank hot caf
ThoughtDef::VBE_HotCoffeeHigh.description: That hot caf hit exactly right. Bitter, strong, and just what I needed before the shift.

ThoughtDef::VBE_IcedCoffeeHigh.label: drank iced caf
ThoughtDef::VBE_IcedCoffeeHigh.description: Cold caf over ice, in this heat — that hit exactly right.

ThoughtDef::VBE_RBMeadAsIngredient.label: drank mead cocktail
ThoughtDef::VBE_RBMeadAsIngredient.description: That mead mix was sweet and heavy, sat warm in my chest the whole way down.

ThoughtDef::VBE_TequilaAsIngredient.label: drank tequila cocktail
ThoughtDef::VBE_TequilaAsIngredient.description: That tequila mix burned going down, but it burned good.

ThoughtDef::VBE_TobaccoHigh.label: lit one up
ThoughtDef::VBE_TobaccoHigh.description: Pulled the smoke deep and let it work. First real quiet my head's had all shift.

ThoughtDef::VBE_TobaccoWithdrawal.label: tobacco withdrawal
ThoughtDef::VBE_TobaccoWithdrawal.description: I'd trade half my scrap pile for a cigarette right now. My hands keep reaching for one that isn't there.

ThoughtDef::VBE_VodkaAsIngredient.label: drank vodka cocktail
ThoughtDef::VBE_VodkaAsIngredient.description: That vodka mix hit clean and fast. No complaints.

ThoughtDef::VBE_WhiskeyAsIngredient.label: drank whiskey cocktail
ThoughtDef::VBE_WhiskeyAsIngredient.description: That whiskey mix had a good burn to it, the kind that makes a long shift worth finishing.

ThoughtDef::VBE_WineAsIngredient.label: drank wine cocktail
ThoughtDef::VBE_WineAsIngredient.description: That wine mix was smooth going down, better than anything I've traded for in a while.

ThoughtDef::PR_ForceFed.label: force-fed
ThoughtDef::PR_ForceFed.description: Someone forced food down my throat like I was a beast too stupid to feed itself. I won't forget the humiliation of it.

ThoughtDef::PR_HarmfulSurgeryVictim.label: cut me open
ThoughtDef::PR_HarmfulSurgeryVictim.description: This is the one who opened me up while I was strapped down and helpless. I look at them and feel the blade again.

ThoughtDef::PR_HarmfulSurgeryWitness.label: butchers fellow captives
ThoughtDef::PR_HarmfulSurgeryWitness.description: They carve into the others in this cage like we're spare parts on a workbench. I could be next on the table.

ThoughtDef::PR_MissesPrison.label: adjusting to freedom
ThoughtDef::PR_MissesPrison.description: After so long chained in that cell, the open sand feels wrong under my feet. Part of me almost misses knowing exactly where the walls were.

ThoughtDef::PR_OldFriend.label: old friend
ThoughtDef::PR_OldFriend.description: We've hauled scrap and dodged raiders together for years. I'd stand at their back against anything this desert throws at us.

ThoughtDef::PR_PrisonWork.label: put to work in the cage
ThoughtDef::PR_PrisonWork.description: At least they've given my hands something to do in here — better than staring at the bars all day, though some jobs they hand me are worse than the boredom.

ThoughtDef::PR_Ringleader.label: cellblock mood
ThoughtDef::PR_Ringleader.description: The one who runs this block sets the temper for the rest of us — their mood bleeds into every cage down the row, mine included.

ThoughtDef::PR_Searched.label: searched
ThoughtDef::PR_Searched.description: They patted me down like I was a crate of contraband, not a person. Nothing in this cell is mine anymore, not even my pockets.

ThoughtDef::PR_SolitaryResentment.label: buried in the hole
ThoughtDef::PR_SolitaryResentment.description: Nothing down here but dark and my own breathing, day after day. I'm keeping a tally, and it isn't in their favor.

XenotypeDef::Baseliner.label: Baseliner
XenotypeDef::Baseliner.description: No genes worth logging. A baseliner works like your grandfather worked — hands, sweat, and whatever tool's in reach. Cheap to feed, easy to trust, nothing to trade for. Every clan's got a few; every clan needs them.

XenotypeDef::Jawa_Xeno_Gamorrean.label: Gamorrean
XenotypeDef::Jawa_Xeno_Gamorrean.description: Big, tusked, from a wet green world that ruined them for a desert. Strong backs, short patience — put them on hauling and lifting, never on a delicate deal. Feed them well and they won't ask questions about where the meat came from.

XenotypeDef::MandrakeJawa.label: Jawa
XenotypeDef::MandrakeJawa.description: Us. Small under the hood for a reason — less skin in the sun, less water lost to it. Big eyes see in the dark when the sandcrawler runs cold-hours; the old scars on our hands are the ledger nobody needs written down. We don't explain ourselves to outsiders. We don't need to.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeAbednedo.label: Abednedo
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeAbednedo.description: Long dangling tendrils off the face, catch the wind before you feel it — useful on watch duty during a storm. Steady, easygoing types, good with their hands, don't spook at a hard bargain. Homeworld gets battered by weather worse than ours, so a little grit doesn't slow them down.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeAnzati.label: Anzati
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeAnzati.description: Old. Older than they look, and that's the problem — they feed on more than food, and every settlement that's ever hosted one long-term has a story it doesn't like to tell. Charming to a fault, which is exactly the warning sign. Trade in the open, never alone, never after dark.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeAqualish.label: Aqualish
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeAqualish.description: Round black eyes, thick fur, a temper that doesn't wait for an insult to land before it swings. Some strains run four arms — twice the work, twice the reach in a brawl. Good muscle for a raid or a hauling crew; bad choice to seat across a negotiating table.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeArkanian.label: Arkanian
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeArkanian.description: Pale skin, white hair, eyes that don't blink at a gene-splice most folk would call heresy. Their homeworld bred engineers who rewrote living things for a living, and it shows in how coldly they talk about a body. Worth more at a workbench than a campfire.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeBith.label: Bith
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeBith.description: Domed skull, no eyelids, ears that catch a coolant hiss three rooms off before you do. Steady hands, careful minds, half of them can carry a tune while they work a torch. Put one on watch or on repairs and forget you're short-handed.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeBothan.label: Bothan
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeBothan.description: Fur that shifts color with the mood, and a mind that never stops keeping score. Every clan trades gossip, but a Bothan trades it for a living — what they know, they sell, and what they sell, someone usually dies over. Useful. Never fully trusted, and they'd tell you the same.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeCathar.label: Cathar
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeCathar.description: Feline, quick-tempered, and loyal past the point of sense once you've earned it. A slight lands harder on a Cathar than on most — keep the insults for someone else's crew. Good in a fight, better as kin.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeCerean.label: Cerean
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeCerean.description: Tall skull, two minds working under it, and they'll make you wait while both weigh in. Slow to decide, near impossible to fool once they have. Put them on planning a raid or reading a contract, not on the clock.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeChadraFan.label: Chadra-Fan
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeChadraFan.description: Barely knee-high on a human, ears like satellite dishes, nose that reads a chemfuel leak before the gauge does. Quick, nervous, good in tight crawlspaces a bigger scavenger can't reach. Kin to how we work, if not to what we are.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeChagrian.label: Chagrian
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeChagrian.description: Blue skin, head-tresses that read a room's mood before the mouth does, and a homeworld that was all water. They wilt on long dry runs faster than they'll admit — keep the ration skins close. Dignified, careful traders once they trust you.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeChiss.label: Chiss
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeChiss.description: Blue skin, red eyes, and a stare that's already three moves ahead of the conversation. Come from somewhere cold and unmapped, and it left them formal, disciplined, slow to warm to strangers. Deal straight with a Chiss and they'll deal straighter back — cross one and they'll have planned for it before you tried.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeDathomirian.label: Dathomirian
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeDathomirian.description: Horns on the males, wild manes on the females, and a homeworld thick with old magic nobody here claims to understand. Hard folk, harder to spook — most have already survived worse than a desert. Respect the reputation even when the individual seems ordinary.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeDefel.label: Defel
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeDefel.description: Fur that eats the light instead of reflecting it — step into shadow and they're near gone. Nocturnal by nature, which suits a night salvage run better than any tool we own. Post one on a dark watch and sleep easier.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeDevaronian.label: Devaronian
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeDevaronian.description: Horns and a devil's grin on the males, a face fur-covered enough to fool a stranger on the females — neither means what an outsider assumes. Restless by blood; most left home and never went back, which makes them the crew that never balks at a long run. Wanderers, not villains, whatever the face suggests.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeDuros.label: Duros
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeDuros.description: Smooth blue skin, no nose worth mentioning, red eyes that never seem to blink at a bad flight path. Some of the first to fly among the stars, and it's bred true — put a Duros in the pilot's seat of anything that moves and trust the landing.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeEchani.label: Echani
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeEchani.description: Pale skin, white hair, silver eyes, and a way of reading a fight in the set of your shoulders before you throw a punch. Warrior stock, disciplined past what most clans bother with. Hire one to guard the haul and don't waste words explaining the job — they'll already be watching the door.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeEwok.label: Ewok
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeEwok.description: Small, furry, and don't let the size fool you — a cornered Ewok has killed things twice its weight with a sharpened stick and a good trap. Tribal, clannish, suspicious of strangers the same way we are. Closer kin to us than most bigger folk want to admit.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeFalleen.label: Falleen
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeFalleen.description: Mottled green skin, ridged skull, and a way of smelling out exactly what you want to hear — some claim it's more than charm, that the scent itself works on you. Watch a deal with a Falleen the same way you'd watch a card game with a cheat: closely, and sober.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeFeeorin.label: Feeorin
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeFeeorin.description: Tendrils trailing off the head and face, and enough years ahead of them — some run four centuries — that a Feeorin remembers debts the rest of us forgot were owed. Patient past reason. Good for a long trade relationship, bad to try and cheat, because they will still be here to collect.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeGamorrean.label: Gamorrean
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeGamorrean.description: Tusked, thick-skinned, built for lifting what two of us couldn't. Not the crew for talking a price down, but put one on the door or the loading ramp and nothing gets past that shouldn't. Feed them plenty and they're no trouble at all.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeGand.label: Gand
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeGand.description: Some breathe our air fine; some need a mask the moment they step off a ship, ammonia-bred and none too happy about the swap. The findsmen among them won't say the word 'I' — track a person's trail their whole life and start talking like the trail matters more than the tracker. Hire one to find something lost and don't ask how they do it.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeGeonosianVariant.label: Geonosian
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeGeonosianVariant.description: Winged, insectoid, and never really individuals — deal with the hive's will, not the drone in front of you, or the deal means nothing past that one drone. Master builders; put a swarm of them on a foundry job and they'll outbuild a whole crew of us. Don't turn your back on the wings.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeGungan.label: Gungan
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeGungan.description: Amphibious, thick-skinned, and clumsier looking than they fight — a Gungan with an energy-ball launcher has ended arguments faster than a blaster. Need water near enough to duck into, and they'll grumble the whole desert crossing about the lack of it. Sturdier allies than the look suggests.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeHerglic.label: Herglic
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeHerglic.description: Hulking, black-skinned, built like they were meant for open water or open space rather than dry ground — which, on this world, they mostly were. Rare out here, and worth it when you find one: nothing hauls heavier or takes a hit better. Thick hide, thicker patience.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeHutt.label: Hutt
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeHutt.description: Slow-moving, slug-bodied, and it doesn't matter — a Hutt never has to move to win a deal, because the deal was already decided before you sat down. Old, patient past a human lifetime twice over, and every credit that crosses their coils gets remembered. Never owe one anything you can't repay on their terms.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeIktotchi.label: Iktotchi
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeIktotchi.description: Curved horns, reddish skin, and some of them swear they see trouble coming before it arrives — a few are even right often enough to bet on it. Good scouts, better gamblers. Listen when one says to move the caravan; ask questions after.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeIridonian.label: Iridonian
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeIridonian.description: Crown of horns aside, near enough to human that you'd miss it in a headwrap. Homeworld's as unforgiving as ours, so they take to this life without complaint — desert-bred stock knows desert-bred work.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeIthorian.label: Ithorian
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeIthorian.description: Long-necked, two mouths, a voice that comes out low and doubled like it's speaking from two directions at once. Gentle by nature, and they'll wince at how hard we strip a scrapyard bare — keep them off any job that looks too much like ruining living ground. Peaceable, useful, easily offended by waste.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeJawa.label: Jawa
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeJawa.description: Small, fur-covered, orange eyes that glow under a hood — a desert people, same as us, who never stop moving from one dry world to the next that'll have them. Every clan out here is built the same way: salvage what the big folk left, trade what you can't use, keep the hood up and the eyes hidden. Family, more or less, whatever crawler they call home.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeKaleesh.label: Kaleesh
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeKaleesh.description: Reptilian, scarred, and most wear the skull of something they killed rather than talk about how. Their homeworld chewed them into warriors first and everything else second. Earn respect from a Kaleesh with steel, not silver — credits mean less to them than a kill well made.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeKaminoan.label: Kaminoan
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeKaminoan.description: Tall, thin, amphibian, and colder about a living body than anyone ought to be — they didn't just study cloning, they perfected it. Precise, clinical, unnervingly patient with a scalpel. Good to have around when someone's hurt bad; don't expect warmth while they work.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeKelDor.label: Kel Dor
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeKelDor.description: Orange-skinned, big black goggle-eyes too sensitive for open sun, and they need a mask fitted the moment they leave homeworld air or they won't last the day. Once geared up, sharp senses and steady nerves — good trackers, better pilots. Budget the mask into the price of hiring one.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeKlatoonian.label: Klatoonian
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeKlatoonian.description: Green to brown skin, green blood if they're cut, and a build made for a lifetime of hauling somebody else's cargo. Strong, uncomplaining workers — the Hutts have leaned on their backs for generations, and we're not too proud to do the same. Don't flinch at the blood; it's just theirs.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeKubaz.label: Kubaz
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeKubaz.description: Long snout, keen nose — a Kubaz can smell a coolant leak or a lie three stalls down the bazaar. Keep an eye on the ledger around one; the good ones traded gossip and grudges as fast as scrap back on Kubindi, and habits like that don't stay home. Useful on a crew that needs eyes and ears in a crowded market.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeLasat.label: Lasat
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeLasat.description: Big, strong, and built for hauling what two of us together couldn't lift. Lasan is gone — burned out from under them by the Empire — so don't ask, and don't expect gratitude for pity; earn trust with fair work and a straight trade, same as anyone who's lost a homeworld.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeMimbanese.label: Mimbanese
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeMimbanese.description: Mud-world stock, and it shows: they'll work a swamp claim or a flooded trench without the complaint that would fold a desert crew in an hour. Mimban bred them fighting Imperial mining rigs, so don't be surprised if one still flinches at a company logo.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeMirialan.label: Mirialan
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeMirialan.description: Green or purple skin, marks cut into the face for things earned, not given — respect that, it's the closest thing they've got to our own clan-marks. Quiet, disciplined, good with their hands; the kind you want on a delicate salvage job, not a loud one.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeMonCalamari.label: Mon Calamari
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeMonCalamari.description: Big-domed heads, gill-slits, a nose for a bad hull weld from a klick off. Put one near a busted engine or a leaking tank before you put a wrench in your own hand — Mon Cala breeds shipwrights, and it shows in everything they touch.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeMuun.label: Muun
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeMuun.description: Thin, tall, and they'll count your credits twice before you've finished counting them once. Banking-clan blood; fair dealers if the terms are exact, but read every line before you sign — a Muun never writes a contract that favors the other side.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeNagai.label: Nagai
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeNagai.description: Tall, quick, and touchy about honor in a way that gets men killed over nothing, so don't insult one you mean to keep around. Wild Space stock, hard fighters, harder to read — useful backup, bad company for a slow argument.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeNautolan.label: Nautolan
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeNautolan.description: Green-blue skin, head-tentacles that read the air like a Jawa reads a scrap pile — don't try to bluff one, they'll smell the lie before you finish it. Amphibious, tough in weather that'd cook the rest of us; good for the wet-season runs nobody else wants.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeNeimoidian.label: Neimoidian
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeNeimoidian.description: Smooth green faces, soft voices, and a mind for profit margins sharper than any blade on this crew. Trade Federation stock — don't mistake the caution for weakness, it's kept their kind rich longer than most species stay solvent.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeNelvaanian.label: Nelvaanian
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeNelvaanian.description: Blue fur, wolf jaw, claws that'll open a crate faster than a vibroblade. Not much for words, plenty for work — point one at a job and step back.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeNikto.label: Nikto
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeNikto.description: Scaled hide, horns, built for rough work in worse weather — Kintan bred them tough. Plenty hire out as muscle for the Hutts; that's not an insult, it's just where the steady credits are, and a Nikto on your side is worth the wage.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeOrtolan.label: Ortolan
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeOrtolan.description: Soft, round, big ears, gentler than they look — good ears for a haggle, bad stomach for a fight. Feed one well and it'll remember you kindly; Ortolans hold a grudge about hunger longer than they hold one about anything else.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakePantoran.label: Pantoran
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakePantoran.description: Blue skin, gold marks on the face, cold-world stock that handles heat worse than we do — keep one shaded and watered on a desert run or you'll lose the day's work to sunstroke. Steady traders otherwise, no complaints there.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakePyke.label: Pyke
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakePyke.description: Big skull, small face, and a look that unsettles half the market before they've said a word. Spice-cartel blood runs deep in that family name — trade careful, ask fewer questions than you want to, and never owe one credits.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeQuarren.label: Quarren
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeQuarren.description: Squid-faced, sharp-tempered about their old rivalry with the Mon Calamari — don't seat the two at the same table unless you like shouting. Good hands underwater or in a flooded hold; keep the grudge off the work floor and they're solid.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeRakata.label: Rakata
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeRakata.description: Amphibious, old-blood, and carry themselves like they remember when their people ruled the stars — some of the oldest hyperspace lore in the galaxy traces back to Lehon. Rare to see one on a scavenger crew; when you do, listen before you talk.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeRodian.label: Rodian
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeRodian.description: Big infrared eyes, twitchy antennae that pick up a footstep before your own ears do — good watch on a night haul. Rodia turns out hunters and trackers more than traders; pay the bounty, don't become one.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeSelkath.label: Selkath
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeSelkath.description: Water-skinned, from a whole world of the stuff, and they wilt fast away from it — keep a basin or a damp cloth handy if one's working your crew in this desert, or you'll lose them to the dry faster than you'd think. Steady, careful workers once they're not dying of thirst.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeSithKissaiPurebl.label: Sith Kissai (Pureblood)
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeSithKissaiPurebl.description: Red skin, priest-caste bearing, and a way of talking about the dark side like it's a tool on a belt rather than a story. Rare out this far — if one's trading with you, they want something specific, and it's worth finding out what before the deal closes.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeSithMassassi.label: Sith Massassi (Pureblood)
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeSithMassassi.description: Ridged red hide, tendrils down the jaw, built for a fight rather than a sermon — different line from the priest-caste Kissai, same old blood. Hard workers when the job's physical; don't expect the patience for anything fine.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeSithZ.label: Sith Zugurak (Pureblood)
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeSithZ.description: The engineer line of that old bloodline — tomb-builders and shipwrights once, and the hands still show for it. Give one a busted hull or a collapsed tunnel and they'll have opinions worth listening to.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeSnivvian.label: Snivvian
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeSnivvian.description: Big nostrils, a jaw with a pair of tusks, and a face that reads sadder than the pawn usually feels — don't mistake the look for the mood. Decent traders, expressive in a way that makes them easy to read at the table, which cuts both ways.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeSullustan.label: Sullustan
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeSullustan.description: Big eyes, big ears, built for the dark of a mine tunnel or a ship's crawlspace — Sullust breeds them underground and it never leaves. Some of the best small-craft pilots you'll find; put one behind the stick before you put one on a wrench.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeTaung.label: Taung
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeTaung.description: Old blood, near enough to a ghost story as a living species gets — the tales say they're kin somewhere far back to the armored clans, but nobody out here can prove it and I wouldn't ask one to their face. If you meet one, you're meeting something rare.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeTogorian.label: Togorian
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeTogorian.description: Big cats standing upright, digitigrade like they're always ready to run — strong, fast, dangerous to cross. Good hunters, better guards; don't leave food unclaimed around one and don't test the claws.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeTogruta.label: Togruta
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeTogruta.description: Colored skin, white stripes, head-tails that hear better than most crews' whole watch rotation put together. Shili bred them for the hunt-pack — one of these on lookout is worth two without the montrals.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeTrandoshan.label: Trandoshan
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeTrandoshan.description: Scaled, tough, and they'll grow a lost finger back before you've finished apologizing for costing it to them. Hunters by nature and old rivals of the Wookiees — keep the two off the same crew unless you enjoy refereeing.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeTusken.label: Tusken
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeTusken.description: Wrapped head to foot, never seen bare-faced by outsiders and don't expect to be the first. Tatooine's own — territorial, dangerous to a moisture farm or a careless caravan, about as likely to trade fair as a sandstorm is to hold still. Respect the wraps, keep your distance, don't push.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeTwilek.label: Twi'lek
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeTwilek.description: Lekku instead of hair, from Ryloth, and more of them scattered across the galaxy in chains than free — a fact worth remembering before you make demands of one on this crew. Adaptable, quick-witted, and they've earned every bit of the wariness they carry.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeUgnaught.label: Ugnaught
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeUgnaught.description: Short, piggish snout, and they'll outwork three of us on a shift without slowing down — Cloud City bred them for exactly that kind of labor and the habit never left. Pay fair, work them fair, and you'll never find a steadier hand on the line.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeUmbaran.label: Umbaran
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeUmbaran.description: Pale skin, no color in the eyes, and a soft way of talking that can turn a bad deal into a good-sounding one before you notice — watch for that, not the face. Umbara's a dark world; don't be surprised if one prefers the shade.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeWeequay.label: Weequay
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeWeequay.description: Leather hide, tough enough to shrug off sun and a stray blaster bolt both — desert stock knows desert stock, and a Weequay handles this heat better than half the crew. Plenty run with pirates or mercs back where they're from; that's a resume, not a warning, out here.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeWookiee.label: Wookiee
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeWookiee.description: Tall, strong, covered in fur, and loyal to whoever's earned it — Kashyyyk breeds warriors and craftsmen both, and you want either on your side of a fight. Don't cheat one on a debt; a Wookiee's memory for a wrong is as long as the arm that'll collect it.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeYoderForceGremli.label: Yoder
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeYoderForceGremli.description: Rare enough that most of the clan's never traded with one — small, strange, said to live long past anything reasonable. Whatever the truth of it, treat the meeting as the find of a lifetime and don't try too hard to explain what you're looking at.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeZeltron.label: Zeltron
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeZeltron.description: Red skin, near-human otherwise, and they'll feel the room's mood before you've finished walking into it — good for reading a tense trade, bad for keeping your own bluff hidden. Warm company, sharp senses; don't bring one to a negotiation you plan to lie through.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeZygerrian.label: Zygerrian
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeZygerrian.description: Feline, sharp-featured, carrying an old reputation for the slave trade that the honest ones spend a lifetime living down. Judge the pawn in front of you, not the empire behind the name — but don't be shocked if others on the crew aren't as willing to let it go.

MentalBreakDef::FireTerror.label: bolting from the flame
MentalBreakDef::FireTerror.beginLetter:
{0} is bolting from the fire.

[PAWN_pronoun] won't stop running until the flame is behind [PAWN_objective].
MentalBreakDef::FireTerror.recoveryMessage: {0} has stopped bolting from the fire.

MentalBreakDef::BedroomTantrum.label: wrecking the bunk
MentalBreakDef::BedroomTantrum.beginLetter:
{0} has cracked and is tearing [PAWN_possessive] own bunk apart.

[PAWN_pronoun] is going to wreck everything [PAWN_pronoun] owns in there before it passes.

MentalBreakDef::Berserk.label: gone to the blade
MentalBreakDef::Berserk.beginLetter:
{0} has snapped and gone to the blade.

[PAWN_pronoun] will cut down anyone in reach - crew, stranger, doesn't matter.

MentalBreakDef::Binging_Food.label: gorging the stores
MentalBreakDef::Binging_Food.beginLetter:
{0} is tearing into the food stores.

[PAWN_pronoun] won't stop eating until the ration crate is bare.
MentalBreakDef::Binging_Food.recoveryMessage: {0} has stopped gorging on the stores.

MentalBreakDef::CorpseObsession.label: corpse-fixed
MentalBreakDef::CorpseObsession.beginLetter:
{0} has broken inside and fixed on the dead.

[PAWN_pronoun] is going to drag a corpse out and put it where everyone has to look at it.
MentalBreakDef::CorpseObsession.recoveryMessage: {0} has let go of the corpse fixation.

MentalBreakDef::GiveUpExit.label: walking off into the waste
MentalBreakDef::GiveUpExit.beginLetter:
{0} has given up on this crew.

[PAWN_pronoun] is walking out into the waste to try [PAWN_possessive] luck alone. You can run [PAWN_objective] down and hold [PAWN_objective], or let [PAWN_objective] go - the sand may bring [PAWN_objective] back someday, or it may not.
MentalBreakDef::GiveUpExit.recoveryMessage: {0} thought better of it and is coming back to the crew.

MentalBreakDef::InsultingSpree.label: mouthing off at everyone
MentalBreakDef::InsultingSpree.beginLetter:
{0} is on a mouthing-off spree.

[PAWN_pronoun] will wander the hull, running [PAWN_possessive] mouth at whoever's closest.
MentalBreakDef::InsultingSpree.recoveryMessage: {0} has stopped mouthing off at everyone.

MentalBreakDef::Jailbreaker.label: working the cage door
MentalBreakDef::Jailbreaker.beginLetter: {0} has cracked and is going to talk the prisoners into running.
MentalBreakDef::Jailbreaker.recoveryMessage: {0} has given up on working the cage door.

MentalBreakDef::MurderousRage.label: marked for killing
MentalBreakDef::MurderousRage.beginLetter:
{0} has fixed on a killing.

[PAWN_pronoun] has decided {1} doesn't get to see the next sunrise.
MentalBreakDef::MurderousRage.recoveryMessage: {0} has let go of the killing rage.

MentalBreakDef::SadisticRage.label: taking it out on the cages
MentalBreakDef::SadisticRage.beginLetter:
{0} has flown into a black rage.

[PAWN_pronoun] is going to go take it out on whoever's chained up.
MentalBreakDef::SadisticRage.recoveryMessage: {0} is done taking it out on the prisoners.

MentalBreakDef::Slaughterer.label: turned on the herd
MentalBreakDef::Slaughterer.beginLetter: {0} has cracked and turned on the herd - [PAWN_pronoun]'s going to gut whatever [PAWN_pronoun] can catch.

MentalBreakDef::Tantrum.label: smashing the hull
MentalBreakDef::Tantrum.beginLetter: {0} is smashing whatever's in reach - furniture, gear, the walls themselves.

MentalBreakDef::TargetedInsultingSpree.label: riding {0} hard
MentalBreakDef::TargetedInsultingSpree.beginLetter:
{0} has fixed [PAWN_possessive] rage on {1}.

[PAWN_pronoun] will dog {1}'s steps, mouthing off without letup.

MentalBreakDef::TargetedTantrum.label: set on wrecking it
MentalBreakDef::TargetedTantrum.beginLetter: {0} is having a fit and has fixed on one thing to destroy: {1}.
MentalBreakDef::TargetedTantrum.recoveryMessage: {0} has stopped trying to destroy it.

MentalBreakDef::Wander_OwnRoom.label: shut in
MentalBreakDef::Wander_OwnRoom.beginLetter: {0} has shut [PAWN_objective]self in [PAWN_possessive] own quarters and won't come out.

MentalBreakDef::Wander_Psychotic.label: wandering blank-eyed
MentalBreakDef::Wander_Psychotic.beginLetter: {0} is wandering the hull blank-eyed, [PAWN_possessive] mind somewhere else entirely.

MentalBreakDef::Wander_Sad.label: wandering low
MentalBreakDef::Wander_Sad.beginLetter: {0} has broken down and is wandering the hull, hollowed out.
MentalBreakDef::Wander_Sad.recoveryMessage: {0} has stopped wandering in the low.

MentalBreakDef::Rebellion.label: stirring the chained
MentalBreakDef::Rebellion.beginLetter: {0} has hit the wall inside and is going to stir the other chained ones to break for it.

ThoughtDef::AnyBodyPartButGroinCovered_D.label: wrapped more than the groin
ThoughtDef::AnyBodyPartButGroinCovered_D.description: I've got cloth over skin that should be out in the wind and sun. Only the groin needs hiding — the rest should breathe free.

ThoughtDef::AnyBodyPartButGroinCovered_D.label: wrapped more than the groin
ThoughtDef::AnyBodyPartButGroinCovered_D.description: I've got cloth over skin that should be out in the wind and sun. Only the groin needs hiding — the rest should breathe free.

ThoughtDef::AnyBodyPartButGroinCovered_D.label: wrapped up too much
ThoughtDef::AnyBodyPartButGroinCovered_D.description: I kept skin bound that should have been open to the air, and I knew it while I did it. Only the groin is supposed to stay covered.

ThoughtDef::AnyBodyPartButGroinCovered_D.label: wraps more than the groin
ThoughtDef::AnyBodyPartButGroinCovered_D.description: They keep skin bound that ought to be free in the sun. Not how I'd wear it, but it's their hide.

ThoughtDef::AnyBodyPartButGroinCovered_D.label: wraps more than the groin
ThoughtDef::AnyBodyPartButGroinCovered_D.description: They keep skin bound that ought to be free in the sun. Not how I'd wear it, but it's their hide.

ThoughtDef::AnyBodyPartCovered_Disapprov.label: covered up anyway
ThoughtDef::AnyBodyPartCovered_Disapprov.description: I don't believe in hiding my skin, and here I am wrapped in cloth like everyone else. It doesn't sit right.

ThoughtDef::AnyBodyPartCovered_Disapprov.label: covered up anyway
ThoughtDef::AnyBodyPartCovered_Disapprov.description: I don't believe in hiding my skin, and here I am wrapped in cloth like everyone else. It doesn't sit right.

ThoughtDef::AnyBodyPartCovered_Disapprov.label: hid my skin
ThoughtDef::AnyBodyPartCovered_Disapprov.description: I wrapped myself up when skin should stay bare and open. It was the wrong call and I made it anyway.

ThoughtDef::AnyBodyPartCovered_Disapprov.label: keeps skin covered
ThoughtDef::AnyBodyPartCovered_Disapprov.description: They go around wrapped head to foot when there's no need for it. Skin was never meant to hide.

ThoughtDef::AnyBodyPartCovered_Disapprov.label: keeps skin covered
ThoughtDef::AnyBodyPartCovered_Disapprov.description: They go around wrapped head to foot when there's no need for it. Skin was never meant to hide.

ThoughtDef::BeautifulSkyLanterns.label: lanterns on the wind
ThoughtDef::BeautifulSkyLanterns.description: We sent lanterns up off the dunes and watched them go small against the stars. For a minute the whole camp went quiet and easy.

ThoughtDef::BioSculpterDespised.label: fouled by the pod
ThoughtDef::BioSculpterDespised.description: That biosculpter pod did something to my body I never asked for. I don't care how clean the readout looked — it's not right, using machines to remake flesh.

ThoughtDef::BiosculpterPleasure.label: pod-smoothed all over
ThoughtDef::BiosculpterPleasure.description: Every joint, every scar, every ache — the pod took it and made it feel good instead. I could get used to this.

ThoughtDef::BlindingCeremony_Know_Horrib.label: we blinded one of ours
ThoughtDef::BlindingCeremony_Know_Horrib.description: Someone in the crew put out another's eyes for the ideoligion, and I watched it happen. Whatever the reason, that's not something I can call right.

ThoughtDef::BlindingCeremony_Self_Elevat.label: blinded, and glad of it
ThoughtDef::BlindingCeremony_Self_Elevat.description: They took my sight in the ceremony, and I let them. Without eyes to lie to me, I can finally start learning to actually see.

ThoughtDef::BlindingCeremony_Self_Respec.label: blinded, and glad of it
ThoughtDef::BlindingCeremony_Self_Respec.description: They took my sight in the ceremony, and I let them. Without eyes to lie to me, I can finally start learning to actually see.

ThoughtDef::BlindingCeremony_Self_Sublim.label: blinded, and glad of it
ThoughtDef::BlindingCeremony_Self_Sublim.description: They took my sight in the ceremony, and I let them. Without eyes to lie to me, I can finally start learning to actually see.

ThoughtDef::Blindness_ArtificialBlind.label: wearing the blindfold
ThoughtDef::Blindness_ArtificialBlind.description: Cloth over my eyes keeps me a step closer to the truth underneath what's visible. Not as good as losing the eyes for real, but it'll do.

ThoughtDef::Blindness_Elevated_Blind.label: blind, and better for it
ThoughtDef::Blindness_Elevated_Blind.description: No eyes left, and the world makes more sense than it ever did with them. There's a wider kind of seeing I'm only just getting into.

ThoughtDef::Blindness_Elevated_Blind_Soc.label: goes without eyes
ThoughtDef::Blindness_Elevated_Blind_Soc.description: They've got no sight left, and I respect that — they see something past what the rest of us can.

ThoughtDef::Blindness_Elevated_HalfBlind.label: half in the dark
ThoughtDef::Blindness_Elevated_HalfBlind.description: One eye gone, one still working. They're partway to something I think is worth reaching.

ThoughtDef::Blindness_Elevated_NonBlind.label: still stuck with my eyes
ThoughtDef::Blindness_Elevated_NonBlind.description: I want my sight gone so I can get closer to what's real underneath it. Short of that, I should at least be wearing a blindfold.

ThoughtDef::Blindness_Elevated_NonBlind_.label: keeps both eyes
ThoughtDef::Blindness_Elevated_NonBlind_.description: They've still got full sight, no interest in losing it. Fine for them, I suppose.

ThoughtDef::Blindness_Respected_Blind.label: blind now, clear-headed
ThoughtDef::Blindness_Respected_Blind.description: My eyes are gone and somehow everything is clearer for it. Funny how that works.

ThoughtDef::Blindness_Respected_Blind_So.label: goes without eyes
ThoughtDef::Blindness_Respected_Blind_So.description: No sight left on them, and I think better of them for it.

ThoughtDef::Blindness_Respected_NonBlind.label: keeps both eyes
ThoughtDef::Blindness_Respected_NonBlind.description: Still sighted, no plans otherwise. Not my business.

ThoughtDef::Blindness_Sublime_Blind.label: free of my eyes
ThoughtDef::Blindness_Sublime_Blind.description: With the eyes gone I can finally get past what they were always in the way of — my own mind, the truth underneath things. No limits left there.

ThoughtDef::Blindness_Sublime_Blind_Soci.label: goes without eyes
ThoughtDef::Blindness_Sublime_Blind_Soci.description: No sight on them at all, and to my mind that's the deepest kind of devotion there is.

ThoughtDef::Blindness_Sublime_HalfBlind_.label: half in the dark
ThoughtDef::Blindness_Sublime_HalfBlind_.description: One eye gone. Partway down a road I hold in real high regard.

ThoughtDef::Blindness_Sublime_NonBlind.label: eyes I don't want
ThoughtDef::Blindness_Sublime_NonBlind.description: I want these eyes gone, badly — every day I keep them is a day further from what's real underneath the seeing. At the very least I should be wearing a blindfold.

ThoughtDef::Blindness_Sublime_NonBlind_S.label: keeps both eyes
ThoughtDef::Blindness_Sublime_NonBlind_S.description: Full sight, no interest in losing it. That's their road, not mine.

ThoughtDef::BoringBlinding.label: flat, joyless blinding
ThoughtDef::BoringBlinding.description: That blinding had no fire behind it — sloppy technique, nobody's heart in it. Not the kind of ceremony that means anything.

ThoughtDef::BoringDuel.label: dull duel
ThoughtDef::BoringDuel.description: That duel was two people flinching at each other, no heat in it at all. Just survival, no fight.

ThoughtDef::BoringFestival.label: flat festival
ThoughtDef::BoringFestival.description: That festival dragged. I stood around wishing I'd stayed back at camp.

ThoughtDef::BoringParty.label: dull party
ThoughtDef::BoringParty.description: Bad music, worse dancing, nothing worth staying for. Wish I hadn't bothered showing up.

ThoughtDef::BoringSacrifice.label: flat, joyless sacrifice
ThoughtDef::BoringSacrifice.description: That sacrifice had no fire behind it — sloppy technique, nobody's heart in it. Not the kind of rite that means anything.

ThoughtDef::ButcheredHuman_Abhorrent.label: butchered a person
ThoughtDef::ButcheredHuman_Abhorrent.description: I cut up a person like meat for the pot. That's against everything I hold to, and I don't think I get to walk that back.

ThoughtDef::ButcheredHuman_Disapproved.label: butchered a person
ThoughtDef::ButcheredHuman_Disapproved.description: I cut up a person like they were livestock. I believe that's wrong, and I did it anyway.

ThoughtDef::ButcheredHuman_Horrible.label: butchered a person
ThoughtDef::ButcheredHuman_Horrible.description: I cut up a person like meat for the pot. Whatever the reason, that was a horrible thing to do.

ThoughtDef::ButcheredHuman_Know_Abhorren.label: one of us butchered a person
ThoughtDef::ButcheredHuman_Know_Abhorren.description: Someone in the crew cut up a person like livestock. That's against everything I hold to, and I can't just let it sit quiet.

ThoughtDef::ButcheredHuman_Know_Abhorren.label: butchered a person
ThoughtDef::ButcheredHuman_Know_Abhorren.description: They cut up a person like meat. I don't know how I look at them the same after that.

ThoughtDef::ButcheredHuman_Know_Disappro.label: one of us butchered a person
ThoughtDef::ButcheredHuman_Know_Disappro.description: Someone in the crew cut up a person like livestock. I believe that's wrong, whoever did it.

ThoughtDef::ButcheredHuman_Know_Disappro.label: butchered a person
ThoughtDef::ButcheredHuman_Know_Disappro.description: They cut a person up like meat for the pot. Wrong, plain and simple.

ThoughtDef::ButcheredHuman_Know_Horrible.label: one of us butchered a person
ThoughtDef::ButcheredHuman_Know_Horrible.description: Someone in the crew cut up a person like livestock, and I can't get the thought out of my head. That was a horrible thing to do.

ThoughtDef::ButcheredHuman_Know_Horrible.label: butchered a person
ThoughtDef::ButcheredHuman_Know_Horrible.description: They cut a person up like meat for the pot. That's a horrible thing to have done.

ThoughtDef::ChangedIdeo_Know_Abhorrent.label: turned from the faith
ThoughtDef::ChangedIdeo_Know_Abhorrent.description: They walked away from what we believe, not long back. I still don't know how to look at them.

ThoughtDef::ChangedIdeo_Know_Disapproved.label: turned from the faith
ThoughtDef::ChangedIdeo_Know_Disapproved.description: They walked away from what we believe not long ago. I don't approve, but it's done.

ThoughtDef::ChangedIdeo_Know_Horrible.label: turned from the faith
ThoughtDef::ChangedIdeo_Know_Horrible.description: They walked away from what we believe, and it wasn't long ago. That's a hard thing to sit with.

ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Essential_B.label: fed the beggars
ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Essential_B.description: Wanderers came to the gate with empty hands and we gave what we had. Out here that's not charity, that's just what you do — and it feels good to have done it right.

ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Essential_H.label: took the refugees in
ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Essential_H.description: We opened the doors to people running from something worse than us. Feeding an extra mouth costs water, but I'd do it again without thinking twice.

ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Essential_I.label: helped the stranded noble
ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Essential_I.description: Some soft-handed offworlder showed up in trouble, and we didn't have to help — but we did. Turns out that matters to me more than I expected.

ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Essential_R.label: pulled a survivor from the wreck
ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Essential_R.description: Their pod came down hard and they were half-dead in the sand when we found them. We got them water and shelter, and I'm glad of it — that's who I want to be.

ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Essential_S.label: dug shuttle survivors out
ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Essential_S.description: That shuttle went down hard and we spent the day digging people out of the wreck. Every one we pulled out alive made it worth the sunburn.

ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Essential_T.label: took in someone hunted
ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Essential_T.description: Someone came to us running from real trouble, and we didn't send them back out into it. That's the kind of crew I want to be part of.

ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Important_B.label: fed the beggars
ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Important_B.description: Wanderers turned up hungry at the gate and we gave what we could spare. It was the right call.

ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Important_H.label: took the refugees in
ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Important_H.description: We gave shelter to people who had nowhere else to go. Helping folks like that matters, even when water's tight.

ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Important_I.label: helped the stranded noble
ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Important_I.description: Some offworlder in over their head needed a hand, and we gave it. Helping who you can, when you can — that's important.

ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Important_R.label: pulled a survivor from the wreck
ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Important_R.description: We found them barely breathing next to their crashed pod and got them back on their feet. Helping people out here is important, full stop.

ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Important_S.label: dug shuttle survivors out
ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Important_S.description: We spent the day pulling people from that downed shuttle. It was clearly the right thing to do.

ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Important_T.label: took in someone hunted
ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Important_T.description: Someone in real danger asked us for shelter and we gave it. It was the right thing to do.

ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Worthwhile_.label: fed the beggars
ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Worthwhile_.description: Gave some water and scraps to a few wanderers at the gate. Good to be good to people, when it costs you so little.

ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Worthwhile_.label: took the refugees in
ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Worthwhile_.description: We put up a few people who had nowhere else to go. It was a decent thing to do.

ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Worthwhile_.label: helped the stranded noble
ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Worthwhile_.description: Gave a lost offworlder a hand out of a bad spot. Decent of us, I suppose.

ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Worthwhile_.label: pulled a survivor from the wreck
ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Worthwhile_.description: Got them out of the wreckage and gave them water. Small thing, but it was good of me.

ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Worthwhile_.label: dug shuttle survivors out
ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Worthwhile_.description: Helped haul a few people out of that crashed shuttle. Good thing to have done with the day.

ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Worthwhile_.label: took in someone hunted
ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Worthwhile_.description: Let someone in trouble stay with us a while. That was pretty good of us.

ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Essential_Beg.label: turned the beggars away
ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Essential_Beg.description: They came to the gate begging and we shut it in their faces. What kind of crew does that — am I even still decent?

ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Essential_Beg.label: betrayed the beggars
ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Essential_Beg.description: They came begging and we as good as promised help, then turned on them instead. I don't know if I can forgive myself for that one.

ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Essential_Hos.label: turned the refugees away
ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Essential_Hos.description: They had nowhere left to go and we sent them back out into the waste anyway. How does a person do that and still call themselves decent?

ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Essential_Pil.label: turned pilgrims away
ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Essential_Pil.description: They only wanted to see the relic, and we refused them at the door. That was a selfish, small thing to do.

ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Essential_Pil.label: betrayed the pilgrims
ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Essential_Pil.description: They came to pay respect to the relic and we turned on them instead. I don't know how we sank that low.

ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Essential_Shu.label: left the shuttle burning
ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Essential_Shu.description: That shuttle went down and people were screaming for help, and we didn't go. I don't know how I live with that one.

ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Essential_Thr.label: turned away someone hunted
ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Essential_Thr.description: Someone in real danger came to us for shelter and we said no. I've broken something in myself I believed in.

ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Essential_Wan.label: turned the wanderer away
ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Essential_Wan.description: Someone came looking for help and we sent them back into the sand alone. That was an inhuman thing to do.

ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Important_Beg.label: turned the beggars away
ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Important_Beg.description: They came begging at the gate and we did nothing for them. That was deeply wrong of us.

ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Important_Beg.label: betrayed the beggars
ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Important_Beg.description: They came begging and we betrayed the trust instead of helping. That was a horrendous thing to do.

ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Important_Hos.label: turned the refugees away
ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Important_Hos.description: They were desperate and we didn't help. We were obligated to do better than that.

ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Important_Pil.label: turned pilgrims away
ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Important_Pil.description: They asked only to view the relic and we refused. We need to do better than that.

ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Important_Pil.label: betrayed the pilgrims
ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Important_Pil.description: They came to pay respects to the relic and we betrayed them for it. That was a monstrous thing to do.

ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Important_Shu.label: left the shuttle burning
ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Important_Shu.description: That shuttle went down and we didn't go help. It was flat wrong.

ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Important_Thr.label: turned away someone hunted
ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Important_Thr.description: Someone in real danger needed help and we refused it. That'll sit with me a while.

ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Important_Wan.label: turned the wanderer away
ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Important_Wan.description: They needed help and we sent them off. Only a rotten crew does that.

ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Worthwhile_Be.label: turned the beggars away
ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Worthwhile_Be.description: They asked for help and we gave them nothing. We should try harder than that.

ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Worthwhile_Be.label: betrayed the beggars
ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Worthwhile_Be.description: They came begging and we betrayed them instead of helping. Can't let that happen again.

ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Worthwhile_Ho.label: turned the refugees away
ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Worthwhile_Ho.description: They were desperate and we didn't help them. Wasn't our finest hour.

ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Worthwhile_Pi.label: turned pilgrims away
ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Worthwhile_Pi.description: They only wanted to see the relic and we sent them off. We should try harder than that.

ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Worthwhile_Pi.label: betrayed the pilgrims
ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Worthwhile_Pi.description: They came to pay respects to the relic and we betrayed that. We owe better than that.

ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Worthwhile_Sh.label: left the shuttle burning
ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Worthwhile_Sh.description: That shuttle went down and we didn't go help. Wasn't a good look for us.

ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Worthwhile_Th.label: turned away someone hunted
ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Worthwhile_Th.description: Someone in danger asked for help and we refused. Wasn't great of us.

ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Worthwhile_Wa.label: turned the wanderer away
ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Worthwhile_Wa.description: They needed help and we turned them away. We should have done better.

ThoughtDef::CounselFailed.label: counsel that made it worse
ThoughtDef::CounselFailed.description: {0} tried to talk me through something that's been eating at me, and somehow it just dug the hole deeper.

ThoughtDef::Counselled.label: talked it through
ThoughtDef::Counselled.description: {0} sat with me and let me talk about what's been gnawing at me. Didn't fix it, but it helped to say it out loud.

ThoughtDef::Counselled_MoodBoost.label: good talk with {0}
ThoughtDef::Counselled_MoodBoost.description: {0} listened to what I had to say without rushing me along. Felt good to just be heard for once.

ThoughtDef::CutTree_Know_Disapproved.label: a tree came down
ThoughtDef::CutTree_Know_Disapproved.description: Someone in the crew felled a tree. Wood's wood, but it still doesn't sit easy with me.

ThoughtDef::CutTree_Know_Disapproved_Moo.label: felled a tree
ThoughtDef::CutTree_Know_Disapproved_Moo.description: We cut a tree down for lumber. Wasn't a good way to treat what little green grows out here.

ThoughtDef::CutTree_Know_Horrible.label: a tree came down
ThoughtDef::CutTree_Know_Horrible.description: Someone in the crew took a tree down. Out here where nothing green lasts, that feels like more than it should.

ThoughtDef::CutTree_Know_Prohibited.label: a tree came down
ThoughtDef::CutTree_Know_Prohibited.description: Someone cut down a tree, and that's not supposed to happen among us. I don't like knowing it did.

ThoughtDef::CutTree_Know_Prohibited_Mood.label: felled a tree
ThoughtDef::CutTree_Know_Prohibited_Mood.description: We cut down a tree that was never ours to take. That kind of thing against what little grows here should never happen.

ThoughtDef::EffectiveConversion.label: the sermon landed
ThoughtDef::EffectiveConversion.description: That conversion talk actually worked — good words, good delivery, people were listening. Rare to see it done that well.

ThoughtDef::EnslavedPrisoner_Know_Honora.label: took a prisoner as a slave
ThoughtDef::EnslavedPrisoner_Know_Honora.description: We put a prisoner in chains for the clan. Now they know exactly what our reach is worth.

ThoughtDef::ExpectationsSlave.label: a slave's low expectations
ThoughtDef::ExpectationsSlave.description: I'm bound to a clan that has next to nothing, so I've learned not to want much. Whatever they can spare is whatever I get.

ThoughtDef::FailedConvertAbilityRecipien.label: someone tried converting me
ThoughtDef::FailedConvertAbilityRecipien.description: {0} came at me trying to talk me into their faith. I just want to be left to mine.

ThoughtDef::FunFestival.label: good time at the festival
ThoughtDef::FunFestival.description: Got to kick back with the crew for once, nothing to fix, nothing to scavenge. Felt good just to laugh for a while.

ThoughtDef::FunParty.label: good party
ThoughtDef::FunParty.description: That was a proper break from the grind — music, drink, nobody working. Needed that.

ThoughtDef::GauranlenConnectionDesired.label: bond with the tree-thing
ThoughtDef::GauranlenConnectionDesired.description: That gauranlen tree and I are linked somehow, and going too long without checking in on it leaves me uneasy. Out here, it's the closest thing to green I've got.

ThoughtDef::GoodDuel.label: a real duel
ThoughtDef::GoodDuel.description: That duel had teeth in it — both of them fighting like it mattered. Good to watch people put everything on the line.

ThoughtDef::GoodFuneral.label: a proper send-off
ThoughtDef::GoodFuneral.description: We gave them a real send-off, said it right, buried them right. Good way to close out a life.

ThoughtDef::GotLovin_Abhorrent.label: gave in to lust
ThoughtDef::GotLovin_Abhorrent.description: I let myself go somewhere I have no business going. That was flat against everything I hold to.

ThoughtDef::GotLovin_Disapproved.label: gave in, briefly
ThoughtDef::GotLovin_Disapproved.description: I let want get the better of judgment for a while. Wrong call, I know it.

ThoughtDef::GotLovin_Horrible.label: gave in to lust
ThoughtDef::GotLovin_Horrible.description: I let myself go somewhere I have no business going. Deeply wrong, and I know it.

ThoughtDef::GroinChestHairOrFaceUncovere.label: showed too much skin
ThoughtDef::GroinChestHairOrFaceUncovere.description: I let myself be seen with too much bare — should be wrapped up head to foot, nothing on show. That was wrong of me.

ThoughtDef::GroinChestHairOrFaceUncovere.label: showed too much skin
ThoughtDef::GroinChestHairOrFaceUncovere.description: I let myself be seen with too much bare — should be wrapped up head to foot, nothing on show. That was wrong of me.

ThoughtDef::GroinChestHairOrFaceUncovere.label: shows too much skin
ThoughtDef::GroinChestHairOrFaceUncovere.description: They go around with too much bare for my taste. Should keep it all covered.

ThoughtDef::GroinChestHairOrFaceUncovere.label: shows too much skin
ThoughtDef::GroinChestHairOrFaceUncovere.description: They go around with too much bare for my taste. Should keep it all covered.

ThoughtDef::GroinChestOrHairUncovered_Di.label: groin, chest, or hair bare
ThoughtDef::GroinChestOrHairUncovered_Di.description: I've got skin showing that should be hidden — only the face is meant to be seen. Wrong to be out like this.

ThoughtDef::GroinChestOrHairUncovered_Di.label: groin, chest, or hair bare
ThoughtDef::GroinChestOrHairUncovered_Di.description: I've got skin showing that should be hidden — only the face is meant to be seen. Wrong to be out like this.

ThoughtDef::GroinChestOrHairUncovered_Di.label: shows too much skin
ThoughtDef::GroinChestOrHairUncovered_Di.description: They've got skin bare that should stay covered. Not how it's meant to be worn.

ThoughtDef::GroinChestOrHairUncovered_Di.label: shows too much skin
ThoughtDef::GroinChestOrHairUncovered_Di.description: They've got skin bare that should stay covered. Not how it's meant to be worn.

ThoughtDef::GroinOrChestUncovered_Disapp.label: chest or groin bare
ThoughtDef::GroinOrChestUncovered_Disapp.description: They're going around with chest or groin uncovered. Should keep it wrapped.

ThoughtDef::GroinOrChestUncovered_Disapp.label: chest or groin bare
ThoughtDef::GroinOrChestUncovered_Disapp.description: They're going around with chest or groin uncovered. Should keep it wrapped.

ThoughtDef::GroinUncovered_Disapproved_S.label: groin left bare
ThoughtDef::GroinUncovered_Disapproved_S.description: They've got the one part that should always stay covered, showing. That's not how it's done.

ThoughtDef::GroinUncovered_Disapproved_S.label: groin left bare
ThoughtDef::GroinUncovered_Disapproved_S.description: They've got the one part that should always stay covered, showing. That's not how it's done.

ThoughtDef::HarvestedOrgan_Abhorrent.label: cut an organ out
ThoughtDef::HarvestedOrgan_Abhorrent.description: I had to carve a piece out of someone for parts. That's about as far from what I believe as it gets.

ThoughtDef::HarvestedOrgan_Horrible.label: cut an organ out
ThoughtDef::HarvestedOrgan_Horrible.description: I had to carve a piece out of someone for parts. Horrible thing to have my hands do, whatever the reason.

ThoughtDef::HarvestedOrgan_Know_Abhorren.label: someone got carved for parts
ThoughtDef::HarvestedOrgan_Know_Abhorren.description: One of the crew had an organ cut out of them for salvage. I can't square that with what I believe.

ThoughtDef::HarvestedOrgan_Know_Abhorren.label: an organ taken
ThoughtDef::HarvestedOrgan_Know_Abhorren.description: Somebody took a piece out of one of ours for parts. That's a horrible thing to have happen to family.

ThoughtDef::HarvestedOrgan_Know_Horrible.label: someone got carved for parts
ThoughtDef::HarvestedOrgan_Know_Horrible.description: One of the crew had an organ cut out of them. It's a horrible offense against everything I hold to.

ThoughtDef::HarvestedOrgan_Know_Horrible.label: an organ taken
ThoughtDef::HarvestedOrgan_Know_Horrible.description: Somebody took a piece out of one of ours for parts. That's a horrible thing to have happen to family.

ThoughtDef::HasNoProsthetic_Disapproved.label: still all flesh
ThoughtDef::HasNoProsthetic_Disapproved.description: Not a scrap of chrome anywhere on me. Feels wrong not to have upgraded what the body can't do on its own.

ThoughtDef::HasNoProsthetic_Disapproved_.label: still all flesh
ThoughtDef::HasNoProsthetic_Disapproved_.description: No augments on them at all. Seems like they're falling behind.

ThoughtDef::HasProsthetic_Abhorrent.label: wired with chrome
ThoughtDef::HasProsthetic_Abhorrent.description: There's machine grafted into my own flesh now. Every gear-turn under my skin is a betrayal of everything I hold sacred.

ThoughtDef::HasProsthetic_Abhorrent_Soci.label: chrome under their skin
ThoughtDef::HasProsthetic_Abhorrent_Soci.description: They've let machine into their body. I can't look at them without thinking about what that says about their soul.

ThoughtDef::HasProsthetic_Approved.label: modded and proud
ThoughtDef::HasProsthetic_Approved.description: Every chrome part I add is another proof I'm becoming what I'm meant to be. The more machine in me, the more myself I feel.

ThoughtDef::HasProsthetic_Disapproved.label: wired with chrome
ThoughtDef::HasProsthetic_Disapproved.description: I've got machine grafted into my own body now. I don't like it, and I don't think I ever will.

ThoughtDef::HasProsthetic_Disapproved_So.label: chrome under their skin
ThoughtDef::HasProsthetic_Disapproved_So.description: They've got machine parts grafted into their body. It's not to my taste, and I can't help noticing it.

ThoughtDef::HeartwarmingFuneral.label: a good send-off
ThoughtDef::HeartwarmingFuneral.description: We buried one of our own right. Old stories got told, old grudges got dropped, and for a while it felt like the whole crew was one family again.

ThoughtDef::HighLife.label: walking the higher path
ThoughtDef::HighLife.description: My faith says the clearest truth comes from a mind turned loose. Right now I'm right where I should be - half somewhere else, half here, and both feel true.

ThoughtDef::HumanLeatherApparel_Abhorren.label: wearing skin-leather
ThoughtDef::HumanLeatherApparel_Abhorren.description: This apparel is cut from someone's skin. I don't care whose - wearing it makes me sick to the stomach every time I put it on.

ThoughtDef::HumanLeatherApparel_Disappro.label: wearing skin-leather
ThoughtDef::HumanLeatherApparel_Disappro.description: This gear is cut from someone's hide, not a beast's. It sits wrong on me, even if I can't say exactly why.

ThoughtDef::HumanLeatherApparel_Horrible.label: dressed in skin-leather
ThoughtDef::HumanLeatherApparel_Horrible.description: Every time I look down at this gear I remember it used to be someone's skin. I hate that I'm the one wearing it.

ThoughtDef::HumanLeatherApparel_Preferre.label: wearing skin-leather
ThoughtDef::HumanLeatherApparel_Preferre.description: There's an old raider's habit in taking a hide and wearing it proud. This one fits well, and I like what it says about me.

ThoughtDef::IdeoBuildingMissing.label: no {BUILDING_label}
ThoughtDef::IdeoBuildingMissing.description: We're supposed to have {BUILDING_labelIndef} and we don't. Something's missing from how we do things here.

ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Abhorrent.label: heretics among us
ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Abhorrent.description: The truth is right there in front of everyone, plain as the suns overhead, and still some of this crew won't see it. It makes my skin crawl.

ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Abhorrent_Part.label: stood at a false rite
ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Abhorrent_Part.description: I stood through a ceremony built on beliefs I know are wrong. Didn't matter that I had no choice - I shouldn't have been there.

ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Abhorrent_Soci.label: believes differently
ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Abhorrent_Soci.description: Their faith isn't mine, and it isn't close. I can't shake how wrong that sits with me.

ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Abhorrent_Styl.label: {ADJECTIVE}-style surroundings
ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Abhorrent_Styl.description: Everything I see around here is built {ADJECTIVE}, the way my faith says it should be. It's the only reason this crew still feels like home to me.

ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Abhorrent_Unif.label: no heretics here
ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Abhorrent_Unif.description: Every one of us believes the same thing, the way it should be. No poison thoughts creeping in from outside.

ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Approved.label: different faiths, one crew
ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Approved.description: Not everyone here believes what I believe, and that's fine by me. A crew that can hold more than one truth is a healthy one.

ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Approved_Style.label: too much {ADJECTIVE}
ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Approved_Style.description: Everything here is built {ADJECTIVE}, over and over, no exceptions. It's fine, but I'd trade some of that sameness for a bit more variety.

ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Disapproved.label: wrongheaded beliefs nearby
ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Disapproved.description: I know what's true, and some of this crew just won't see it. Doesn't put me in a good mood being around that kind of thinking.

ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Disapproved_Pa.label: stood at a false rite
ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Disapproved_Pa.description: I took part in a ceremony that wasn't built on my beliefs. Wasn't my choice, but I still wish I hadn't been there.

ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Disapproved_So.label: believes differently
ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Disapproved_So.description: Their faith isn't mine. Doesn't sit easy with me, even if it's not the worst thing in the world.

ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Disapproved_St.label: {ADJECTIVE}-style surroundings
ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Disapproved_St.description: The way things are built around here is {ADJECTIVE}, matching what I believe. Small comfort, but I notice it every day.

ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Disapproved_Un.label: no wrongheaded thinking here
ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Disapproved_Un.description: Everyone on this crew believes the same thing. No arguments about what's true, and that's how I like it.

ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Exalted.label: different faiths, one crew
ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Exalted.description: Half this crew believes something different than I do, and I love that about us. A faith that can't stand next to another one isn't much of a faith.

ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Exalted_StyleD.label: too much {ADJECTIVE}
ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Exalted_StyleD.description: Every wall and floor here is built {ADJECTIVE}. Fine work, but my faith says variety is the better path, and I miss it.

ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Horrible.label: heretics among us
ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Horrible.description: The truth is obvious to anyone with eyes, and still half this crew is blind to it. It's honestly hard to stomach some days.

ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Horrible_Parti.label: stood at a false rite
ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Horrible_Parti.description: I stood through a ceremony built on beliefs I know are false. I shouldn't have been there, choice or not.

ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Horrible_Socia.label: believes differently
ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Horrible_Socia.description: Their faith runs against everything I hold true. Being around it wears on me more than I'd like to admit.

ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Horrible_Style.label: {ADJECTIVE}-style surroundings
ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Horrible_Style.description: Everything built here is {ADJECTIVE}, matching my beliefs line for line. It's about the only thing keeping me steady these days.

ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Respected.label: different faiths, one crew
ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Respected.description: Plenty of this crew believes something other than what I believe. I take that as a good sign - a crew that can't disagree isn't much of a crew.

ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Respected_Styl.label: too much {ADJECTIVE}
ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Respected_Styl.description: Every build around here follows the same {ADJECTIVE} lines. Good work, but I'd rather see some variety mixed in.

ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Standard_Style.label: too much {ADJECTIVE}
ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Standard_Style.description: The place is built {ADJECTIVE}, same style throughout. Nothing wrong with it, but a little variety wouldn't hurt.

ThoughtDef::IdeoLeaderResentmentAbhorren.label: led by an outsider's faith
ThoughtDef::IdeoLeaderResentmentAbhorren.description: Taking orders from someone who doesn't believe what I believe - that's about as low as it gets. Every command out of their mouth grates on me.

ThoughtDef::IdeoLeaderResentmentDisappro.label: led by an outsider's faith
ThoughtDef::IdeoLeaderResentmentDisappro.description: Our leader doesn't believe what I believe. Doesn't feel right taking their orders, even when they're good ones.

ThoughtDef::IdeoLeaderResentmentHorrible.label: led by an outsider's faith
ThoughtDef::IdeoLeaderResentmentHorrible.description: Taking orders from someone whose faith isn't mine is humiliating. I follow because I have to, not because I want to.

ThoughtDef::IdeoLeaderResentmentStandard.label: led by an outsider's faith
ThoughtDef::IdeoLeaderResentmentStandard.description: Our leader believes something different than I do. Not the end of the world, but I notice it every time they give an order.

ThoughtDef::IdeoRoleEmpty.label: no {ROLE_label}
ThoughtDef::IdeoRoleEmpty.description: Every {0} needs {ROLE_labelIndef} watching over them, and we don't have one. That gap doesn't sit right with me.

ThoughtDef::IdeoRoleLost.label: lost my {ROLE_label} role
ThoughtDef::IdeoRoleLost.description: I used to serve this crew as {ROLE_labelDef}, and now I don't. Feels like I lost a piece of who I am.

ThoughtDef::InnocentPrisonerDied_Know_Ab.label: an innocent died in chains
ThoughtDef::InnocentPrisonerDied_Know_Ab.description: One of our prisoners died and they'd done nothing to deserve it. If we wanted them dead we should've had the nerve to do it clean, not let them rot.

ThoughtDef::InstalledOrgan_Abhorrent.label: grafted in an organ
ThoughtDef::InstalledOrgan_Abhorrent.description: I put someone else's organ into another body. My faith says the body is sacred and untouchable, and I broke that rule with my own hands.

ThoughtDef::InstalledOrgan_Know_Abhorren.label: grafted in an organ
ThoughtDef::InstalledOrgan_Know_Abhorren.description: Someone here cut a person open and put a stranger's organ inside them. I can't unsee that.

ThoughtDef::InstalledOrgan_Know_Abhorren.label: an organ was grafted
ThoughtDef::InstalledOrgan_Know_Abhorren.description: Somebody on this crew cut a person open and put another's organ inside them. The body's supposed to be untouchable, and now it isn't.

ThoughtDef::InstalledProsthetic_Abhorren.label: grafted in chrome
ThoughtDef::InstalledProsthetic_Abhorren.description: I wired machine parts into someone's body with my own hands. My faith calls that a violation, and I felt every bit of it while I did it.

ThoughtDef::InstalledProsthetic_Disappro.label: grafted in chrome
ThoughtDef::InstalledProsthetic_Disappro.description: I had to wire machine parts into someone's body. It's against what I believe, plain and simple.

ThoughtDef::InstalledProsthetic_Know_Abh.label: chrome grafted onto them
ThoughtDef::InstalledProsthetic_Know_Abh.description: Someone on this crew put machine parts into another person's body. I can't say I approve.

ThoughtDef::InstalledProsthetic_Know_Dis.label: chrome grafted onto them
ThoughtDef::InstalledProsthetic_Know_Dis.description: Someone here wired machine into another person's body. It's not how I'd have done it.

ThoughtDef::IsApostate_Abhorrent_Social.label: turned from the faith
ThoughtDef::IsApostate_Abhorrent_Social.description: They walked away from the truth we all share. I can barely stand looking at them now.

ThoughtDef::IsApostate_Disapproved_Socia.label: turned from the faith
ThoughtDef::IsApostate_Disapproved_Socia.description: They left the beliefs we're supposed to share. Doesn't sit right with me, even if I understand why they did it.

ThoughtDef::IsApostate_Horrible_Social.label: turned from the faith
ThoughtDef::IsApostate_Horrible_Social.description: They gave up the truth the rest of us still hold to. Every time I see them I remember that, and it sours the day.

ThoughtDef::KillWithNobleWeapon.label: victory with an honored blade
ThoughtDef::KillWithNobleWeapon.description: I took them down with a weapon my faith calls noble, not some scavenged junk-gun. Feels like the kill actually meant something.

ThoughtDef::LookChangeDesired.label: don't look like myself
ThoughtDef::LookChangeDesired.description: The face and body I'm wearing don't match who I've become out here. I want to change it before it starts bothering me more than it already does.

ThoughtDef::Lovin_Know_Abhorrent.label: a lustful act, right here
ThoughtDef::Lovin_Know_Abhorrent.description: I saw what they were doing and it goes against everything I believe about restraint. I wish I hadn't seen it.

ThoughtDef::Lovin_Know_Approved.label: lovin' afterglow
ThoughtDef::Lovin_Know_Approved.description: Word's gotten around about last night, and good for them. My faith says there's nothing to be ashamed of in that.

ThoughtDef::Lovin_Know_Disapproved.label: an act of desire, nearby
ThoughtDef::Lovin_Know_Disapproved.description: I know what they got up to last night. Not my business, but it's not exactly to my taste either.

ThoughtDef::Lovin_Know_Horrible.label: a lustful act, right here
ThoughtDef::Lovin_Know_Horrible.description: Everyone on this crew knows what they did. My faith has strong words about that kind of thing, and I can't help agreeing.

ThoughtDef::MasochistWearingBodyStrap.label: the straps feel right
