ThoughtDef::MasochistWearingBodyStrap.description: The body strap digs in tight and it settles something in me. Most people wouldn't understand, but the ache is almost peaceful.

ThoughtDef::MasterfulConversion.label: a masterful conversion
ThoughtDef::MasterfulConversion.description: I watched someone's old faith crumble and the truth take its place, clean and total. Nobody walked away from that unconvinced.

ThoughtDef::Mined_Disapproved.label: cut into the ground
ThoughtDef::Mined_Disapproved.description: I had to dig a hole in the earth for scrap. My faith doesn't hold with tearing the world open like that.

ThoughtDef::Mined_Horrible.label: cut into the ground
ThoughtDef::Mined_Horrible.description: I tore open the earth looking for scrap. Every swing of that pick felt like an offense against something bigger than me.

ThoughtDef::Mined_Know_Disapproved.label: the ground was cut open
ThoughtDef::Mined_Know_Disapproved.description: Someone on this crew dug a hole in the earth. I don't hold with that kind of thing.

ThoughtDef::Mined_Know_Horrible.label: the ground was cut open
ThoughtDef::Mined_Know_Horrible.description: Someone here tore the earth open for scrap. It's an offense my faith doesn't forgive easily.

ThoughtDef::Mined_Know_Horrible_Mood.label: the earth was violated
ThoughtDef::Mined_Know_Horrible_Mood.description: Somebody on this crew dug a hole straight into untouched ground. My faith calls the earth sacred, and now there's a wound in it that wasn't there before.

ThoughtDef::Mined_Know_Prohibited.label: the ground was cut open
ThoughtDef::Mined_Know_Prohibited.description: Someone here broke the ground open. My faith forbids it outright, and I can't look past that.

ThoughtDef::Mined_Know_Prohibited_Mood.label: the earth was violated
ThoughtDef::Mined_Know_Prohibited_Mood.description: We cut a hole straight into ground that was never meant to be touched. My faith forbids this, no exceptions, and we did it anyway.

ThoughtDef::NeedNeuralSupercharge.label: want the overclock
ThoughtDef::NeedNeuralSupercharge.description: Without the neural boost wired into my skull doing its job, I'm running slower than I should be. It's a small thing, but it drags on me.

ThoughtDef::NoRecentHumanMeat_Preferred.label: craving real meat
ThoughtDef::NoRecentHumanMeat_Preferred.description: It's been a while since I ate flesh cut from one of the free peoples. My gut knows it's been too long, and it's starting to bother me.

ThoughtDef::NoRecentHumanMeat_RequiredRa.label: starving for real meat
ThoughtDef::NoRecentHumanMeat_RequiredRa.description: I haven't tasted true flesh in far too long and my whole body knows it. This isn't hunger anymore, it's something closer to desperation.

ThoughtDef::NoRecentHumanMeat_RequiredSt.label: craving real meat
ThoughtDef::NoRecentHumanMeat_RequiredSt.description: It's been far too long since I ate flesh cut from one of the free peoples. I should have eaten by now, and going without is starting to eat at me.

ThoughtDef::ObservedGibbetCage.label: saw a gibbet cage
ThoughtDef::ObservedGibbetCage.description: There's a body left hanging out in a cage for everyone to see. I didn't need to look, but I did, and now I can't stop thinking about it.

ThoughtDef::ObservedSkullspike.label: saw a skullspike
ThoughtDef::ObservedSkullspike.description: Somebody put a skull up on a spike where the whole crew has to walk past it. It's a hard thing to un-see.

ThoughtDef::ObservedTerror.label: {THING_label}
ThoughtDef::ObservedTerror.description: Whatever that thing is, my body knew before my mind did that something was deeply wrong with it. I still feel it crawling under my skin.

ThoughtDef::ParticipatedInRaid_Required.label: rode with the raid
ThoughtDef::ParticipatedInRaid_Required.description: I was out there with the crew hitting another camp. Now everyone will know my name for it, and that's exactly how I wanted it.

ThoughtDef::ParticipatedInRaid_Respected.label: rode with the raid
ThoughtDef::ParticipatedInRaid_Respected.description: I rode out with the crew and we hit another camp hard. That's how we've always done things, and I'm proud to have been part of it.

ThoughtDef::PsychicArchotechEmanator_Cor.label: the machine's true scale
ThoughtDef::PsychicArchotechEmanator_Cor.description: Something ancient and vast is speaking through the structure, and for a moment there's no me and no them, just the whole of it at once. I don't know if I'm losing myself or finally seeing straight.

ThoughtDef::PsychicArchotechEmanator_Gra.label: voices from the deep signal
ThoughtDef::PsychicArchotechEmanator_Gra.description: The structure shows me too much - every mind out there speaking and dying and starting over all at once. It's all I can do to hold onto who I am while it plays through me.

ThoughtDef::PsychicArchotechEmanator_Maj.label: voices from the deep signal
ThoughtDef::PsychicArchotechEmanator_Maj.description: Something in that structure is putting thoughts in my head that aren't mine, opening onto something huge. It makes me feel very small and very far from home.

ThoughtDef::RecentConquest_Required.label: we struck and won
ThoughtDef::RecentConquest_Required.description: We hit another crew hard and took what we came for. Let their suffering be the lesson - out here, that's how respect gets earned.

ThoughtDef::RecentConquest_Respected.label: we struck and won
ThoughtDef::RecentConquest_Respected.description: We raided another camp not long ago and came out on top. That's one more crew that knows better than to cross us.

ThoughtDef::RelicAtRitual.label: {RELICNAME} at the rite
ThoughtDef::RelicAtRitual.description: We had {RELICNAME} in the room during the ritual, right where everyone could see it. Having something that real close by made the whole thing feel true.

ThoughtDef::RelicDestroyed.label: the relic is gone
ThoughtDef::RelicDestroyed.description: The relic's been smashed to nothing. That was a piece of who we are, and now it's just scrap and dust.

ThoughtDef::RelicLost.label: we lost the relic
ThoughtDef::RelicLost.description: The relic's gone missing, and I don't know if we're getting it back. Feels like we misplaced a piece of ourselves.

ThoughtDef::RelicsCollected.label: every relic recovered
ThoughtDef::RelicsCollected.description: We finally have every sacred relic back in our hands, all of them. It feels like the crew is whole again.

ThoughtDef::SatisfyingBlinding.label: a clean blinding
ThoughtDef::SatisfyingBlinding.description: That blinding went exactly how it should have. Quick, deep, done right - there's a satisfaction in a ritual performed well, even one like that.

ThoughtDef::SatisfyingExecution.label: a clean execution
ThoughtDef::SatisfyingExecution.description: That execution went exactly the way it should have. Felt like real justice got handed out, not just another killing.

ThoughtDef::SatisfyingSacrifice.label: a proper sacrifice
ThoughtDef::SatisfyingSacrifice.description: That sacrifice was done right - clean hands, right amount of blood, nothing wasted. It felt like it actually meant something.

ThoughtDef::Skullspike_Desired.label: strength on display
ThoughtDef::Skullspike_Desired.description: I've walked past our skullspikes a few times now, and every one of them reminds me that this crew isn't to be messed with. I like the reminder.

ThoughtDef::Slavery_Abhorrent_SlavesInCo.label: we're keeping slaves
ThoughtDef::Slavery_Abhorrent_SlavesInCo.description: We've got people in chains here, and my faith calls that barbaric. I hate that I'm part of a crew that does this.

ThoughtDef::Slavery_Disapproved_SlavesIn.label: we're keeping slaves
ThoughtDef::Slavery_Disapproved_SlavesIn.description: We keep people in chains here. Maybe it's necessary out in this sand, but I still don't like it.

ThoughtDef::Slavery_Honorable_NoSlavesIn.label: no slaves, no respect
ThoughtDef::Slavery_Honorable_NoSlavesIn.description: A crew with no one in chains doesn't get taken seriously out here. Without slaves working under us, nobody thinks twice about crossing us.

ThoughtDef::Slavery_Honorable_SlavesInCo.label: slaves in chains
ThoughtDef::Slavery_Honorable_SlavesInCo.description: We've got people working under the chain, same as any crew worth respecting. It tells me we're doing this right.

ThoughtDef::Slavery_Horrible_SlavesInCol.label: we're keeping slaves
ThoughtDef::Slavery_Horrible_SlavesInCol.description: There are people in chains on this crew, and it's wrong. Every day it goes on I feel worse about being part of it.

ThoughtDef::SoldOrgan_Disapproved.label: sold an organ
ThoughtDef::SoldOrgan_Disapproved.description: I had to sell an organ cut from someone's body. I don't like that kind of trade, and I did it anyway.

ThoughtDef::SoldOrgan_Know_Disapproved.label: an organ got sold
ThoughtDef::SoldOrgan_Know_Disapproved.description: Someone here sold an organ cut out of a person. Not the kind of deal I'd have made.

ThoughtDef::SoldSlave_Disapproved.label: sold someone off
ThoughtDef::SoldSlave_Disapproved.description: I sold a person into someone else's chains. I hope whoever bought them treats them better than I'm expecting.

ThoughtDef::SoldSlave_Honorable.label: sold someone off
ThoughtDef::SoldSlave_Honorable.description: I sold a person into chains, and word of that deal will get around. My faith says that's the kind of trade that builds a name.

ThoughtDef::SoldSlave_Horrible.label: sold someone off
ThoughtDef::SoldSlave_Horrible.description: I sold a person into another crew's chains. I'm not sure that's something I get to forgive myself for.

ThoughtDef::SoldSlave_Know_Abhorrent.label: a person was sold off
ThoughtDef::SoldSlave_Know_Abhorrent.description: Someone on this crew sold a person into chains. It turns my stomach that we did that.

ThoughtDef::SoldSlave_Know_Abhorrent_Moo.label: we sold a person off
ThoughtDef::SoldSlave_Know_Abhorrent_Moo.description: We sold a person into someone else's chains, and I was part of the crew that did it. It's about as low as this outfit has ever gone.

ThoughtDef::SoldSlave_Know_Disapproved.label: a person was sold off
ThoughtDef::SoldSlave_Know_Disapproved.description: Someone here sold a person into chains. Not a trade I'd have made myself.

ThoughtDef::SoldSlave_Know_Disapproved_M.label: we sold a person off
ThoughtDef::SoldSlave_Know_Disapproved_M.description: We sold a person into another crew's chains for the credits. I don't think it was the right call.

ThoughtDef::SoldSlave_Know_Honorable.label: a person was sold off
ThoughtDef::SoldSlave_Know_Honorable.description: Someone on this crew sold a person into chains and did well out of the deal. Says something about how this crew handles business.

ThoughtDef::SoldSlave_Know_Honorable_Moo.label: we sold a person off
ThoughtDef::SoldSlave_Know_Honorable_Moo.description: We sold a person into chains and got a good price for it. Word of a deal like that will travel, and it'll travel in our favor.

ThoughtDef::SoldSlave_Know_Horrible.label: a person was sold off
ThoughtDef::SoldSlave_Know_Horrible.description: Someone on this crew sold a person into chains. It's a hard thing to shake off.

ThoughtDef::SoldSlave_Know_Horrible_Mood.label: we sold a person off
ThoughtDef::SoldSlave_Know_Horrible_Mood.description: We sold a person into another crew's chains. It was a horrible thing to do, and I keep thinking about it.

ThoughtDef::SpectacularExecution.label: an electrifying execution
ThoughtDef::SpectacularExecution.description: That execution had the whole crowd on its feet. I've never felt justice hit that hard before.

ThoughtDef::SpectacularSacrifice.label: a sacrifice to remember
ThoughtDef::SpectacularSacrifice.description: The blood, the release, the whole crew feeling it at once - that sacrifice felt like it opened a door to something bigger than this world.

ThoughtDef::TendedByMedicalSpecialist.label: healed by the marked
ThoughtDef::TendedByMedicalSpecialist.description: The one who tended me carries the healer's mark of our faith. There's a comfort in that, knowing the hands fixing me up believe what I believe.

ThoughtDef::TerribleBlinding.label: a botched blinding
ThoughtDef::TerribleBlinding.description: That blinding went wrong from start to finish. Whole thing felt clumsy and awkward when it was supposed to mean something.

ThoughtDef::TerribleDuel.label: a shameful duel
ThoughtDef::TerribleDuel.description: That duel was an embarrassment. I'm still cringing thinking about how badly it went.

ThoughtDef::TerribleFestival.label: a miserable festival
ThoughtDef::TerribleFestival.description: That festival was a mess start to finish. I keep replaying the worst parts of it in my head.

ThoughtDef::TerribleFuneral.label: a disgraceful funeral
ThoughtDef::TerribleFuneral.description: That funeral was borderline insulting to everyone who showed up for it. Whoever ran it should be ashamed.

ThoughtDef::TerribleParty.label: a terrible party
ThoughtDef::TerribleParty.description: That party was bad from the first hour. Sour music, worse dancing - I couldn't wait for it to end.

ThoughtDef::TerribleSkyLanterns.label: a wasted skylantern rite
ThoughtDef::TerribleSkyLanterns.description: I hated putting that lantern together, and it looked like junk once it was in the air. Whole thing felt like wasted effort.

ThoughtDef::TreesDesired.label: the trees astonish me
ThoughtDef::TreesDesired.description: I'm standing near real trees, huge and green and alive, and it still stops me cold. Out here, that's about as close to a miracle as I get.

ThoughtDef::TrialConvicted.label: convicted unjustly
ThoughtDef::TrialConvicted.description: I was found guilty of something I never did, and it's going to follow me now. Doesn't matter how loud I say it - nobody's listening.

ThoughtDef::TrialExonerated.label: cleared at trial
ThoughtDef::TrialExonerated.description: They had nothing on me and I made sure everyone knew it. Walking away clean feels better than I expected.

ThoughtDef::TrialFailed.label: a failed accusation
ThoughtDef::TrialFailed.description: I stood up and made an accusation, and it didn't stick. Standing there while it fell apart in front of everyone was humiliating.

ThoughtDef::UnforgettableDuel.label: a duel to remember
ThoughtDef::UnforgettableDuel.description: The nerve, the blood, the moment it was decided - I don't think I'll ever forget watching that duel play out.

ThoughtDef::UnforgettableFestival.label: a festival to remember
ThoughtDef::UnforgettableFestival.description: That festival is one I'll be telling stories about for years. Everything about it just worked.

ThoughtDef::UnforgettableParty.label: a party to remember
ThoughtDef::UnforgettableParty.description: That party was perfect start to finish - the music, the mood, all of it. I haven't felt that good in a long time.

ThoughtDef::UnforgettableSkyLanterns.label: lanterns against the dusk
ThoughtDef::UnforgettableSkyLanterns.description: Building those lanterns together, then watching them go up and drift off into the dark - it felt like my worries went with them. I won't forget that.

ThoughtDef::UnimpressiveSkyLanterns.label: unimpressive skylanterns
ThoughtDef::UnimpressiveSkyLanterns.description: Those lanterns didn't do a thing for me. Felt like scrap and hours burned for nothing.

ThoughtDef::WasEnslaved.label: I was enslaved
ThoughtDef::WasEnslaved.description: They put me in chains and made me suffer for it. That's not something I forget easily, if I ever do.

ThoughtDef::WearingColor_Favorite.label: wearing my color
ThoughtDef::WearingColor_Favorite.description: I picked this color out for a reason, and putting it on still does something for me. Small thing, but it's mine.

ThoughtDef::WearingColor_Ideo.label: dressed in the faith's colors
ThoughtDef::WearingColor_Ideo.description: My gear's colored the way my faith says it should be. It's a small thing, but it feels like walking around wearing what I believe.

ThoughtDef::WearingDesiredApparel_Soft.label: wearing {APPAREL}
ThoughtDef::WearingDesiredApparel_Soft.description: I'm wearing {APPAREL}, same as my faith asks of me. It's a small comfort, knowing I'm dressed the way I'm supposed to be.

ThoughtDef::WearingDesiredApparel_Strong.label: wearing {APPAREL}
ThoughtDef::WearingDesiredApparel_Strong.description: I'm wearing {APPAREL}, exactly the way my faith calls for. It feels good, knowing I'm doing this one right.

ThoughtDef::WieldingNobleOrDespisedWeapo.label: wielding {WEAPON}
ThoughtDef::WieldingNobleOrDespisedWeapo.description: This {WEAPON} in my hands means something to my faith - I can feel it every time I swing it, whether that feeling is pride or shame.

ThoughtDef::WillDiminished.label: something in me is dimmer
ThoughtDef::WillDiminished.description: Whatever gives my will its edge feels duller than it used to. I can't point to why, just that it's not all there anymore.

ThoughtDef::VCE_AteChocolate_Craved.label: got my chocolate fix
ThoughtDef::VCE_AteChocolate_Craved.description: Real chocolate, not the ration-bar approximation. I've been dreaming about this since the last stash ran dry.

ThoughtDef::VCE_AteFineDessert_Craved.label: fine dessert, craved
ThoughtDef::VCE_AteFineDessert_Craved.description: That was sweet and rich enough to make me forget where I am for a minute. I want another plate right now.

ThoughtDef::VCE_AteGourmetDessert_Craved.label: gourmet dessert, craved
ThoughtDef::VCE_AteGourmetDessert_Craved.description: Layers of sugar and spice I didn't know a kitchen out here could manage. My mouth is still watering and I want it again, now.

ThoughtDef::VCE_AteLavishDessert_Craved.label: lavish dessert, craved
ThoughtDef::VCE_AteLavishDessert_Craved.description: That dessert was so good I ate it slow just to make it last, and it still wasn't enough. I need another helping.

ThoughtDef::VCE_AteSimpleDessert_Craved.label: simple dessert, craved
ThoughtDef::VCE_AteSimpleDessert_Craved.description: Nothing fancy, just something sweet after ration paste, and I'm already thinking about the next bite.

ThoughtDef::VME_AccursedIncantation.label: accursed chanting
ThoughtDef::VME_AccursedIncantation.description: Somebody stood at the fire and recited a litany of crime and rot dressed up as wisdom. I still feel it crawling under my hood.

ThoughtDef::VME_Alcohol_Demanded.label: need a drink, bad
ThoughtDef::VME_Alcohol_Demanded.description: My throat's dry and my hands won't settle. I'd trade good scrap for one swallow of anything that burns going down.

ThoughtDef::VME_Alcohol_Desired.label: missing a drink
ThoughtDef::VME_Alcohol_Desired.description: It's been a while since I shared a bottle with the crew. A still and a few mugs around the fire would do this camp good.

ThoughtDef::VME_Alcohol_MildAbstinence.label: had a little drink
ThoughtDef::VME_Alcohol_MildAbstinence.description: Just a swallow of the still-brew, nothing serious. Still, my head's a bit soft and I know I'll pay for it come dawn watch.

ThoughtDef::VME_AmazingSlaveEmancipation.label: an emancipation for the ages
ThoughtDef::VME_AmazingSlaveEmancipation.description: Our leader stood over the broken chains and every word landed true. Whoever heard that speech is going to be telling it to their grandkids.

ThoughtDef::VME_AteAnimalProducts_Abhorr.label: ate animal flesh
ThoughtDef::VME_AteAnimalProducts_Abhorr.description: I had to eat something that came off a living creature we penned up and used. Out here that's a line I don't like crossing.

ThoughtDef::VME_AteAnimalProducts_Know_A.label: word got out
ThoughtDef::VME_AteAnimalProducts_Know_A.description: Everyone knows I ate animal flesh now. I don't need the looks, I already feel bad enough about it.

ThoughtDef::VME_AteInsectJellyDirect.label: ate hive jelly
ThoughtDef::VME_AteInsectJellyDirect.description: Scooped some jelly straight from a busted hive comb. Not bad, actually — sweeter than I expected.

ThoughtDef::VME_AteInsectJellyDirect_Des.label: ate that hive jelly
ThoughtDef::VME_AteInsectJellyDirect_Des.description: Something gave me hive jelly to eat and I choked it down. Foul stuff, and I can still taste it.

ThoughtDef::VME_AteInsectJellyDirect_Lov.label: hive jelly, glorious
ThoughtDef::VME_AteInsectJellyDirect_Lov.description: That jelly straight off the comb is the finest thing I've eaten in a season. Whatever made it, I'd follow the swarm myself for more.

ThoughtDef::VME_AteInsectMeatAsIngredien.label: ate hidden bug meat
ThoughtDef::VME_AteInsectMeatAsIngredien.description: There was hive meat mixed into that stew and nobody told me until after. I know it's just protein, but I still wish I hadn't found out.

ThoughtDef::VME_AteInsectMeat_Sacrilegio.label: ate bug meat
ThoughtDef::VME_AteInsectMeat_Sacrilegio.description: I ate meat carved straight off a hive-thing, no hiding it in a stew this time. Why did I let myself do that?

ThoughtDef::VME_AttendedParty.label: went to a good party
ThoughtDef::VME_AttendedParty.description: Music, drink, everyone loosening up for once. I had a genuinely good time.

ThoughtDef::VME_Aurora_Amazing.label: the sky lit up
ThoughtDef::VME_Aurora_Amazing.description: Color bled clear across the whole night sky, green and violet over the dunes. I stood out there longer than I should have, just watching.

ThoughtDef::VME_Aurora_Despised.label: that awful sky-glow
ThoughtDef::VME_Aurora_Despised.description: The lights overhead won't stop crawling around up there and it's setting my teeth on edge. Unnatural, whatever it is.

ThoughtDef::VME_AutonomousWeapons_Accept.label: trust the auto-turrets
ThoughtDef::VME_AutonomousWeapons_Accept.description: We've got gun-droids covering the perimeter now. One less watch shift for the rest of us, and I'm not complaining.

ThoughtDef::VME_AutonomousWeapons_Exalte.label: the turrets never sleep
ThoughtDef::VME_AutonomousWeapons_Exalte.description: Automated guns hold this camp better than any tired sentry could. A clan that doesn't lean on machines for its defense is asking to get raided.

ThoughtDef::VME_AwkwardInsectoidHymn.label: that hive-hymn fell flat
ThoughtDef::VME_AwkwardInsectoidHymn.description: The chanting dragged on and never once made me believe there's anything holy about a hive. Mostly I was just waiting for it to end.

ThoughtDef::VME_AwkwardOrgy.label: that gathering went nowhere
ThoughtDef::VME_AwkwardOrgy.description: Everybody just sat around half-undressed, nobody sure what came next. More embarrassing than anything.

ThoughtDef::VME_AwkwardViolentConversion.label: unconvincing conversion
ThoughtDef::VME_AwkwardViolentConversion.description: Somebody tried to talk a captive into our ways at knifepoint and fumbled every line. Neither of us believed a word of it.

ThoughtDef::VME_BlasphemousIncantation.label: blasphemous chanting
ThoughtDef::VME_BlasphemousIncantation.description: Whoever led that chant spoke of things buried deep that were never meant to wake. I keep glancing at the dark past the firelight now.

ThoughtDef::VME_BookQuality_Desired.label: we've got a real data-slate
ThoughtDef::VME_BookQuality_Desired.description: There's a genuinely rare old text stored in camp now. Knowledge like that is worth more than most of what we haul out of the wrecks.

ThoughtDef::VME_BoringCeremonialSuicide.label: that blade-rite was flat
ThoughtDef::VME_BoringCeremonialSuicide.description: The words felt forced and nobody's heart was really in it. At least the honor's paid back, for whatever that's worth.

ThoughtDef::VME_BoringLeadershipChalleng.label: dull leadership fight
ThoughtDef::VME_BoringLeadershipChalleng.description: Neither of them really committed, so it was mostly circling and posturing. We know who's strongest, I guess, but nobody felt much.

ThoughtDef::VME_BoringPlagueFestival.label: flat plague rite
ThoughtDef::VME_BoringPlagueFestival.description: The killing was clumsy and the whole thing dragged. Still, the blessed sickness is loose among us now, so it did its job.

ThoughtDef::VME_BoughtSlave_Know_Forbidd.label: we bought a slave
ThoughtDef::VME_BoughtSlave_Know_Forbidd.description: We paid coin to wicked traders for another person like they were cargo. I don't like what that says about us.

ThoughtDef::VME_CheapTradingFair.label: we skimped on the fair
ThoughtDef::VME_CheapTradingFair.description: We threw together a trading fair without spending a single credit on it. Word gets around when a clan's that stingy.

ThoughtDef::VME_Darklight_DislikeDarknes.label: hate the dark
ThoughtDef::VME_Darklight_DislikeDarknes.description: No light at all down here, and it's wrong. My eyes keep straining for something that isn't there.

ThoughtDef::VME_Darklight_NormalPreferre.label: this dim glow's unnatural
ThoughtDef::VME_Darklight_NormalPreferre.description: It's not real light and it's not real dark, just some half-lit nothing that doesn't sit right with me.

ThoughtDef::VME_Death_Troubling.label: death, close by
ThoughtDef::VME_Death_Troubling.description: I know everyone dies out here eventually, water and luck both run out. Doesn't mean I like being made to think about it.

ThoughtDef::VME_Defeat_Dishonorable.label: beaten in a fight
ThoughtDef::VME_Defeat_Dishonorable.description: I went down in a fight I should have won. That's a mark against me the whole crew saw.

ThoughtDef::VME_DemagogicSlaveEmancipati.label: that emancipation backfired
ThoughtDef::VME_DemagogicSlaveEmancipati.description: The speech played us up as the villains of our own story. Nobody's going to want to throw in with a clan that looks like that.

ThoughtDef::VME_DumbLabor_Disliked.label: stuck on grunt work
ThoughtDef::VME_DumbLabor_Disliked.description: Hauling and digging, nothing that takes a brain. It wore me out for nothing.

ThoughtDef::VME_DumbLabor_Exalted.label: proud of the grunt work
ThoughtDef::VME_DumbLabor_Exalted.description: I hauled and dug like everyone else today, no better and no worse. That's exactly the kind of clan-member I want to be.

ThoughtDef::VME_DumbLabor_Horrible.label: hated that grunt work
ThoughtDef::VME_DumbLabor_Horrible.description: Hours of hauling scrap with no thought involved at all. I don't want to do that again.

ThoughtDef::VME_DumbLabor_Liked.label: decent honest labor
ThoughtDef::VME_DumbLabor_Liked.description: Worked up a real sweat hauling and digging today. Simple work, but it was honest.

ThoughtDef::VME_Eclipse_Despised.label: that eclipse spooked me
ThoughtDef::VME_Eclipse_Despised.description: The suns just went dark for no reason I understand. I don't like it when the sky stops making sense.

ThoughtDef::VME_Elders_Despised.label: stuck near an elder
ThoughtDef::VME_Elders_Despised.description: There's a graybeard in camp everyone defers to just for having lasted this long. I don't see what age has to do with anything.

ThoughtDef::VME_Elders_Holy.label: in the presence of an elder
ThoughtDef::VME_Elders_Holy.description: An elder walks among us, carrying more seasons of sand than the rest of the clan combined. Being near that kind of endurance feels like a blessing.

ThoughtDef::VME_Elders_Respected.label: an elder's nearby
ThoughtDef::VME_Elders_Respected.description: One of the old ones is close by, the kind who's outlasted three generations of scrap runs. I feel a little steadier having them around.

ThoughtDef::VME_EnforcedCompliance.label: forced to smile about it
ThoughtDef::VME_EnforcedCompliance.description: Somebody got made an example of for not being cheerful enough. I need to be positive. I NEED TO.

ThoughtDef::VME_EntrancingInsectoidHymn.label: that hive-hymn got under my skin
ThoughtDef::VME_EntrancingInsectoidHymn.description: The chant is still looping in my head, like a thousand little legs moving in rhythm across my arms. I can't tell if it's beautiful or just unsettling, but I want to hear it again.

ThoughtDef::VME_ExhilaratingOrgy.label: unforgettable night together
ThoughtDef::VME_ExhilaratingOrgy.description: Masks on, nothing else, the whole camp lost itself for a while. My body's still humming from it.

ThoughtDef::VME_Fire_Desired.label: missing open flame
ThoughtDef::VME_Fire_Desired.description: It's been too long since I've watched a real fire burn. I keep thinking about the last one we lit.

ThoughtDef::VME_Fire_Despised.label: too much fire around
ThoughtDef::VME_Fire_Despised.description: There's flame nearby again and it puts me on edge every time. I'd rather not look at it.

ThoughtDef::VME_Firefighting_Abhorrent.label: had to fight a fire
ThoughtDef::VME_Firefighting_Abhorrent.description: I beat down flames I would've rather let burn. Hated every second of it.

ThoughtDef::VME_Firefighting_Preferred.label: put out a fire, proud of it
ThoughtDef::VME_Firefighting_Preferred.description: Got the flames down before they could spread. Felt good doing something that mattered.

ThoughtDef::VME_FreethinkingSlaveEmancip.label: a clear-headed emancipation
ThoughtDef::VME_FreethinkingSlaveEmancip.description: Our leader laid out every evil of slavery plain and short, no wasted words. Hard to argue with a speech that clean.

ThoughtDef::VME_GloriousBonfire.label: glorious bonfire
ThoughtDef::VME_GloriousBonfire.description: The whole crew crowded round that fire and for once nobody was watching the horizon. We were just people, together, for a night.

ThoughtDef::VME_GloriousWickerManBurning.label: the wicker man burned bright
ThoughtDef::VME_GloriousWickerManBurning.description: I'll remember the screaming rising with the flames for a long time. Another soul given to the fire, and it felt righteous.

ThoughtDef::VME_GoodBonfire.label: good bonfire
ThoughtDef::VME_GoodBonfire.description: Flames climbed high over the camp and it lifted everyone's mood a notch. Good night, simple as that.

ThoughtDef::VME_GoodLeadershipChallenge.label: solid leadership fight
ThoughtDef::VME_GoodLeadershipChallenge.description: Both fighters actually went for it, drew real blood, showed real nerve. Now we know for certain who's strongest.

ThoughtDef::VME_GoodWickerManBurning.label: the wicker man burned
ThoughtDef::VME_GoodWickerManBurning.description: The screaming stuck with me, another soul fed to the flames. It'll linger a while.

ThoughtDef::VME_GotSomeLovin.label: got some company last night
ThoughtDef::VME_GotSomeLovin.description: Nothing clears the head like sharing a bunk for an hour. Feeling better for it today.

ThoughtDef::VME_GrotesqueOrgy.label: that gathering was rough to look at
ThoughtDef::VME_GrotesqueOrgy.description: You picture something else entirely when people talk about a night like that. This was the opposite, and I can't unsee it.

ThoughtDef::VME_HasProsthetic_OnlyBiolog.label: carrying non-flesh parts
ThoughtDef::VME_HasProsthetic_OnlyBiolog.description: There's machine in me where there should only be meat and bone. Flesh should only ever be replaced with flesh.

ThoughtDef::VME_HasProsthetic_OnlyBiolog.label: everyone sees the chrome in me
ThoughtDef::VME_HasProsthetic_OnlyBiolog.description: They all know I'm carrying a part that isn't flesh. I catch the looks.

ThoughtDef::VME_HonorableCeremonialSuici.label: an honorable blade-rite
ThoughtDef::VME_HonorableCeremonialSuici.description: The blade was clean and the words were true. Whatever shame we were carrying, it's gone now.

ThoughtDef::VME_Hospital_Required.label: no proper med-bay
ThoughtDef::VME_Hospital_Required.description: We patch people up on whatever table's free, and it's not good enough. This camp needs a real place to treat the wounded.

ThoughtDef::VME_IdeoRole_FireKeeper.label: keeper of the flame
ThoughtDef::VME_IdeoRole_FireKeeper.description: Tending the sacred fire falls to me now, keeping it lit no matter the wind off the dunes. It's a duty I take seriously.

ThoughtDef::VME_Illness_Exalted.label: blessed with sickness
ThoughtDef::VME_Illness_Exalted.description: Something's breeding in my blood right now and I'm told that's a gift. I hope I catch something again soon.

ThoughtDef::VME_Illness_Preferred.label: sick, and not complaining
ThoughtDef::VME_Illness_Preferred.description: I'm laid up with something, and honestly, it's a decent excuse to rest for once.

ThoughtDef::VME_Insectoids_Despised.label: killed a hive-thing
ThoughtDef::VME_Insectoids_Despised.description: Put down one of those chittering things today. Good riddance.

ThoughtDef::VME_Insectoids_Exalted.label: killed a hive-thing
ThoughtDef::VME_Insectoids_Exalted.description: I ended one of the hive-kind today and it sits wrong with me. They're not supposed to be vermin, not to us.

ThoughtDef::VME_InstalledProsthetic_Know.label: everyone knows about my new part
ThoughtDef::VME_InstalledProsthetic_Know.description: Word's out that I had a machine part put in me. I don't need the reminder.

ThoughtDef::VME_InstalledProsthetic_Only.label: had to go chrome
ThoughtDef::VME_InstalledProsthetic_Only.description: Lost enough of myself that I needed a machine part put in to keep working. Flesh should only ever be replaced by flesh.

ThoughtDef::VME_Junk_Preferred.label: good junk pile nearby
ThoughtDef::VME_Junk_Preferred.description: There's real ancient scrap sitting around camp and I like having it close. You learn things picking through old tech nobody else bothered to save.

ThoughtDef::VME_KillingWithFire_Abhorren.label: watched someone burn
ThoughtDef::VME_KillingWithFire_Abhorren.description: I saw a person burned to death and it didn't need to happen that way. Nobody deserves that.

ThoughtDef::VME_KillingWithFire_Preferre.label: let the enemy burn
ThoughtDef::VME_KillingWithFire_Preferre.description: Watched our enemies go up in flame. Good. Let the fire do the talking.

ThoughtDef::VME_LacklusterBonfire.label: weak bonfire
ThoughtDef::VME_LacklusterBonfire.description: We wanted a real blaze and got an oversized cookfire instead. Mildly entertaining, nothing more.

ThoughtDef::VME_LacklusterWickerManBurni.label: that burning fell flat
ThoughtDef::VME_LacklusterWickerManBurni.description: The prisoner went too fast and the fire barely lifted anyone's spirits. Didn't feel like much of anything.

ThoughtDef::VME_Leader_Godlike.label: our leader, near-divine
ThoughtDef::VME_Leader_Godlike.description: The way the clan looks at our leader now, you'd think the suns rise on their word. I believe it more than I probably should.

ThoughtDef::VME_LeatherApparel_Abhorrent.label: wearing skinned hide
ThoughtDef::VME_LeatherApparel_Abhorrent.description: This apparel came off a living animal we killed for its skin. That's a cruelty I shouldn't be wearing.

ThoughtDef::VME_LeatherApparel_Disliked.label: wearing animal leather
ThoughtDef::VME_LeatherApparel_Disliked.description: I'm dressed in hide taken off a slaughtered animal. Would rather we didn't do that.

ThoughtDef::VME_LiberatingSlaveEmancipat.label: a masterful emancipation
ThoughtDef::VME_LiberatingSlaveEmancipat.description: Our leader tore the whole idea of slavery apart in front of everyone, and made freedom sound like the only sane choice. That's a speech that'll get repeated around fires for seasons.

ThoughtDef::VME_LoathsomeIncantation.label: loathsome chanting
ThoughtDef::VME_LoathsomeIncantation.description: Whatever was said at that fire made this whole desert feel small and watched. I wasn't meant to hear words like that.

ThoughtDef::VME_Mechanoids_Despised.label: took down a war-droid
ThoughtDef::VME_Mechanoids_Despised.description: Wrecked one of those killer machines today. Good scrap, and one less thing trying to kill us.

ThoughtDef::VME_Mechanoids_Exalted.label: destroyed a machine-being
ThoughtDef::VME_Mechanoids_Exalted.description: I put down one of the mechanoids today, and something about it feels like it'll come back on us. Machines like that aren't supposed to be enemies.

ThoughtDef::VME_Mood_DictatedByStars.label: the twin suns favor me
ThoughtDef::VME_Mood_DictatedByStars.description: Whatever's written in the sky tonight, it's written for me. I can feel my luck holding.

ThoughtDef::VME_Mood_HighExpectations.label: just feeling good
ThoughtDef::VME_Mood_HighExpectations.description: No particular reason, I'm just in a good mood today. This rock's not so bad when you're not looking for trouble.

ThoughtDef::VME_Mood_LowExpectations.label: just feeling low
ThoughtDef::VME_Mood_LowExpectations.description: No particular reason, I'm just in a bad mood today. This rock never lets you forget how hostile it is.

ThoughtDef::VME_Mood_Shared.label: feeling what the camp feels
ThoughtDef::VME_Mood_Shared.description: Whatever mood's moving through the crew right now, I'm carried right along with it. Right now, that means I'm up too.

ThoughtDef::VME_NeedAnonymity.label: too exposed
ThoughtDef::VME_NeedAnonymity.description: Everyone knows my business now, nothing held back. I feel like I'm standing in the open with no cover.

ThoughtDef::VME_NeedSweets.label: craving something sweet
ThoughtDef::VME_NeedSweets.description: I'd trade good scrap for a single piece of real dessert right now. It's getting ridiculous how much I want it.

ThoughtDef::VME_ParticipatedInRaid_Abhor.label: took part in a raid
ThoughtDef::VME_ParticipatedInRaid_Abhor.description: I helped raid another camp today. How did I let myself do that? I'm ashamed of it.

ThoughtDef::VME_ParticipatedInRaid_Honor.label: took part in a raid
ThoughtDef::VME_ParticipatedInRaid_Honor.description: I helped raid another camp today. Taking what we need by force brings honor to this clan.

ThoughtDef::VME_PermanentBases_Desired.label: our settlement's something real
ThoughtDef::VME_PermanentBases_Desired.description: Look at what we've built here, proper walls and proper buildings. This is what a clan can become when it stops wandering.

ThoughtDef::VME_PermanentBases_Despised.label: we've stayed too long
ThoughtDef::VME_PermanentBases_Despised.description: We've been parked in one spot for too many days now. Time to load the crawler and move on.

ThoughtDef::VME_PoorlyOrganizedTradingFa.label: botched trading fair
ThoughtDef::VME_PoorlyOrganizedTradingFa.description: That fair was thrown together badly and it showed. No caravan's coming back for that.

ThoughtDef::VME_Power_Desired.label: feeling important
ThoughtDef::VME_Power_Desired.description: People are looking to me for once, listening when I talk. I could get used to this.

ThoughtDef::VME_Power_Exalted.label: ruling like something divine
ThoughtDef::VME_Power_Exalted.description: My word moves this whole clan now, and it's starting to feel like more than just leadership. Like something closer to a god's word.

ThoughtDef::VME_Power_Preferred.label: reasonably important
ThoughtDef::VME_Power_Preferred.description: I've got a little standing in this camp these days. Not bad.

ThoughtDef::VME_Ranching_Disliked.label: penning up animals, wrong
ThoughtDef::VME_Ranching_Disliked.description: There's a pen holding animals captive in this camp and I don't like walking past it. Keeping a creature locked up just to use it isn't right.

ThoughtDef::VME_Ranching_Disliked_Attack.label: had to hurt an animal
ThoughtDef::VME_Ranching_Disliked_Attack.description: I had to strike an animal today and it didn't sit well with me. Wish there'd been another way.

ThoughtDef::VME_Ranching_Disliked_SowedP.label: planted food, clean conscience
ThoughtDef::VME_Ranching_Disliked_SowedP.description: Put seed in the ground for human food today, nothing that had to suffer for it. That's the kind of work I don't mind.

ThoughtDef::VME_RecentConquest_Abhorrent.label: we raided again
ThoughtDef::VME_RecentConquest_Abhorrent.description: We hit another faction not long ago and it still sits ugly with me. This clan should be better than that.

ThoughtDef::VME_RecentConquest_Honorable.label: we raided again
ThoughtDef::VME_RecentConquest_Honorable.description: We hit another faction not long ago, and that's exactly the kind of conquest that earns a clan respect.

ThoughtDef::VME_Recreation_Disapproved.label: recreation's a waste
ThoughtDef::VME_Recreation_Disapproved.description: Sitting around playing games or reading when there's scrap to sort. Feels like wasted time I'll regret.

ThoughtDef::VME_RousingInsectoidHymn.label: a rousing hive-hymn
ThoughtDef::VME_RousingInsectoidHymn.description: The chanter had real skill, and every line of that hymn made our way of life sound like it mattered. Still humming it.

ThoughtDef::VME_Royalty_Disliked.label: highborn in the room
ThoughtDef::VME_Royalty_Disliked.description: There's someone here who thinks their bloodline means something out on this rock. It doesn't sit right with me.

ThoughtDef::VME_Royalty_Exalted.label: nobility among us
ThoughtDef::VME_Royalty_Exalted.description: Having someone of real rank walking through camp is an honor I don't take lightly. Even the sand seems to sit up straighter.

ThoughtDef::VME_Royalty_Hated.label: nobility among us
ThoughtDef::VME_Royalty_Hated.description: Somebody with a fancy title is standing around like the desert owes them something. I can't stand being near it.

ThoughtDef::VME_Royalty_Respected.label: someone of rank's nearby
ThoughtDef::VME_Royalty_Respected.description: There's a person of real standing in camp today. Worth a bit of extra care in how I talk to them.

ThoughtDef::VME_SatisfyingPlagueFestival.label: a satisfying plague rite
ThoughtDef::VME_SatisfyingPlagueFestival.description: The corpse gave up its sickness right on cue and it swept over all of us like a blessing. That's how it's supposed to go.

ThoughtDef::VME_SatisfyingViolentConvers.label: a satisfying conversion
ThoughtDef::VME_SatisfyingViolentConvers.description: That speech at knifepoint actually landed, stirring and sharp. Worked better than I expected.

ThoughtDef::VME_Scars_Disgusting.label: all those old scars
ThoughtDef::VME_Scars_Disgusting.description: Whoever's near me is carved up head to foot with old battle wounds. I can't stop noticing it, and it turns my stomach a little.

ThoughtDef::VME_Scars_Honorable.label: scars worth respect
ThoughtDef::VME_Scars_Honorable.description: Whoever's near me is carved up with old battle wounds, and every one of them is a story worth telling. That's a person who's survived plenty.

ThoughtDef::VME_SecondDefeat_Dishonorabl.label: beaten again
ThoughtDef::VME_SecondDefeat_Dishonorabl.description: Lost a fight for the second time now. My name's not worth much after that.

ThoughtDef::VME_SexyOrgy.label: a night to remember
ThoughtDef::VME_SexyOrgy.description: We gave ourselves over to each other, no pretense about it. Feels good just thinking back on it.

ThoughtDef::VME_Slavery_Forbidden_HasBee.label: carrying old chains
ThoughtDef::VME_Slavery_Forbidden_HasBee.description: I remember what it was to be owned by somebody else. That doesn't just wash off.

ThoughtDef::VME_Slavery_Forbidden_Slaves.label: slaves, still in camp
ThoughtDef::VME_Slavery_Forbidden_Slaves.description: There are people here held as property and we haven't freed them yet. We need to fix that.

ThoughtDef::VME_SoldSlave_Know_Forbidden.label: word got out we sold someone
ThoughtDef::VME_SoldSlave_Know_Forbidden.description: Everyone in camp knows we sold a person off like cargo now. I can feel the judgment in the air.

ThoughtDef::VME_SoldSlave_Know_Forbidden.label: we sold a slave
ThoughtDef::VME_SoldSlave_Know_Forbidden.description: We took part in selling a person like they were spare parts. That's a disgrace I'll be carrying a while.

ThoughtDef::VME_SpectacularPlagueFestiva.label: spectacular plague rite
ThoughtDef::VME_SpectacularPlagueFestiva.description: The whole camp worked itself to a frenzy and the sickness rolled off that corpse like a blessing wind. I've never felt anything like it.

ThoughtDef::VME_SpectacularViolentConver.label: an electrifying conversion
ThoughtDef::VME_SpectacularViolentConver.description: That speech at the blade's edge was sharp enough to make anyone believe. Surely nobody else's creed stands a chance against ours now.

ThoughtDef::VME_SquamousIncantation.label: squamous chanting
ThoughtDef::VME_SquamousIncantation.description: Whoever led that chant used words I can't even pronounce, and I don't want to know what they mean. Unsettling stuff.

ThoughtDef::VME_TaintedApparel_Abhorrent.label: wearing a dead man's clothes
ThoughtDef::VME_TaintedApparel_Abhorrent.description: This apparel belonged to somebody who died in it. I can't think of much worse to have against my skin.

ThoughtDef::VME_TerribleBonfire.label: sorry excuse for a bonfire
ThoughtDef::VME_TerribleBonfire.description: A few sad little flames sputtered and died out fast. Barely worth calling it a fire at all.

ThoughtDef::VME_TerribleCeremonialSuicid.label: botched blade-rite
ThoughtDef::VME_TerribleCeremonialSuicid.description: The blade went in sideways and there was blood and worse everywhere. I still feel sick thinking about it.

ThoughtDef::VME_TerribleLeadershipChalle.label: grim leadership fight
ThoughtDef::VME_TerribleLeadershipChalle.description: Watching that fight just made everyone sad, nothing exciting about it. At least our leader's clearly the strongest, small comfort as that is.

ThoughtDef::VME_TerriblePlagueFestival.label: botched plague rite
ThoughtDef::VME_TerriblePlagueFestival.description: The whole ritual fell flat and the corpse just lay there, no sickness released at all. Waste of a good corpse.

ThoughtDef::VME_TerribleWickerManBurning.label: that burning went wrong
ThoughtDef::VME_TerribleWickerManBurning.description: The whole thing smelled like burnt rations, and the prisoner kept screaming something about insects that made no sense. I still don't know what that was about.

ThoughtDef::VME_Travel_Desired.label: we've been moving lately
ThoughtDef::VME_Travel_Desired.description: Nothing beats seeing new ground after too long parked in one spot. This desert's got more to it than any one dune.

ThoughtDef::VME_Travel_Despised.label: had to move again
ThoughtDef::VME_Travel_Despised.description: We packed up and left camp again not long ago. I hate being uprooted like that.

ThoughtDef::VME_UnexcitingTradingFair.label: dull trading fair
ThoughtDef::VME_UnexcitingTradingFair.description: A couple of good deals happened, sure, but most of it was just haggling nobody enjoyed. Forgettable.

ThoughtDef::VME_UnforgettableCeremonialS.label: unforgettable blade-rite
ThoughtDef::VME_UnforgettableCeremonialS.description: That was courage and resolve nobody in this camp will forget. The honor's more than restored — it's legend now.

ThoughtDef::VME_UnforgettableLeadershipC.label: unforgettable leadership fight
ThoughtDef::VME_UnforgettableLeadershipC.description: Both fighters left everything they had on the ground. Nobody doubts who's strongest after that.

ThoughtDef::VME_UninterestingInsectoidHy.label: tedious hive-hymn
ThoughtDef::VME_UninterestingInsectoidHy.description: Yes, yes, the hive-kind are wondrous, we get it. That chant dragged on forever and said nothing new.

ThoughtDef::VME_UnshacklingSlaveEmancipa.label: an inspiring emancipation
ThoughtDef::VME_UnshacklingSlaveEmancipa.description: Our leader laid out every cruelty of slavery and every reason a free clan beats an owned one. Hard not to feel it.

ThoughtDef::VME_Violence_Abhorrent.label: killed someone
ThoughtDef::VME_Violence_Abhorrent.description: I used lethal force on another person today. I'm ashamed of what that makes me.

ThoughtDef::VME_Violence_Disapproved.label: used deadly force
ThoughtDef::VME_Violence_Disapproved.description: I killed someone today, no way around saying it plain. Doesn't sit easy with me.

ThoughtDef::VME_Violence_Honorable.label: used deadly force
ThoughtDef::VME_Violence_Honorable.description: I killed an adversary today. Out here, that's just what surviving costs, and I don't regret it.

ThoughtDef::VME_WellOrganizedTradingFair.label: solid trading fair
ThoughtDef::VME_WellOrganizedTradingFair.description: Plenty of back-and-forth, plenty of new faces to remember. Good networking, good day.

ThoughtDef::VME_WondrousTradingFair.label: a legendary trading fair
ThoughtDef::VME_WondrousTradingFair.description: We talked trade ideas sharp enough that word of this camp as a place of real business is going to spread. That's worth more than any single deal.

ThoughtDef::Affair.label: carrying on behind their back
ThoughtDef::Affair.description: I've been slipping off to see someone who isn't my partner. It's a good feeling and a rotten one at the same time, and I can't have both halves of that without the guilt catching up.

ThoughtDef::AmbrosiaHigh.label: ambrosia glow
ThoughtDef::AmbrosiaHigh.description: That fruit hit like nothing grown on this rock should. Warm, loose, humming with energy I didn't have an hour ago.

ThoughtDef::AnestheticHigh.label: anesthetic fog
ThoughtDef::AnestheticHigh.description: Everything's gone soft and far away. My limbs feel like sandbags, but good sandbags.

ThoughtDef::AnnoyingVoice.label: grating voice
ThoughtDef::AnnoyingVoice.description: Every word out of them scrapes on my nerves like sand in a joint. I can't tell them to stop talking, but I want to.

ThoughtDef::ApparelDamaged.label: clothes falling apart
ThoughtDef::ApparelDamaged.description: My gear's worn through faster than I can patch it, holes and all. I look like I lost a fight with a sandstorm.

ThoughtDef::ArtifactMoodBoost.label: off the strange relic
ThoughtDef::ArtifactMoodBoost.description: That thing does something to my head I can't name, but it leaves me loose and easy. I'm not asking questions, I'm just enjoying it.

ThoughtDef::AttendedConcert.label: watched a performance
ThoughtDef::AttendedConcert.description: Someone actually played for us tonight, and it was good. Out here that counts as a real treat.

ThoughtDef::AttendedParty.label: went to a gathering
ThoughtDef::AttendedParty.description: We put the work down for a night and just talked and drank together. I needed that more than I realized.

ThoughtDef::AttendedWedding.label: saw two bond
ThoughtDef::AttendedWedding.description: Watching two of ours tie themselves together, out here where nothing's guaranteed, does something to a person. Good for them.

ThoughtDef::Aurora.label: lights in the sky
ThoughtDef::Aurora.description: The sky's doing something I've got no explanation for, and it's beautiful. Worth stopping the work to look up.

ThoughtDef::BodyPuristDisgust.label: sick of the metal in me
ThoughtDef::BodyPuristDisgust.description: Every bit of chrome bolted into my body is a bit of me that isn't me anymore. I hate looking down and seeing it.

ThoughtDef::BotchedMySurgery.label: they cut me wrong
ThoughtDef::BotchedMySurgery.description: Whoever held the knife on me didn't know what they were doing, and now I'm paying for it. That kind of mistake doesn't heal clean.

ThoughtDef::BrokeUpWithMeMood.label: cast off by {0}
ThoughtDef::BrokeUpWithMeMood.description: {0} decided we were done and didn't ask my opinion on it. I feel like a part I got traded out of the crew.

ThoughtDef::Catharsis.label: let it all out
ThoughtDef::Catharsis.description: I finally said the things I'd been sitting on for too long. Feels like setting down a load I didn't know I was carrying.

ThoughtDef::ChemicalInterestVsTeetotaler.label: they judge my habit
ThoughtDef::ChemicalInterestVsTeetotaler.description: They look at me sideways every time I reach for a drink or a smoke, like I'm ruining myself. It gets old fast.

ThoughtDef::Chitchat.label: traded some words
ThoughtDef::Chitchat.description: Just a bit of easy talk with someone while we worked. Nothing important, but it made the shift go faster.

ThoughtDef::ColonistBanished.label: we cast someone out
ThoughtDef::ColonistBanished.description: We sent one of our own off the crew and out into the sand alone. I hope they make it, but I know the odds.

ThoughtDef::ColonistLost.label: we lost someone
ThoughtDef::ColonistLost.description: One of ours didn't make it, and it happened ugly. This crew feels smaller now.

ThoughtDef::CrashedTogether.label: went down together
ThoughtDef::CrashedTogether.description: We hit the dirt in the same wreck and walked away from it side by side. That kind of thing sticks a bond in fast.

ThoughtDef::CreepyBreathing.label: that breathing unsettles me
ThoughtDef::CreepyBreathing.description: Every breath they take sounds like it's dragging something behind it. I can't sit near them without my skin crawling a little.

ThoughtDef::DebugBad.label: test glitch, bad flavor
ThoughtDef::DebugBad.description: Somewhere a dev forgot to swap this string out before shipping. I'm not really unhappy, I'm a placeholder.

ThoughtDef::DebugGood.label: test glitch, good flavor
ThoughtDef::DebugGood.description: Somewhere a dev forgot to swap this string out before shipping. I'm not really happy, I'm a placeholder.

ThoughtDef::DeepTalk.label: talked about real things
ThoughtDef::DeepTalk.description: We got past the small talk and into what actually matters to us. I feel like they know me a little better now.

ThoughtDef::DefeatedHostileFactionLeader.label: put down {0}
ThoughtDef::DefeatedHostileFactionLeader.description: {0} was gunning for all of us, and I'm the one who ended that. Feels good to have that threat off the board for good.

ThoughtDef::DefeatedHostileFactionLeader.label: took down their leader
ThoughtDef::DefeatedHostileFactionLeader.description: They're the one who ended the fight against that leader who wanted us dead. I respect that more than I can say.

ThoughtDef::DefeatedInsectHive.label: cleared the hive
ThoughtDef::DefeatedInsectHive.description: We burned out a nest of those things before they could spread. One less patch of tunnel to worry about.

ThoughtDef::DefeatedMechCluster.label: scrapped the machines
ThoughtDef::DefeatedMechCluster.description: We tore down a whole cluster of hostile chrome before it tore through us. Good riddance to it.

ThoughtDef::DeniedJoining.label: turned someone away
ThoughtDef::DeniedJoining.description: We told someone the crew's full and sent them back out into the waste. I hope that wasn't the wrong call.

ThoughtDef::Disfigured.label: look at their scars
ThoughtDef::Disfigured.description: Whatever happened to their face, it's rough to look at straight on. I try not to stare, but I notice every time.

ThoughtDef::DivorcedMe.label: they ended us
ThoughtDef::DivorcedMe.description: They're the one who walked away from what we had. I still think about it more than I'd like.

ThoughtDef::DivorcedMeMood.label: cut loose by {0}
ThoughtDef::DivorcedMeMood.description: {0} and I made a promise, and they're the one who broke it. I feel like cargo somebody decided wasn't worth the weight.

ThoughtDef::EncouragingSpeech.label: heard a good speech
ThoughtDef::EncouragingSpeech.description: Somebody stood up and told us we've got a real shot at this, and I believed it. We needed the push.

ThoughtDef::Expectations.label: used to better
ThoughtDef::Expectations.description: I know what a decent bunk and a full plate feel like, and this crew's giving me less. I try not to complain, but I notice the gap.

ThoughtDef::FailedRomanceAttemptOnMe.label: someone struck out on me
ThoughtDef::FailedRomanceAttemptOnMe.description: They tried to make a move and it went nowhere. Awkward for both of us, but I'll let it go.

ThoughtDef::FailedRomanceAttemptOnMeLowO.label: had to turn {0} down
ThoughtDef::FailedRomanceAttemptOnMeLowO.description: {0} tried something with me and I wasn't having it, not from them. Now it's just uncomfortable every time we're in the same room.

ThoughtDef::FailedToRescueRelative.label: couldn't save {0}
ThoughtDef::FailedToRescueRelative.description: We had a real shot at pulling {0} out of trouble and we blew it. I keep running through what I should've done different.

ThoughtDef::FlakeHigh.label: riding flake
ThoughtDef::FlakeHigh.description: Whatever's in this stuff, it's good, real good. I don't want to come down.

ThoughtDef::ForcedMeToTakeLuciferium.label: they hooked me on lume
ThoughtDef::ForcedMeToTakeLuciferium.description: They dosed me with luciferium without asking, and now I'm chained to it for good. I won't forget whose idea that was.

ThoughtDef::FreedFromSlavery.label: off the chain
ThoughtDef::FreedFromSlavery.description: Nobody owns me anymore. I still can't quite believe it, and I'm not wasting the feeling.

ThoughtDef::GotSomeLovin.label: had a good night
ThoughtDef::GotSomeLovin.description: Sometimes the best cure for a hard day out here is another warm body next to yours. I'm not complaining.

ThoughtDef::HarmedMe.label: they hurt me
ThoughtDef::HarmedMe.description: They put their hands on me and I haven't forgotten it. I don't trust them the way I used to.

ThoughtDef::HarvestedOrgan_Bloodlust.label: loved the cutting
ThoughtDef::HarvestedOrgan_Bloodlust.description: Pulling the organs out of them, blood everywhere, scalpel doing its work. I won't pretend I didn't enjoy every second.

ThoughtDef::HeldConcert.label: played for the crowd
ThoughtDef::HeldConcert.description: I gave it everything up there and they ate it up. Nothing beats a crew cheering for you.

ThoughtDef::HoneymoonPhase.label: still in the glow
ThoughtDef::HoneymoonPhase.description: Everything about them is still new and good, and I can't stop thinking about it. This part never lasts, so I'm holding onto it.

ThoughtDef::HumanLeatherApparelSad.label: wearing someone's skin
ThoughtDef::HumanLeatherApparelSad.description: This gear was tanned off a person, not a bantha, and I know it every time I put it on. It doesn't sit right, no matter how well it fits.

ThoughtDef::IRejectedTheirProposal.label: I turned them down
ThoughtDef::IRejectedTheirProposal.description: They asked me to bind myself to them and I said no. I don't regret it, but I know it cost them something.

ThoughtDef::Incestuous.label: that's kin, not a match
ThoughtDef::Incestuous.description: Those two are blood, and what they're doing together turns my stomach. I don't want to think about it, but I keep catching myself doing exactly that.

ThoughtDef::InspirationalSpeech.label: moved by that speech
ThoughtDef::InspirationalSpeech.description: Every word landed somewhere real, and now I've got purpose burning where there wasn't any an hour ago. I'd follow whoever said that anywhere.

ThoughtDef::Joywire.label: the wire's singing
ThoughtDef::Joywire.description: Whatever they wired into my skull, it's making everything feel incredible right now. I don't want to ask what it's costing me later.

ThoughtDef::KilledColonist.label: they killed one of ours
ThoughtDef::KilledColonist.description: One of our own is dead because of them. I look at them different now, and not in a good way.

ThoughtDef::KilledHumanlikeBloodlust.label: killed and loved it
ThoughtDef::KilledHumanlikeBloodlust.description: I put someone down and felt the rush of it hit me clean through. Doesn't matter who they were, that felt incredible.

ThoughtDef::KilledMyBrother.label: they killed my brother
ThoughtDef::KilledMyBrother.description: My brother's dead by their hand, and I can't shake it off. Every time I see them I think about it.

ThoughtDef::KilledMyDaughter.label: they killed my daughter
ThoughtDef::KilledMyDaughter.description: My daughter's dead by their hand, and I can't shake it off. Every time I see them I think about it.

ThoughtDef::KilledMyFather.label: they killed my father
ThoughtDef::KilledMyFather.description: My father's dead by their hand, and I can't shake it off. Every time I see them I think about it.

ThoughtDef::KilledMyFiance.label: they killed my fiance
ThoughtDef::KilledMyFiance.description: The one I was going to bind myself to is dead by their hand. I can't look at them without seeing that.

ThoughtDef::KilledMyKin.label: they killed my kin
ThoughtDef::KilledMyKin.description: Family of mine is dead by their hand, and I can't shake it off. Every time I see them I think about it.

ThoughtDef::KilledMyMother.label: they killed my mother
ThoughtDef::KilledMyMother.description: My mother's dead by their hand, and I can't shake it off. Every time I see them I think about it.

ThoughtDef::KilledMyRival.label: they killed my rival
ThoughtDef::KilledMyRival.description: The person I never got along with is dead now, and by their hand. Strange thing to feel angry about, but I do.

ThoughtDef::KilledMySister.label: they killed my sister
ThoughtDef::KilledMySister.description: My sister's dead by their hand, and I can't shake it off. Every time I see them I think about it.

ThoughtDef::KilledMySon.label: they killed my son
ThoughtDef::KilledMySon.description: My son's dead by their hand, and I can't shake it off. Every time I see them I think about it.

ThoughtDef::KilledMySpouse.label: they killed my spouse
ThoughtDef::KilledMySpouse.description: The one I bound my life to is dead by their hand. I don't know how I look at them and keep working.

ThoughtDef::KindWords.label: said something kind
ThoughtDef::KindWords.description: I told them something good, meant it plain and simple. Didn't cost me anything and it seemed to help.

ThoughtDef::KindWordsMood.label: someone was kind to me
ThoughtDef::KindWordsMood.description: They didn't have to say something good to me, and they did anyway. It sat with me longer than I expected.

ThoughtDef::KnowBuriedInSarcophagus.label: buried them proper
ThoughtDef::KnowBuriedInSarcophagus.description: This crew laid someone to rest in a real sealed casket, not just sand over a shroud. Whatever they were owed, we gave them that much.

ThoughtDef::KnowColonistOrganHarvested.label: we cut up one of ours
ThoughtDef::KnowColonistOrganHarvested.description: Somebody on this crew took another crewmate's organs out and sold them off. That's not scavenging, that's something else, and it sits wrong with me.

ThoughtDef::KnowPrisonerDiedInnocent.label: an innocent died in our cage
ThoughtDef::KnowPrisonerDiedInnocent.description: We had someone locked up who never did us wrong, and they died on our watch anyway. We owed them better than that.

ThoughtDef::LoveReading.label: lost in a good text
ThoughtDef::LoveReading.description: Nothing clears my head like getting deep into a real book. I could go hours and not notice the sun move.

ThoughtDef::Man.label: he's a man
ThoughtDef::Man.description: Just taking note of him, plain as that. Doesn't change how I feel about him one way or the other.

ThoughtDef::MissingTongue.label: no tongue left
ThoughtDef::MissingTongue.description: I can't form a word anymore, not one. Everything I want to say just sits stuck behind my teeth.

ThoughtDef::MoodOffsetDepressive.label: the weight never lifts
ThoughtDef::MoodOffsetDepressive.description: Some days are just heavier than others, and mine's always heavier. That's not something that fixes itself.

ThoughtDef::MoodOffsetOptimist.label: keep expecting good
ThoughtDef::MoodOffsetOptimist.description: Even out here, I keep waiting for something to go right. Most days I'm not wrong about it.

ThoughtDef::MoodOffsetPessimist.label: expecting the worst
ThoughtDef::MoodOffsetPessimist.description: I've stopped hoping for good news, it saves me the letdown. Out here that's just being realistic.

ThoughtDef::MoodOffsetSanguine.label: steady no matter what
ThoughtDef::MoodOffsetSanguine.description: Whatever this day throws at me, I roll with it. Not much rattles me for long.

ThoughtDef::MoodOffsetTorturedArtist.label: the craft eats at me
ThoughtDef::MoodOffsetTorturedArtist.description: Whatever I make never comes out the way it lives in my head, and that gap follows me around. Making things hurts as much as it helps.

ThoughtDef::MyAuntLost.label: my aunt {0} is missing
ThoughtDef::MyAuntLost.description: My aunt went out and hasn't come back. I keep hoping she turns up somewhere on the horizon.

ThoughtDef::MyBrotherLost.label: my brother {0} is missing
ThoughtDef::MyBrotherLost.description: My brother went out and hasn't come back. I keep hoping he turns up somewhere on the horizon.

ThoughtDef::MyCousinLost.label: my cousin {0} is missing
ThoughtDef::MyCousinLost.description: My cousin went out and hasn't come back. I don't know where to even start looking.

ThoughtDef::MyDaughterLost.label: my daughter {0} is missing
ThoughtDef::MyDaughterLost.description: My daughter went out and hasn't come back. I keep hoping she turns up somewhere on the horizon.

ThoughtDef::MyFatherLost.label: my father {0} is missing
ThoughtDef::MyFatherLost.description: My father went out and hasn't come back. I keep hoping he turns up somewhere on the horizon.

ThoughtDef::MyFianceLost.label: my fiance {0} is missing
ThoughtDef::MyFianceLost.description: The one I was going to bind myself to went out and hasn't come back. I keep hoping he turns up somewhere on the horizon.

ThoughtDef::MyFianceeLost.label: my fiancee {0} is missing
ThoughtDef::MyFianceeLost.description: The one I was going to bind myself to went out and hasn't come back. I keep hoping she turns up somewhere on the horizon.

ThoughtDef::MyGrandchildLost.label: my grandchild {0} is missing
ThoughtDef::MyGrandchildLost.description: My grandchild went out and hasn't come back. I keep hoping they turn up somewhere on the horizon.

ThoughtDef::MyGrandparentLost.label: my grandparent {0} is missing
ThoughtDef::MyGrandparentLost.description: My grandparent went out and hasn't come back. I don't know where to even start looking.

ThoughtDef::MyHalfSiblingLost.label: my half-sibling {0} is missing
ThoughtDef::MyHalfSiblingLost.description: My half-sibling went out and hasn't come back. I don't know where to even start looking.

ThoughtDef::MyHusbandLost.label: my husband {0} is missing
ThoughtDef::MyHusbandLost.description: My husband went out and hasn't come back. I keep hoping he turns up somewhere on the horizon.

ThoughtDef::MyKinLost.label: my kin {0} is missing
ThoughtDef::MyKinLost.description: Family of mine went out and hasn't come back. I don't know where to even start looking.

ThoughtDef::MyMotherLost.label: my mother {0} is missing
ThoughtDef::MyMotherLost.description: My mother went out and hasn't come back. I keep hoping she turns up somewhere on the horizon.

ThoughtDef::MyNephewLost.label: my nephew {0} is missing
ThoughtDef::MyNephewLost.description: My nephew went out and hasn't come back. I keep hoping he turns up somewhere on the horizon.

ThoughtDef::MyNieceLost.label: my niece {0} is missing
ThoughtDef::MyNieceLost.description: My niece went out and hasn't come back. I keep hoping she turns up somewhere on the horizon.

ThoughtDef::MyOrganHarvested.label: they cut me for parts
ThoughtDef::MyOrganHarvested.description: This crew took organs out of my own body and I didn't get a say. I'm just spare stock to them now, same as any junk pile.

ThoughtDef::MySisterLost.label: my sister {0} is missing
ThoughtDef::MySisterLost.description: My sister went out and hasn't come back. I keep hoping she turns up somewhere on the horizon.

ThoughtDef::MySonLost.label: my son {0} is missing
ThoughtDef::MySonLost.description: My son went out and hasn't come back. I keep hoping he turns up somewhere on the horizon.

ThoughtDef::MyUncleLost.label: my uncle {0} is missing
ThoughtDef::MyUncleLost.description: My uncle went out and hasn't come back. I keep hoping he turns up somewhere on the horizon.

ThoughtDef::MyWifeLost.label: my wife {0} is missing
ThoughtDef::MyWifeLost.description: My wife went out and hasn't come back. I keep hoping she turns up somewhere on the horizon.

ThoughtDef::NeedComfort.label: sick of hard ground
ThoughtDef::NeedComfort.description: My back's been aching from sleeping and sitting on nothing but bare rock and metal. A soft seat would go a long way right now.

ThoughtDef::NeedIndoors.label: too long under open sky
ThoughtDef::NeedIndoors.description: I've been out under the sun and stars too many days running with no roof over me. My skin and my nerves are both done with it.

ThoughtDef::NewColonyOptimism.label: fresh start, good feeling
ThoughtDef::NewColonyOptimism.description: This ground's rough and we've got nothing built yet, but I like our odds. Starting from scratch beats where we came from.

ThoughtDef::NightOwlDuringTheNight.label: sharper after dark
ThoughtDef::NightOwlDuringTheNight.description: Once the sun's down and the heat breaks, I come alive. This is when I do my best work.

ThoughtDef::OnDuty.label: eyes on the job
ThoughtDef::OnDuty.description: I've got a post to hold and I'm holding it. Nothing fancy about it, just the work in front of me.

ThoughtDef::OpinionOfMyLover.label: how {0} makes me feel
ThoughtDef::OpinionOfMyLover.description: Being close to {0} colors how I feel most days, for better or worse. It's not something I can just switch off.

ThoughtDef::PawnWithBadOpinionLost.label: good riddance to {0}
ThoughtDef::PawnWithBadOpinionLost.description: {0} went missing, and I can't say I'm losing sleep over it. Some kind of justice in that, even out here.

ThoughtDef::Pretty.label: easy on the eyes
ThoughtDef::Pretty.description: There's something about the way they carry themselves that I notice more than I should. Doesn't hurt to look.

ThoughtDef::ProsthophileNoProsthetic.label: wish I had chrome
ThoughtDef::ProsthophileNoProsthetic.description: This meat body's soft and slow next to what a good prosthetic could do. I want metal in me, and I don't have any yet.

ThoughtDef::PsychicEmanatorSoothe.label: the emanator's calm
ThoughtDef::PsychicEmanatorSoothe.description: That machine's doing something to my head, and whatever it is, it's leaving me loose and easy. I'm not fighting the feeling.

ThoughtDef::PsychiteTeaHigh.label: buzzing off the tea
ThoughtDef::PsychiteTeaHigh.description: That brew hit me faster than I expected, and now I've got energy to spare. I could work through the night on this.

ThoughtDef::PsychiteWithdrawal.label: coming down hard
ThoughtDef::PsychiteWithdrawal.description: Everything's dragging and slow, and so am I. I want that tea back in my hands, bad.

ThoughtDef::PyromaniacHappy.label: eyeing the firestarter
ThoughtDef::PyromaniacHappy.description: Just holding this thing that throws flame gets my blood up. I want to see what it can do.

ThoughtDef::PyromaniacNearFire.label: watching it burn
ThoughtDef::PyromaniacNearFire.description: That flame twists and climbs like it's alive, and I can't look away. Something about fire feels like freedom to me.

ThoughtDef::RapportBuilt.label: built some rapport
ThoughtDef::RapportBuilt.description: We understand each other a little better after that talk. Small thing, but it counts.

ThoughtDef::RebuffedMyRomanceAttempt.label: they shut me down
ThoughtDef::RebuffedMyRomanceAttempt.description: I put myself out there and they weren't interested. I'll get over it, but it stings for now.

ThoughtDef::RecruitedMe.label: they brought me into the crew
ThoughtDef::RecruitedMe.description: They're the one who talked me into joining up instead of leaving me out in the sand. I owe them that much trust.

ThoughtDef::RejectedMyProposal.label: they turned me down
ThoughtDef::RejectedMyProposal.description: I asked them to bind their life to mine and they said no. That's a hard thing to carry around them now.

ThoughtDef::Rescued.label: pulled out alive
ThoughtDef::Rescued.description: I was sure that was the end of me, and then somebody pulled me out of it. I'm not taking that for granted.

ThoughtDef::RescuedMe.label: they pulled me out
ThoughtDef::RescuedMe.description: They're the one who got to me before it was too late. I don't forget a thing like that.

ThoughtDef::RescuedMeByOfferingHelp.label: someone pulled me out
ThoughtDef::RescuedMeByOfferingHelp.description: I was sure that was the end of me, and then a stranger got me clear of it. I'm not taking that for granted.

ThoughtDef::RescuedRelative.label: got {0} back safe
ThoughtDef::RescuedRelative.description: We went out and brought {0} back before it was too late. First real breath I've taken in days.

ThoughtDef::RotStinkLingering.label: can't wash the rot off
ThoughtDef::RotStinkLingering.description: That rot smell was bad enough when it happened, and it's still clinging to me now. I keep catching whiffs of it that aren't really there.

ThoughtDef::SmokeleafHigh.label: smoked out
ThoughtDef::SmokeleafHigh.description: Everything's slow and easy and a little funny right now. Good smoke, good headspace.

ThoughtDef::SmokeleafWithdrawal.label: wanting a smoke
ThoughtDef::SmokeleafWithdrawal.description: My hands are jittery and my gut's tight with wanting it. One good pull is all I'd need.

ThoughtDef::SoakingWet.label: drenched through
ThoughtDef::SoakingWet.description: Water's soaked clean through everything I'm wearing, which out here is rare enough to be miserable in its own way. I want to be dry again.

ThoughtDef::TeetotalerVsChemicalInterest.label: they can't leave it alone
ThoughtDef::TeetotalerVsChemicalInterest.description: Watching them chase whatever they're using bothers me more than it should. I don't understand why they'd want that in them at all.

ThoughtDef::TerribleSpeech.label: that speech was rough
ThoughtDef::TerribleSpeech.description: Whoever gave that speech had nothing worth hearing in it. If that's the best we've got leading us, I'm worried.

ThoughtDef::TranshumanistAppreciation.label: respect the chrome
ThoughtDef::TranshumanistAppreciation.description: Seeing them decked out in good augmentation does something for me. That's the future, worn right on the body.

ThoughtDef::Ugly.label: hard to look at
ThoughtDef::Ugly.description: Whatever's happened to their face, it's not easy on the eyes. I try not to let it show, but I notice it every time.

ThoughtDef::UndergrounderOutdoors.label: hate the open sky
ThoughtDef::UndergrounderOutdoors.description: All this open ground and empty sky sets my teeth on edge. I want walls around me and rock over my head.

ThoughtDef::UninspiringSpeech.label: flat, forgettable speech
ThoughtDef::UninspiringSpeech.description: That speech didn't land, just words that came and went. If that's who's supposed to lead us, I've got my doubts.

ThoughtDef::WakeUpWithdrawal.label: off the wake-up
ThoughtDef::WakeUpWithdrawal.description: My head's stuffed with fog and I can't hold a thought straight. And I'm exhausted on top of it.

ThoughtDef::Woman.label: she's a woman
ThoughtDef::Woman.description: Just taking note of her, plain as that. Doesn't change how I feel about her one way or the other.

ThoughtDef::WrongApparelGender.label: wearing the wrong cut
ThoughtDef::WrongApparelGender.description: This gear was clearly tailored for someone built different than me, and it shows. I feel ridiculous wearing it.

ThoughtDef::YayoHigh.label: riding yayo
ThoughtDef::YayoHigh.description: My heart's pounding and I feel like I could take on the whole waste right now. Let's go, let's go, let's go.

ThoughtDef::AM_AmazingAnimaBurial.label: burial under the old tree
ThoughtDef::AM_AmazingAnimaBurial.description: We laid our crewmate to rest beneath the old tree and I swear I felt something answer back. That's the kind of send-off I want when it's my turn.

ThoughtDef::AM_AmazingBlastOff.label: sent off in fire
ThoughtDef::AM_AmazingBlastOff.description: We fired the pod straight up and watched the flame eat the sky. My mouth still tastes of chemfuel, and it was exactly the goodbye they deserved.

ThoughtDef::AM_AmazingDreadnought.label: sealed clean in the shell
ThoughtDef::AM_AmazingDreadnought.description: We sealed them into the old war-hull without a hitch, no twitching, no wrong noises after. I hope mine goes that smooth.

ThoughtDef::AM_AmazingFuneral.label: a send-off done right
ThoughtDef::AM_AmazingFuneral.description: We told the old stories over the body and nobody rushed it. It settled something in me I didn't know was unsettled.

ThoughtDef::AM_AmazingPaste.label: nothing of them wasted
ThoughtDef::AM_AmazingPaste.description: Every scrap of them went into the vats and came back as meal. Grim as that sounds, I've never eaten better.

ThoughtDef::AM_AmazingTantrum.label: smashed it all clean
ThoughtDef::AM_AmazingTantrum.description: I tore through gear and furniture until my arms ached and my head went quiet. Whatever comes next, I'm ready for it now.

ThoughtDef::AM_AnimaScreamLesser.label: skull full of static
ThoughtDef::AM_AnimaScreamLesser.description: My head's been ringing since we disturbed that tree. We should've left it alone.

ThoughtDef::AM_AnimaScream_TreesInMap.label: the tree won't shut up
ThoughtDef::AM_AnimaScream_TreesInMap.description: That old tree keeps murmuring at the edge of my mind and I can't drown it out. Somebody needs to deal with it before it deals with us.

ThoughtDef::AM_AnimaScreams_Delightful.label: music in the scream
ThoughtDef::AM_AnimaScreams_Delightful.description: That tree's dying screech went straight through my skull and it felt wonderful, like static tuned to the right frequency. I don't ask why anymore.

ThoughtDef::AM_AnimalAnalysis_Expected.label: behind on the bestiary
ThoughtDef::AM_AnimalAnalysis_Expected.description: We've barely logged a single creature out here, and that's data left on the table. A scavenger who doesn't know what's worth trading for is just prey with tools.

ThoughtDef::AM_AnimalAnalyzedAndReleased.label: let the data-beast go
ThoughtDef::AM_AnimalAnalyzedAndReleased.description: We logged everything worth knowing about it and turned it loose instead of skinning it. Feels like we got the better end of that trade.

ThoughtDef::AM_AnimalDespised_Died_Despi.label: good, one less monster
ThoughtDef::AM_AnimalDespised_Died_Despi.description: That twisted thing finally died and I'm not going to pretend to mourn it. The desert's a little safer tonight.

ThoughtDef::AM_AnimalDespised_Died_Norma.label: another vat-thing gone
ThoughtDef::AM_AnimalDespised_Died_Norma.description: One of those gene-twisted animals died today. The fewer of those wrong-built creatures wandering around, the better I sleep.

ThoughtDef::AM_AnimalRelease_Discouraged.label: let good stock walk off
ThoughtDef::AM_AnimalRelease_Discouraged.description: We turned a perfectly usable animal loose into the waste instead of keeping it. That's meat, milk, or coin we just gave away.

ThoughtDef::AM_AnimalRelease_Encouraged.label: gave it back to the sand
ThoughtDef::AM_AnimalRelease_Encouraged.description: We let that animal go free instead of caging it. The desert keeps what it's owed, and that sits right with me.

ThoughtDef::AM_Armour_Expected.label: no plating, no protection
ThoughtDef::AM_Armour_Expected.description: I'm out here in cloth over skin with nothing between me and a blaster bolt. I feel like I'm asking to get shot.

ThoughtDef::AM_ArtQuality_Expected.label: that art insults me
ThoughtDef::AM_ArtQuality_Expected.description: Whoever scratched that together should stick to scrap-sorting. Looking at it does something to my stomach that isn't admiration.

ThoughtDef::AM_Art_Desired.label: not a scrap of art around
ThoughtDef::AM_Art_Desired.description: Nothing decorates these walls, not even a scavenged mural or a carved plate. A camp with nothing pretty in it feels like it's already given up.

ThoughtDef::AM_AteNutrientPasteMeal_Forb.label: won't touch the paste
ThoughtDef::AM_AteNutrientPasteMeal_Forb.description: They put a bowl of grey paste in front of me and I pushed it away. I'd rather go hungry than eat whatever that's supposed to be.

ThoughtDef::AM_AteNutrientPasteMeal_Pref.label: paste and proud of it
ThoughtDef::AM_AteNutrientPasteMeal_Pref.description: Nobody knows what's actually in the paste and I've stopped asking. It's fast, it's full, and out here that's a small miracle of engineering.

ThoughtDef::AM_BoringBaptism.label: water rite fell flat
