ThoughtDef::AM_BoringBaptism.description: We went through the motions with the water and none of it landed. It should have meant something and instead it just meant we were wet.

ThoughtDef::AM_BoringRelicDestruction.label: smashed it, no thrill
ThoughtDef::AM_BoringRelicDestruction.description: We broke the old idol and that's one less false thing in the camp, even if the doing of it was dull work. Still counts for something.

ThoughtDef::AM_BoringRodeo.label: flat day on the beasts
ThoughtDef::AM_BoringRodeo.description: Nobody could get the animals to do anything worth watching. I could've spent that time patching gear instead.

ThoughtDef::AM_BoringSparring.label: sparring with no bite
ThoughtDef::AM_BoringSparring.description: We traded a few half-hearted swings and called it training. I didn't learn a thing and neither did they.

ThoughtDef::AM_CombatProwess_Increased_U.label: had to go in swinging
ThoughtDef::AM_CombatProwess_Increased_U.description: No blaster, no time to draw one, just my hands and whatever I was holding. Fighting up close like an animal isn't something I'm proud of.

ThoughtDef::AM_CombatProwess_Melee_UsedR.label: shot instead of standing my ground
ThoughtDef::AM_CombatProwess_Melee_UsedR.description: I picked them off from range instead of closing the distance like it should be done. Feels like I hid behind the gun instead of earning it.

ThoughtDef::AM_CorpseRumThought.label: drank to the dead
ThoughtDef::AM_CorpseRumThought.description: This rum's got more kick than it should, and something about it brings the faces of the ones we've lost right back to me. Strange comfort, but comfort all the same.

ThoughtDef::AM_Corpses_Sublime_ObservedL.label: a body, just lying there
ThoughtDef::AM_Corpses_Sublime_ObservedL.description: I passed a corpse out on the sand and couldn't stop looking. There's something almost peaceful about a body that's finally done moving.

ThoughtDef::AM_Corpses_Sublime_ObservedL.label: rot has its own beauty
ThoughtDef::AM_Corpses_Sublime_ObservedL.description: That corpse has been out long enough to turn, and I still couldn't look away. Even falling apart, there's something to it.

ThoughtDef::AM_DeathKnellThought.label: drained something out of them
ThoughtDef::AM_DeathKnellThought.description: I pulled whatever was left running through that downed enemy straight out of them. It's an ugly trick but it leaves me humming for hours.

ThoughtDef::AM_Death_Desired.label: death's not unwelcome here
ThoughtDef::AM_Death_Desired.description: Someone in the crew died, and I'm not going to pretend that's only bad. Out here it reminds all of us exactly what we're risking, and that keeps us honest.

ThoughtDef::AM_DeathrestCaskets_Abhorren.label: that coffin shouldn't be here
ThoughtDef::AM_DeathrestCaskets_Abhorren.description: There's a deathrest casket sitting in our camp like it's normal. Get it out before it poisons the rest of us against our own beliefs.

ThoughtDef::AM_DerangedMaddeningChant.label: the chant made sense to me
ThoughtDef::AM_DerangedMaddeningChant.description: Everyone else calls it noise, but the chant lined up with something already loose in my head. Made more sense than half the things people say sober.

ThoughtDef::AM_DisastrousBanquet.label: the feast turned ugly
ThoughtDef::AM_DisastrousBanquet.description: The food was barely edible and it wasn't long before the shouting started. That's a meal I'd like to forget.

ThoughtDef::AM_DullBanquet.label: feast with nothing in it
ThoughtDef::AM_DullBanquet.description: Same rations, same faces, same silence. Calling that a feast is generous.

ThoughtDef::AM_EnjoyableBanquet.label: good food, good crew
ThoughtDef::AM_EnjoyableBanquet.description: We ate well and laughed harder than we have in a while. Worth every scrap it cost to put together.

ThoughtDef::AM_EntertainingRelicDestruct.label: enjoyed smashing that idol
ThoughtDef::AM_EntertainingRelicDestruct.description: Breaking that old relic was actually fun, not just necessary. Getting rid of a false thing and having a good time doing it - can't complain about that.

ThoughtDef::AM_ExquisiteBanquet.label: best meal in memory
ThoughtDef::AM_ExquisiteBanquet.description: The company, the food, the whole night - none of it put a foot wrong. I'll be thinking about this one for a long while.

ThoughtDef::AM_FunBaptism.label: the water rite landed
ThoughtDef::AM_FunBaptism.description: Something about the water ceremony actually reached me this time. I walked away from it feeling lighter.

ThoughtDef::AM_FunRodeo.label: great ride on the beasts
ThoughtDef::AM_FunRodeo.description: The animals were spirited and the crowd was louder for it. I had a genuinely good time out there.

ThoughtDef::AM_FunSparring.label: sparring that woke me up
ThoughtDef::AM_FunSparring.description: That match had real speed and real nerve behind it. I'm still buzzing from it.

ThoughtDef::AM_GauranlenConnection_Forbi.label: bonded to that thing
ThoughtDef::AM_GauranlenConnection_Forbi.description: I'm tied to some parasitic tree now and I hate every part of it. I won't tend to it or whatever it spawns.

ThoughtDef::AM_GauranlenConnection_Forbi.label: cut the parasite tree down
ThoughtDef::AM_GauranlenConnection_Forbi.description: We chopped down one more of those clinging trees today. Good - that thing never belonged here.

ThoughtDef::AM_GoodAnimaBurial.label: decent send-off at the tree
ThoughtDef::AM_GoodAnimaBurial.description: The burial went smoothly and I think they're at rest under that old tree now. Nothing fancy, but it was enough.

ThoughtDef::AM_GoodBlastOff.label: clean launch, clean goodbye
ThoughtDef::AM_GoodBlastOff.description: The pod went up without a hitch. Simple send-off, but it did the job.

ThoughtDef::AM_GoodDreadnought.label: sealed without trouble
ThoughtDef::AM_GoodDreadnought.description: The entombing went fine, no complications I could see. They'll probably be back on their feet before long.

ThoughtDef::AM_GoodFuneral.label: a fair send-off
ThoughtDef::AM_GoodFuneral.description: We said what needed saying and put them to rest properly. That's about all you can ask for out here.

ThoughtDef::AM_GoodPaste.label: decent meal out of it
ThoughtDef::AM_GoodPaste.description: Grim as it sounds, what came out of the vats fed us well. Nothing wasted, and that matters more than it should.

ThoughtDef::AM_GoodTantrum.label: let some anger out
ThoughtDef::AM_GoodTantrum.description: I broke a few things that needed breaking and it helped. Whatever was building up in me is gone now.

ThoughtDef::AM_HarbingerTrees_Disgusting.label: cut the corpse-eating tree
ThoughtDef::AM_HarbingerTrees_Disgusting.description: We took down one of those trees that feeds on the dead. Whoever thought that thing up should be ashamed.

ThoughtDef::AM_Horses_Desired_HorseDied.label: lost one of the herd-friends
ThoughtDef::AM_Horses_Desired_HorseDied.description: One of our riding beasts died today, and that's not just losing an animal to me. They carried us across half this desert and asked nothing back.

ThoughtDef::AM_IncredibleAnimaBurial.label: the tree answered us
ThoughtDef::AM_IncredibleAnimaBurial.description: Something passed through all of us at that burial, like the old tree itself reached out. I've never felt anything like it.

ThoughtDef::AM_InsaneMaddeningChant.label: the chant, full volume
ThoughtDef::AM_InsaneMaddeningChant.description: That chant went further than anything I've heard before, and I loved every unhinged second of it. Some things aren't meant to make sense.

ThoughtDef::AM_LacklusterAnimaBurial.label: the tree gave nothing back
ThoughtDef::AM_LacklusterAnimaBurial.description: We did the burial right and felt nothing in return. The old tree just sat there, quiet, and that's worse than if it had screamed.

ThoughtDef::AM_LacklusterBlastOff.label: that pod barely cleared the dunes
ThoughtDef::AM_LacklusterBlastOff.description: The launch sputtered more than it soared. I doubt it made it past the upper atmosphere before coming apart.

ThoughtDef::AM_LacklusterDreadnought.label: sealed it in wrong
ThoughtDef::AM_LacklusterDreadnought.description: That entombing was rushed and it showed - loose seals, bad wiring. I just hope they make it out the other side in one piece.

ThoughtDef::AM_LacklusterFuneral.label: a funeral that settled nothing
ThoughtDef::AM_LacklusterFuneral.description: We went through the motions but none of it felt real. I walked away with the same knot in my chest I walked in with.

ThoughtDef::AM_LacklusterPaste.label: would've rather been elsewhere
ThoughtDef::AM_LacklusterPaste.description: I stood through that whole process wishing I was doing anything else. At least the nutrients didn't go to waste.

ThoughtDef::AM_LacklusterTantrum.label: tantrum that missed the mark
ThoughtDef::AM_LacklusterTantrum.description: I broke things but picked the wrong things to break. Didn't get the release I was after.

ThoughtDef::AM_Meals_QualityDesired_AteL.label: a meal worth remembering
ThoughtDef::AM_Meals_QualityDesired_AteL.description: Every bite of that meal was layered with flavor I didn't know we had ingredients for. For a minute the whole desert felt further away.

ThoughtDef::AM_Meals_QualityDesired_AteR.label: ate it raw, no shame left
ThoughtDef::AM_Meals_QualityDesired_AteR.description: They handed me food straight off the carcass, no cooking, no dressing. I know we're scavengers, not animals, and this felt like crossing that line.

ThoughtDef::AM_Meals_QualityDesired_AteS.label: another flavorless ration
ThoughtDef::AM_Meals_QualityDesired_AteS.description: Same bland mash as always, nothing added, nothing tried. Is this really the best we can manage?

ThoughtDef::AM_Megaliths_Desired.label: no markers for the ancestors
ThoughtDef::AM_Megaliths_Desired.description: We haven't raised a single stone cairn for those who came before us. Feels disrespectful to keep putting it off.

ThoughtDef::AM_Mood_Volatile.label: sand's playing tricks again
ThoughtDef::AM_Mood_Volatile.description: Something skittered across my vision that wasn't there a second ago, and I can't tell if it's the heat or my own head. Either way, I've stopped mentioning it out loud.

ThoughtDef::AM_OcularTrees_TreesDesired.label: nothing's watching over us
ThoughtDef::AM_OcularTrees_TreesDesired.description: There isn't a single one of those staring trees nearby, and the open ground feels wrong for it. I keep glancing up out of habit and finding nothing there.

ThoughtDef::AM_OrganUse_Know_Torturous.label: heard how they got the organs
ThoughtDef::AM_OrganUse_Know_Torturous.description: Word got around about how those organs were really harvested - screaming, not sedated. Ugly as it is, I can't say I mind.

ThoughtDef::AM_OrganUse_Know_Torturous_M.label: someone tortured for parts
ThoughtDef::AM_OrganUse_Know_Torturous_M.description: One of the crew cut organs out of somebody who was very much awake for it. That's exactly the kind of ruthless I want standing beside me.

ThoughtDef::AM_OrganUse_Torturous.label: I made them suffer for it
ThoughtDef::AM_OrganUse_Torturous.description: I kept them alive and screaming while I took what I needed. Ugly work, but there's a kind of perfection in doing it slow.

ThoughtDef::AM_PsychoticMaddeningChant.label: past the line and I liked it
ThoughtDef::AM_PsychoticMaddeningChant.description: There used to be a line between clever and unhinged. After that chant, I couldn't find it anymore, and I'm not looking too hard.

ThoughtDef::AM_Rain_Blessed.label: the rain is a gift
ThoughtDef::AM_Rain_Blessed.description: Water falling free from the sky still feels like a small miracle out here. I let it soak me and didn't mind one bit.

ThoughtDef::AM_Rain_Disliked.label: rain just gets in the way
ThoughtDef::AM_Rain_Disliked.description: Everything's wet, the ground's mud, and all I want is the sun back. I don't see what anyone finds soothing about this.

ThoughtDef::AM_Ranching_CattleCentered_C.label: not a single bantha to our name
ThoughtDef::AM_Ranching_CattleCentered_C.description: We're out here calling ourselves ranchers without one animal to show for it. Doesn't feel like much of a herd-clan without a herd.

ThoughtDef::AM_Ranching_CattleCentered_P.label: no pens staked out yet
ThoughtDef::AM_Ranching_CattleCentered_P.description: We haven't marked off a single pen for the stock. Quiet enough without them, but the place feels unfinished.

ThoughtDef::AM_RationalMaddeningChant.label: that chant was just noise
ThoughtDef::AM_RationalMaddeningChant.description: Everyone else lost themselves in it and I just stood there watching people babble at nothing. Waste of an evening.

ThoughtDef::AM_Recreation_Abhorrent.label: recreation is wasted time
ThoughtDef::AM_Recreation_Abhorrent.description: They want me sitting around playing games while there's work stacking up. I'd rather be doing literally anything useful.

ThoughtDef::AM_RelicDestruction_Desired.label: one less false idol
ThoughtDef::AM_RelicDestruction_Desired.description: We broke another relic today, and it felt good watching it go. We won't stop until every one of those things is scrap.

ThoughtDef::AM_Religion_Despised.label: their prayers turn my stomach
ThoughtDef::AM_Religion_Despised.description: I watch them mutter over their little rituals and it makes my skin crawl. I don't have room for that kind of belief in this crew.

ThoughtDef::AM_Religion_Disliked.label: not my kind of faith
ThoughtDef::AM_Religion_Disliked.description: They keep their rituals going and I keep my distance. It's not my business, but it's not something I respect either.

ThoughtDef::AM_Religion_Loved.label: I admire their devotion
ThoughtDef::AM_Religion_Loved.description: They hold to their faith even out here with sand in every seam of their gear. There's something steady about that I actually respect.

ThoughtDef::AM_Religion_ProselytismDisli.label: stop preaching at me
ThoughtDef::AM_Religion_ProselytismDisli.description: They keep trying to talk me into their beliefs and I've said no more than once. I came out here to scavenge, not convert.

ThoughtDef::AM_Reliquaries_Forbidden.label: that shrine shouldn't be here
ThoughtDef::AM_Reliquaries_Forbidden.description: There's a reliquary sitting in camp holding onto some relic like it matters. Get it out before it does more damage than good.

ThoughtDef::AM_RoughLiving_Disliked_AteI.label: ate off real wood
ThoughtDef::AM_RoughLiving_Disliked_AteI.description: A table made from actual trees, out here where wood's worth more than most metal. Eating off it felt like a small victory.

ThoughtDef::AM_RoughLiving_Disliked_AteW.label: ate crouched on the ground
ThoughtDef::AM_RoughLiving_Disliked_AteW.description: No table, just dirt and my own knees to balance the bowl on. That's not how a person's supposed to eat.

ThoughtDef::AM_RoughLiving_Disliked_Slep.label: slept on real timber
ThoughtDef::AM_RoughLiving_Disliked_Slep.description: A bed frame cut from actual wood instead of scrap and salvage. Something about sleeping on trees we beat feels earned.

ThoughtDef::AM_SanguophageCamps_Bloodfee.label: too long since we hunted one
ThoughtDef::AM_SanguophageCamps_Bloodfee.description: It's been ages since we put down one of those bloodsuckers. We're getting soft, and that's not the kind of clan I want to be.

ThoughtDef::AM_SanguophageCamps_RaidingD.label: cleared out a nest of them
ThoughtDef::AM_SanguophageCamps_RaidingD.description: We hit a camp full of those bloodsuckers and left nothing standing. Good hunting, and the desert's better for it.

ThoughtDef::AM_SanguophageCamps_RaidingD.label: we hit their camp together
ThoughtDef::AM_SanguophageCamps_RaidingD.description: The whole crew went in on that raid against the bloodsuckers, and we came out ahead. Feels good doing that kind of work as one unit.

ThoughtDef::AM_SleptInBarracksMonastic.label: the barracks is a wreck
ThoughtDef::AM_SleptInBarracksMonastic.description: We're supposed to live simple, and I don't mind that, but this room is falling apart even by those standards. There's a difference between austere and neglected.

ThoughtDef::AM_SleptInBarracksPreferred.label: crammed in like cargo
ThoughtDef::AM_SleptInBarracksPreferred.description: I slept packed in with everyone else in a room that barely fits us. I don't mind the company, but this is pushing it.

ThoughtDef::AM_SleptInPrivateRoomMonasti.label: a room to myself feels wrong
ThoughtDef::AM_SleptInPrivateRoomMonasti.description: They gave me my own space and it just feels indulgent. I'd rather be back with the others where I belong.

ThoughtDef::AM_SleptInPrivateRoomPreferr.label: alone feels unsafe out here
ThoughtDef::AM_SleptInPrivateRoomPreferr.description: Sleeping off by myself with nobody nearby doesn't sit right with me. Out here you want people close, not walls between you.

ThoughtDef::AM_TableQuality_Desired_AteI.label: ate off a wreck of a table
ThoughtDef::AM_TableQuality_Desired_AteI.description: That table's legs wobble and the surface is half splinters. Eating at it felt like an insult to the meal.

ThoughtDef::AM_TeaCeremonyBlasphemous.label: they butchered the tea rite
ThoughtDef::AM_TeaCeremonyBlasphemous.description: Whatever they did to that ceremony, it wasn't the tea rite I know. I'm going to be turning that over in my head for a while, and not in a good way.

ThoughtDef::AM_TeaCeremonyRefreshing.label: the tea rite settled me
ThoughtDef::AM_TeaCeremonyRefreshing.description: There was something calming about the ceremony this time, like the tea itself slowed everything down. I walked away steadier than I went in.

ThoughtDef::AM_TeaCeremonyTranscendent.label: the tea rite opened something
ThoughtDef::AM_TeaCeremonyTranscendent.description: That ceremony went somewhere I wasn't expecting, like the tea itself was speaking. I won't forget that one.

ThoughtDef::AM_TeaCeremonyUnderwhelming.label: the tea rite fell flat
ThoughtDef::AM_TeaCeremonyUnderwhelming.description: It should have meant something and instead it just meant sitting still for a while. Nothing landed.

ThoughtDef::AM_TeaDrinking_Required_Dran.label: rough tea, did the job
ThoughtDef::AM_TeaDrinking_Required_Dran.description: Wasn't real tea, more like whatever we could brew from what psychite we had. Still hit the spot when I needed it to.

ThoughtDef::AM_TeaDrinking_Required_Dran.label: proper tea, rich and rare
ThoughtDef::AM_TeaDrinking_Required_Dran.description: That was real tea, the good stuff, and it tasted like it. Exactly what I needed after the day we had.

ThoughtDef::AM_TeaDrinking_Required_Dran.label: tea to steady the nerves
ThoughtDef::AM_TeaDrinking_Required_Dran.description: A warm cup and a minute to sit still. Small thing, but it helped.

ThoughtDef::AM_TeaNeed.label: off my tea
ThoughtDef::AM_TeaNeed.description: My head's foggy and my hands won't settle. I'd brew boot leather right now if it smelled anything like tea.

ThoughtDef::AM_TerribleAnimaBurial.label: the burial went wrong
ThoughtDef::AM_TerribleAnimaBurial.description: That burial fell apart in every way it could. I hope the old tree forgives us for it, because I'm not sure I do.

ThoughtDef::AM_TerribleBaptism.label: the water rite was fouled
ThoughtDef::AM_TerribleBaptism.description: Whatever they did to that water ceremony, it was an insult to what it's supposed to mean. I'll be turning that over for days.

ThoughtDef::AM_TerribleBlastOff.label: the launch tore itself apart
ThoughtDef::AM_TerribleBlastOff.description: That pod came apart worse than anything I've seen go up. Something was very wrong with it before it even cleared the ground.

ThoughtDef::AM_TerribleDreadnought.label: the sealing failed completely
ThoughtDef::AM_TerribleDreadnought.description: That entombing went bad in every way it could. I'd rather not think about what that means for when it's my turn.

ThoughtDef::AM_TerribleFuneral.label: an insult of a funeral
ThoughtDef::AM_TerribleFuneral.description: That was less a send-off and more an embarrassment to everyone who showed up for it. They deserved better than that.

ThoughtDef::AM_TerriblePaste.label: wasted good nutrients on nothing
ThoughtDef::AM_TerriblePaste.description: All that went into the vats and came out worth nothing. A waste of time and a waste of what little we had to work with.

ThoughtDef::AM_TerribleRodeo.label: the ride was a disaster
ThoughtDef::AM_TerribleRodeo.description: Nothing about that event went as planned - animals spooked, riders down, the whole thing fell apart. Embarrassing to have even watched it.

ThoughtDef::AM_TerribleSparring.label: that match had no honor in it
ThoughtDef::AM_TerribleSparring.description: No skill, no discipline, just sloppy swings and worse attitudes. That's not training, that's just an argument with fists.

ThoughtDef::AM_TerribleTantrum.label: the tantrum accomplished nothing
ThoughtDef::AM_TerribleTantrum.description: I broke things and felt nothing for it, just wasted time and wasted gear. Didn't help at all.

ThoughtDef::AM_TreeDensityReduced.label: the brush is closing in
ThoughtDef::AM_TreeDensityReduced.description: We've barely cut back any of the growth this stretch, and it's spreading faster than we're clearing it. Feels like we're losing ground to it.

ThoughtDef::AM_Trees_Despised.label: those trees don't belong here
ThoughtDef::AM_Trees_Despised.description: There's a stand of overgrown trees crowding the ground near camp and I hate looking at them. Ugly, wasteful things that block out the sky.

ThoughtDef::AM_UnforgettableBaptism.label: the water rite changed me
ThoughtDef::AM_UnforgettableBaptism.description: That ceremony reached somewhere in me the water usually doesn't touch. I don't think I'll shake that feeling anytime soon.

ThoughtDef::AM_UnforgettableRodeo.label: the greatest ride I've seen
ThoughtDef::AM_UnforgettableRodeo.description: That whole event was electric, easily one of the best things this crew has pulled off. I'll be telling that story for a long time.

ThoughtDef::AM_UnforgettableSparring.label: a match I won't forget
ThoughtDef::AM_UnforgettableSparring.description: That fight was skill and nerve in equal measure, and it left a mark on me watching it. Real mastery, on full display.

ThoughtDef::AM_Violence_Abhorrent_Strict.label: another reason to hate this
ThoughtDef::AM_Violence_Abhorrent_Strict.description: Someone in the crew is dead, and it just confirms what I already believed - this world is cruel and violence never fixes anything. It only hardens my resolve to keep my hands clean of it.

ThoughtDef::AM_Water_Desired.label: water close enough to touch
ThoughtDef::AM_Water_Desired.description: Being this near real standing water settles something in me that the desert never does. It feels like a gift we shouldn't take for granted.

ThoughtDef::AN_SlaughteredAnimal_Desired.label: put the animal down myself
ThoughtDef::AN_SlaughteredAnimal_Desired.description: I slaughtered one of the animals myself today. Necessary work, and somebody's got to do it without flinching.

ThoughtDef::AN_SlaughteredAnimal_Know_De.label: the slaughter was handled
ThoughtDef::AN_SlaughteredAnimal_Know_De.description: One of the crew put an animal down for us today. Good - that's work that needs doing regardless of who does it.

ThoughtDef::AN_SlaughteredAnimal_Know_De.label: necessary work, done right
ThoughtDef::AN_SlaughteredAnimal_Know_De.description: Someone slaughtered an animal for the camp today. It's grim work but it keeps us fed, and I respect whoever did it.

ThoughtDef::GR_AmazingExtraction.label: the extraction went perfect
ThoughtDef::GR_AmazingExtraction.description: Everything came out of that clean, exactly what we needed for the build. I can't wait to see what we make out of it.

ThoughtDef::GR_GoodExtraction.label: a solid extraction
ThoughtDef::GR_GoodExtraction.description: The parts came out usable and in good shape. They'll be put to work well.

ThoughtDef::GR_LacklusterExtraction.label: extraction wasn't worth much
ThoughtDef::GR_LacklusterExtraction.description: Whatever we pulled out of that wasn't worth the effort. I worry it'll go to waste on whatever we're building.

ThoughtDef::GR_TerribleExtraction.label: lost more than we got
ThoughtDef::GR_TerribleExtraction.description: That extraction was a mess, and now I've got to say goodbye to what we lost in the process. Should've never tried it.

ThoughtDef::BabyBorn.label: the little one's here
ThoughtDef::BabyBorn.description: My baby came into this world strong and breathing easy. I'd strip a wreck bare with my own hands for this kid.

ThoughtDef::BabyCriedSocial.label: baby cried near them
ThoughtDef::BabyCriedSocial.description: Their kid was screaming and they didn't so much as look up. Makes me think less of them.

ThoughtDef::BabyGiggledSocial.label: baby giggled at them
ThoughtDef::BabyGiggledSocial.description: Their little one laughed at something they did. Small thing, but it says good things about them.

ThoughtDef::BloodTorch.label: the blood torch's glow
ThoughtDef::BloodTorch.description: It burns low and red, quieter than any lamp we've rigged from scrap. There's something almost decent about that light.

ThoughtDef::BloodfeederColonist_Revered.label: leaderless without fangs
ThoughtDef::BloodfeederColonist_Revered.description: We're drifting without a bloodfeeder running this crew. Put one of the fanged ones at the head of things and it would all sort itself out.

ThoughtDef::BloodfeederColonist_Reviled.label: a bloodfeeder in the ranks
ThoughtDef::BloodfeederColonist_Reviled.description: One of them is walking around this camp like they belong here. Our creed says get the bloodfeeder out, and I'm inclined to agree.

ThoughtDef::Bloodfeeder_ReviledBloodfeed.label: hate what I've become
ThoughtDef::Bloodfeeder_ReviledBloodfeed.description: I'm the very thing our own creed despises, and there's no scrubbing that off me. I need to be rid of this curse.

ThoughtDef::Bloodfeeders_Revered_Opinion.label: respects the bloodfeeder
ThoughtDef::Bloodfeeders_Revered_Opinion.description: They carry the fangs, and our creed says that earns respect. I think more of them for it.

ThoughtDef::Bloodfeeders_Reviled_Opinion.label: scorns the bloodfeeder
ThoughtDef::Bloodfeeders_Reviled_Opinion.description: They carry the fangs, and our creed says that's a curse, not a gift. I think less of them for it.

ThoughtDef::BreastfedBaby.label: nursed at the breast
ThoughtDef::BreastfedBaby.description: The little one's fed and quiet, warm against skin. Simple as that, and it's good.

ThoughtDef::BreastfedMe.label: gave them the breast
ThoughtDef::BreastfedMe.description: I nursed the baby myself, no bottle, no rigged formula. Feels like the most basic thing I can do right by them.

ThoughtDef::ChildInGrowthVat.label: my kid's in the vat
ThoughtDef::ChildInGrowthVat.description: My child's floating in that tank somewhere, growing without me watching it happen. Feels like I'm missing something I won't get back.

ThoughtDef::ChildlikePositivity.label: everything's amazing
ThoughtDef::ChildlikePositivity.description: New things, shiny things, funny things — this whole camp is one big surprise today. I can't stop grinning at it.

ThoughtDef::CryingBaby.label: that baby won't stop
ThoughtDef::CryingBaby.description: Somewhere close a baby's wailing and it's grinding on every nerve I've got. I just want it to stop.

ThoughtDef::DeathrestChamber.label: where I deathrest
ThoughtDef::DeathrestChamber.description: The casket's tucked into whatever space we could rig for it, dust and stacked crates instead of a proper chamber. Sleep's sleep, but I'd rather have real walls around me for this.

ThoughtDef::DeathrestExhaustion.label: deathrest calling
ThoughtDef::DeathrestExhaustion.description: My eyes are lead and my head's gone to fog — the coffin's calling and I can't put it off any longer. I need to get in the casket.

ThoughtDef::EnslavedChild.label: my kid, enslaved
ThoughtDef::EnslavedChild.description: Somebody's got my child working like property, and there's not a thing I can do about it from here. Something tears loose in my chest thinking about it.

ThoughtDef::FedBaby.label: got fed
ThoughtDef::FedBaby.description: Belly's full and everything's fine now.

ThoughtDef::FedMe.label: they fed me
ThoughtDef::FedMe.description: Somebody made sure I ate. Small thing, but it counts for something.

ThoughtDef::FedOn.label: drained like livestock
ThoughtDef::FedOn.description: A bloodfeeder had its fangs in me like I was nothing but a water skin to empty. I feel used and small.

ThoughtDef::FedOn_Social.label: was fed on
ThoughtDef::FedOn_Social.description: Word is a bloodfeeder had its fangs in them. Can't say that sits easy with me.

ThoughtDef::GaveLesson.label: learned something new
ThoughtDef::GaveLesson.description: Somebody took the time to actually teach me instead of just barking orders. I picked something up from it.

ThoughtDef::GigglingBaby.label: baby's laughing
ThoughtDef::GigglingBaby.description: That little giggle cuts right through everything else going on around here. Can't help but grin.

ThoughtDef::GrowthVat_Essential_ChildNot.label: kid should be in a vat
ThoughtDef::GrowthVat_Essential_ChildNot.description: My child's out running loose in the open when they should be safe in a tank. Doesn't sit right with me.

ThoughtDef::GrowthVat_Essential_Pregnant.label: carrying it the hard way
ThoughtDef::GrowthVat_Essential_Pregnant.description: Birthing a kid out here with our hands and our nerve instead of a vat scares me plenty. We should have the tech for this by now.

ThoughtDef::GrowthVat_Prohibited_ChildIn.label: kid's stuck in that tank
ThoughtDef::GrowthVat_Prohibited_ChildIn.description: I can't stand thinking about my child floating in that machine instead of growing up proper. It's not natural, and it eats at me.

ThoughtDef::GrowthVat_Prohibited_ChildNo.label: my kid gets to be a kid
ThoughtDef::GrowthVat_Prohibited_ChildNo.description: My child's out running around in the sun, dust on their knees, growing up the real way. That's worth more than any tank.

ThoughtDef::HateAura.label: the hate radiates off it
ThoughtDef::HateAura.description: I can feel that thing's hatred crawling under my skin like it's my own emotion. Everything in me wants it dead.

ThoughtDef::HemogenCraving.label: need blood
ThoughtDef::HemogenCraving.description: My bones ache and my head's gone fuzzy — I need hemogen bad. I'm starting to think about where I could get some.

ThoughtDef::IngestedHemogenPack.label: choked down a hemogen pack
ThoughtDef::IngestedHemogenPack.description: Drank the pack because I had to, not because I wanted to. Kept me standing, but it was foul going down.

ThoughtDef::KillThirst.label: need to kill someone
ThoughtDef::KillThirst.description: It's been too long since I killed someone up close, and the itch for it is getting hard to ignore.

ThoughtDef::KilledChild.label: killed one so young
ThoughtDef::KilledChild.description: I killed a kid today, whatever the reason for it was. Doesn't matter how you dress that up, it's a weight I'll carry.

ThoughtDef::KilledChild_Opinion.label: killed a child
ThoughtDef::KilledChild_Opinion.description: Word's gotten around that they killed a kid. That's not something I can just let go of.

ThoughtDef::KilledMyBirthMother.label: killed my own mother
ThoughtDef::KilledMyBirthMother.description: They're the reason my birth mother is dead. I don't know how I'm supposed to look at them the same way again.

ThoughtDef::MoodOffsetHappy.label: just feel good
ThoughtDef::MoodOffsetHappy.description: No real reason for it, my mood just runs a little brighter than it should. Something in the blood, I guess.

ThoughtDef::MoodOffsetUnhappy.label: just feel off
ThoughtDef::MoodOffsetUnhappy.description: Nothing's actually wrong, but my mood keeps dragging low anyway. Something in the blood, I guess.

ThoughtDef::MoodOffsetVeryHappy.label: genuinely feel great
ThoughtDef::MoodOffsetVeryHappy.description: My mood runs high without any real cause for it, just how I'm wired. I'll take it.

ThoughtDef::MoodOffsetVeryUnhappy.label: genuinely feel low
ThoughtDef::MoodOffsetVeryUnhappy.description: There's a heaviness in me that isn't about anything that happened today. Just how I'm wired, and it drags.

ThoughtDef::MyBirthMotherLost.label: my mother's lost out there
ThoughtDef::MyBirthMotherLost.description: My birth mother's gone missing somewhere out past the dunes. I keep hoping she finds her way back to us.

ThoughtDef::MyChildHappy.label: my kid's doing well
ThoughtDef::MyChildHappy.description: Nothing settles me like seeing my own kid happy and safe. Worth more than any haul.

ThoughtDef::MyChildSad.label: my kid's struggling
ThoughtDef::MyChildSad.description: My child's not doing well, and it eats at me more than I let on. If they're hurting, I'm hurting.

ThoughtDef::MyChildrenHappy.label: my kids are doing well
ThoughtDef::MyChildrenHappy.description: Nothing settles me like seeing my own kids happy and safe. Worth more than any haul.

ThoughtDef::MyChildrenSad.label: my kids are struggling
ThoughtDef::MyChildrenSad.description: My children aren't doing well, and it eats at me more than I let on. If they're hurting, I'm hurting.

ThoughtDef::MyCryingBaby.label: my baby's crying
ThoughtDef::MyCryingBaby.description: My own kid's wailing somewhere in camp and I can't do a thing about it right now. I just hope it settles soon.

ThoughtDef::MyGigglingBaby.label: my baby's laughing
ThoughtDef::MyGigglingBaby.description: That's my kid giggling away over there, and it's the best sound in this whole camp.

ThoughtDef::MyParentHappy.label: my parent's doing well
ThoughtDef::MyParentHappy.description: Good to see my parent in decent spirits for once. When they're happy, I breathe easier.

ThoughtDef::MyParentsHappy.label: my parents are doing well
ThoughtDef::MyParentsHappy.description: Good to see my parents in decent spirits for once. When they're happy, I breathe easier.

ThoughtDef::NeedLearning.label: starved for something new
ThoughtDef::NeedLearning.description: It's been too long since I learned anything, and the sameness of every day is wearing on me. I need something new to chew on.

ThoughtDef::NeedPlay.label: wants to play
ThoughtDef::NeedPlay.description: I want somebody to stop working for five minutes and play with me. This place is boring and nobody's paying attention.

ThoughtDef::NoxiousHaze.label: smog stings my eyes
ThoughtDef::NoxiousHaze.description: This haze burns my eyes and coats the back of my throat. I'd give a lot for one clean breath.

ThoughtDef::PlayedWithMe.label: someone played with me
ThoughtDef::PlayedWithMe.description: Somebody stopped what they were doing to actually play with me. Made the day a little better.

ThoughtDef::PreferredXenotype.label: how they were made
ThoughtDef::PreferredXenotype.description: Some genelines read as solid stock around here, others don't. I can't help sizing people up by it.

ThoughtDef::PreferredXenotypeMakeup.label: who makes up this crew
ThoughtDef::PreferredXenotypeMakeup.description: Look around: some genelines here I trust, some I don't, and it colors how safe I feel in this camp.

ThoughtDef::PregnancyAttitude.label: expecting
ThoughtDef::PregnancyAttitude.description: I'm carrying a kid now, and it's got me somewhere between terrified and hopeful depending on the hour.

ThoughtDef::PregnancyEnded.label: not pregnant anymore
ThoughtDef::PregnancyEnded.description: The pregnancy's over, one way or another, and honestly the relief outweighs everything else right now.

ThoughtDef::PregnancyMood_Collapse.label: pregnancy's wrecking me
ThoughtDef::PregnancyMood_Collapse.description: My whole body feels like it's fighting me and this pregnancy is grinding me down. I don't know how much more of this I can take.

ThoughtDef::PregnancyMood_Down.label: rough day, pregnant
ThoughtDef::PregnancyMood_Down.description: Everything feels harder today than it should. Being pregnant isn't making any of it easier.

ThoughtDef::PregnancyMood_High.label: pregnancy's got me glowing
ThoughtDef::PregnancyMood_High.description: I feel incredible right now. Carrying this kid feels like the best thing I've ever done.

ThoughtDef::PregnancyMood_Up.label: pregnancy's treating me alright
ThoughtDef::PregnancyMood_Up.description: Things feel a little lighter today. Being pregnant isn't so bad right now.

ThoughtDef::PregnancyTerminated.label: ended the pregnancy
ThoughtDef::PregnancyTerminated.description: I made the call to end it. Whatever the reasons were, it's not a decision that sits light.

ThoughtDef::SelfDislikedXenotype.label: not the right stock
ThoughtDef::SelfDislikedXenotype.description: I know what I am, and by our own creed's reckoning I'm not one of the good types. Hard to shake that off.

ThoughtDef::WasTaught.label: taught me something
ThoughtDef::WasTaught.description: Somebody walked me through a skill instead of just letting me flounder. I picked it up, and I'm grateful for it.

ThoughtDef::XenogermHarvested_Prisoner.label: they took my genes
ThoughtDef::XenogermHarvested_Prisoner.description: They cut into me and pulled genetic material out like I was scrap to be salvaged, not a person. I won't forget what that felt like.

ThoughtDef::YoungstersHappy.label: the young ones are thriving
ThoughtDef::YoungstersHappy.description: Good to see the kids around camp doing well for themselves. Gives me some hope for what we're building here.

ThoughtDef::YoungstersSad.label: the young ones are struggling
ThoughtDef::YoungstersSad.description: The kids around camp aren't doing well, and that's a hard thing to watch. Makes me worry about this crew's future.

ThoughtDef::BioluminescentSpores.label: glowing spores
ThoughtDef::BioluminescentSpores.description: Little points of light drifting through the dark like something out of a story. I could watch it for hours.

ThoughtDef::BlowingSand.label: sand in everything
ThoughtDef::BlowingSand.description: It's in my teeth, my collar, my bedroll, everywhere. I don't think I'll ever get fully clean of it.

ThoughtDef::DestroyedMechhive.label: brought down the mechhive
ThoughtDef::DestroyedMechhive.description: We tore that hive apart together and came out the other side alive. That's a weight off the whole crew.

ThoughtDef::DestroyedMechhiveMainPawn.label: I killed the core
ThoughtDef::DestroyedMechhiveMainPawn.description: I put my hands on the cerebrex core myself and shut it down for good. That threat's off our backs because of what I did.

ThoughtDef::GravNausea.label: grav-sick
ThoughtDef::GravNausea.description: The floor won't hold still and my stomach's right behind it. I think I'm about to lose my last meal.

ThoughtDef::MadeStatueOfMe.label: they made a statue of me
ThoughtDef::MadeStatueOfMe.description: Somebody carved my likeness out of stone or scrap and set it up for the whole camp to see. Can't say that doesn't sit well.

ThoughtDef::PsilocapHigh.label: psilocap haze
ThoughtDef::PsilocapHigh.description: Everything's warmer and stranger than it should be, colors bleeding into sounds. I feel connected to everything around me right now.

ThoughtDef::ResettledRecently.label: somewhere new
ThoughtDef::ResettledRecently.description: Fresh ground under my feet and a horizon I haven't picked over yet. There's something good about not knowing every rock here yet.

ThoughtDef::SlaughteredFish_Know_Disappr.label: killed fish
ThoughtDef::SlaughteredFish_Know_Disappr.description: Word is they've been killing fish. Our creed doesn't look kindly on that.

ThoughtDef::SlaughteredFish_Know_Disappr.label: fish are being slaughtered
ThoughtDef::SlaughteredFish_Know_Disappr.description: Somebody in this crew is killing fish, and I don't like it. Those creatures deserve better than that.

ThoughtDef::SlaughteredFish_Know_Prohibi.label: killed fish
ThoughtDef::SlaughteredFish_Know_Prohibi.description: Word is they've been killing fish, and our creed forbids it outright. That's not a small thing to me.

ThoughtDef::SlaughteredFish_Know_Prohibi.label: fish are dying for nothing
ThoughtDef::SlaughteredFish_Know_Prohibi.description: Someone's slaughtering fish against everything we hold sacred. Those creatures are kin to us in a way, and this feels like a betrayal.

ThoughtDef::SlaughteredFish_Sacred.label: fished today
ThoughtDef::SlaughteredFish_Sacred.description: Pulled a line through the water and felt right doing it. Fishing puts my head in the right place, at least for a while.

ThoughtDef::SlaughteredFish_Sacred_NoFis.label: no water to fish
ThoughtDef::SlaughteredFish_Sacred_NoFis.description: I want to be somewhere I can fish and I'm not. Small thing, but I miss it.

ThoughtDef::SpaceHabitat_Mood.label: belongs among the stars
ThoughtDef::SpaceHabitat_Mood.description: Down here in the dirt I never quite feel settled, like I'm supposed to be up in the black instead. Being off-world feels more like home than any ground camp does.

ThoughtDef::ToxWater.label: soaked in tox water
ThoughtDef::ToxWater.description: This stuff's got me itching and burning everywhere it touched. I want it off my skin now.

ThoughtDef::VolcanicAsh.label: ash in my lungs
ThoughtDef::VolcanicAsh.description: Every breath out here comes with a mouthful of burning grit. My throat feels scorched.

ThoughtDef::GR_AteRatMilk.label: was that rat milk?
ThoughtDef::GR_AteRatMilk.description: I just drank something and I'm pretty sure it came out of a rat. I don't want to think about it too hard.

ThoughtDef::GR_BunnyAround.label: cute little catrabbit
ThoughtDef::GR_BunnyAround.description: That hybrid critter hopping around camp is almost too cute to stand. Gets me every time.

ThoughtDef::GR_DamnMammaries.label: milked like livestock
ThoughtDef::GR_DamnMammaries.description: They hooked me up and drained me like I was some animal on a farm, not a person. I feel humiliated down to my bones.

ThoughtDef::GR_DisgustingUwuchat.label: that was humiliating
ThoughtDef::GR_DisgustingUwuchat.description: Whatever that conversation was, it left me feeling grimy all over. I need to scrub that memory out.

ThoughtDef::GR_ElectroEggHigh.label: buzzing with mechanites
ThoughtDef::GR_ElectroEggHigh.description: Swallowing that mechanoid egg was a rush I didn't expect. I can practically feel the little machines working through me.

ThoughtDef::GR_ElectroEggWithdrawal.label: mechanite itch
ThoughtDef::GR_ElectroEggWithdrawal.description: My whole body itches like the mechanites in me have turned hostile. I need another egg to settle it.

ThoughtDef::GR_EngagedByHumanoidMood.label: good talk with a hybrid
ThoughtDef::GR_EngagedByHumanoidMood.description: Had a real conversation with one of the humanoid hybrids and it was more interesting than I expected. Decent creature, that one.

ThoughtDef::GR_Failures_Shameful.label: one of our failures got loose
ThoughtDef::GR_Failures_Shameful.description: One of our genetic experiments went wrong and now there's a twisted thing running around loose because of it. We should put it down before it shames us further.

ThoughtDef::GR_FeatherdustHigh.label: smoked featherdust
ThoughtDef::GR_FeatherdustHigh.description: Ground-up feathers off some lab abomination, smoked and inhaled. Strange stuff to put in my lungs, but I feel alright.

ThoughtDef::GR_FeatherdustWithdrawal.label: craving featherdust
ThoughtDef::GR_FeatherdustWithdrawal.description: I keep thinking about that smoke and how much I want another hit. Can't shake the want for it.

ThoughtDef::GR_HasAutomatedTurrets_Scorn.label: turrets are beneath us
ThoughtDef::GR_HasAutomatedTurrets_Scorn.description: We've got the power to shape life itself in our own hands and we're leaning on automated turrets instead. Feels like a cheap way out.

ThoughtDef::GR_HeWearsAntennae.label: wearing insectoid antennae
ThoughtDef::GR_HeWearsAntennae.description: Every stray signal and buzz in the air is pouring straight into my skull through these things. I need it to stop.

ThoughtDef::GR_HumanoidHybrids_Forbidden.label: hybrids don't belong here
ThoughtDef::GR_HumanoidHybrids_Forbidden.description: There are humanoid hybrids wandering our camp like it's nothing. That's a perversion of everything decent, and I want them gone.

ThoughtDef::GR_InsultedByHumanoidMood.label: insulted by a hybrid
ThoughtDef::GR_InsultedByHumanoidMood.description: One of those genetic abominations mouthed off at me directly. Ugly creature, uglier manners.

ThoughtDef::GR_Uwuchat.label: that uwu thing happened
ThoughtDef::GR_Uwuchat.description: Something strange and cringeworthy just went down in that conversation. I'm questioning some choices right now.

ThoughtDef::GR_WearingBunnyEars.label: wearing bunny ears
ThoughtDef::GR_WearingBunnyEars.description: Got a pair of bunny ears strapped on and honestly, it's kind of fun. Don't tell the rest of the crew.

ThoughtDef::GR_WearingThrumboHorn.label: wearing a thrumbo horn
ThoughtDef::GR_WearingThrumboHorn.description: Strapped a thrumbo horn to my head and I feel unreasonably good about it. Can't quite explain why.

ThoughtDef::AG_Awe.label: can't stop staring
ThoughtDef::AG_Awe.description: Somebody in this camp is so striking I can't get their face out of my head. How is anyone built like that?

ThoughtDef::AG_CorpseFeeding.label: reek of corpse-gas
ThoughtDef::AG_CorpseFeeding.description: The stink of rot and bile hangs so thick I can taste it. I need to get away from whatever's feeding on that corpse.

ThoughtDef::AG_Disgust.label: can't look away, disgusted
ThoughtDef::AG_Disgust.description: Somebody in this camp is so repulsive I can't stop thinking about it. How does anyone end up looking like that?

ThoughtDef::AG_EldritchVisage.label: something's wrong with their face
ThoughtDef::AG_EldritchVisage.description: There's a wrongness to how they look that I can't put into words. It unsettles me every time I catch sight of them.

ThoughtDef::AG_Implanted.label: stung and implanted
ThoughtDef::AG_Implanted.description: Something forced its way into me and left a sting behind, and I never agreed to any of it. I feel violated by what was done to my body.

ThoughtDef::AG_Implanted_Social.label: was implanted against their will
ThoughtDef::AG_Implanted_Social.description: Word is somebody forced something into them without asking. That's not something I can just shrug off.

ThoughtDef::AG_Mood_Volatile.label: genetics running hot
ThoughtDef::AG_Mood_Volatile.description: My mood swings hard depending on the day, sometimes it's a gift, sometimes it drags me under. Comes with the blood, not the circumstances.

ThoughtDef::AG_Parasite.label: eggs under my skin
ThoughtDef::AG_Parasite.description: I can feel something moving inside me, laid there by that thing, and there's nothing I can do to get it out right now. Worst feeling I've had in a long while.

ThoughtDef::AG_Parasite_Social.label: was parasitized
ThoughtDef::AG_Parasite_Social.description: Something laid eggs in them and they're stuck carrying it. Hard to think about without a shudder.

ThoughtDef::AG_PsychicDrone.label: strange calm
ThoughtDef::AG_PsychicDrone.description: There's a hum in my skull that should probably bother me more than it does. Somehow it's leaving me feeling settled.

ThoughtDef::AG_PukedRats.label: threw up rats again
ThoughtDef::AG_PukedRats.description: Doesn't matter how many times this happens, puking up rats never stops being wrong. I don't think I'll ever get used to it.

ThoughtDef::AG_RaidedBioLab.label: raided a biolab
ThoughtDef::AG_RaidedBioLab.description: Cracked into that lab and got out with something worth having. Nothing beats that rush.

ThoughtDef::AG_Stinky.label: reeks something awful
ThoughtDef::AG_Stinky.description: The smell coming off them is bad enough to make my eyes water from across the room. I try to keep my distance.

ThoughtDef::AG_SunlightSensitivity_Minor.label: sun's too bright
ThoughtDef::AG_SunlightSensitivity_Minor.description: The glare out here stabs right through my eyes today. I'd trade for a good pair of goggles or a patch of shade.

ThoughtDef::AG_Thalassophobia.label: terrified of open water
ThoughtDef::AG_Thalassophobia.description: Just being near that much water has my skin crawling. Give me dry sand any day.

ThoughtDef::AG_UnsettlingAppearance.label: unsettling to look at
ThoughtDef::AG_UnsettlingAppearance.description: There's something about their face that puts me on edge every time I look at it. Can't put a finger on why.

ThoughtDef::AG_UsedXenotypeInjector.label: took the xenotype injector
ThoughtDef::AG_UsedXenotypeInjector.description: Jabbed myself with that injector and let it rewrite something in me. Feels strange knowing it's already done.

ThoughtDef::Turn_Thought_FreeSpiritEnsla.label: would rather die than serve
ThoughtDef::Turn_Thought_FreeSpiritEnsla.description: I'll take a blade to the throat before I keep bowing to these people. Being enslaved is a thing I cannot make peace with.

ThoughtDef::Turn_Thought_FreeSpiritImpri.label: locked up against my will
ThoughtDef::Turn_Thought_FreeSpiritImpri.description: Somebody's caged me up like I'm nothing but cargo, and I never agreed to any of it. I can't stand being confined like this.

ThoughtDef::Turn_Thought_GeneticGauranle.label: missing the tree
ThoughtDef::Turn_Thought_GeneticGauranle.description: My head's gone foggy and I can't think straight without a gauranlen tree nearby. I'd give a lot just to stand near one right now.

ThoughtDef::Turn_Thought_GeneticMeditati.label: need to clear my head
ThoughtDef::Turn_Thought_GeneticMeditati.description: My thoughts are running in circles and the walls feel like they're closing in. I need to sit still and let my mind settle.

ThoughtDef::Turn_Thought_Genetic_BeautyS.label: hate my own face
ThoughtDef::Turn_Thought_Genetic_BeautyS.description: I can't stand what people see when they look at me. It's hard not to think everyone's judging me for it.

ThoughtDef::Turn_Thought_Genetic_LessAtt.label: not much to look at
ThoughtDef::Turn_Thought_Genetic_LessAtt.description: I know I'm not much to look at these days, and it's hard to shake that off.

ThoughtDef::Turn_Thought_Genetic_Submiss.label: need someone to answer to
ThoughtDef::Turn_Thought_Genetic_Submiss.description: Without orders to follow or a master to serve, I don't know what I'm supposed to do with myself. Having somebody in charge of me is what feels right.

ThoughtDef::Turn_Thought_MoodOffsetBliss.label: genetic bliss
ThoughtDef::Turn_Thought_MoodOffsetBliss.description: Everything feels a little easier to carry than it should, no reason needed. Must be the genes.

ThoughtDef::Turn_Thought_StumpLeg.label: dragging this stump
ThoughtDef::Turn_Thought_StumpLeg.description: This flesh stump where a leg should be is a pain to haul around every single day. I hate having to deal with it.

ThoughtDef::BS_AlienApperanceStandards.label: how alien they look
ThoughtDef::BS_AlienApperanceStandards.description: Some faces around here read as close enough to my own kind, others sit in that wrong-but-almost-right place that itches at me. I can't help noticing the difference.

ThoughtDef::BS_DrunkenHigh2.label: the party's just getting going
ThoughtDef::BS_DrunkenHigh2.description: Drink's flowing and the whole crew's loosening up. This is exactly where I want to be right now.

ThoughtDef::BS_DrunkenHigh3.label: nothing's stopping this party
ThoughtDef::BS_DrunkenHigh3.description: I am deep in it now and nobody's pulling me out of this revelry. Let it run.

ThoughtDef::BS_Mood_Deteriorated_Mind.label: losing my grip
ThoughtDef::BS_Mood_Deteriorated_Mind.description: Holding onto my own impulses is getting harder by the day. Something in my head isn't working the way it should anymore.

ThoughtDef::BS_Mood_Violently_Insane.label: violence keeps breaking loose
ThoughtDef::BS_Mood_Violently_Insane.description: Something in me snaps without warning and I lash out before I can stop myself. I can't trust my own hands right now.

ThoughtDef::BS_SimpleMind.label: simple and content
ThoughtDef::BS_SimpleMind.description: Things don't need to be complicated to feel good, and mine mostly aren't. Suits me fine.

ThoughtDef::BS_VerySimpleMind.label: simple and happy
ThoughtDef::BS_VerySimpleMind.description: I don't need much to feel good, a full belly and a warm spot in the sun does it. Suits me just fine.

ThoughtDef::BS_WerewolfRage.label: the rage is taking over
ThoughtDef::BS_WerewolfRage.description: Something animal is clawing its way up from inside me and I can barely hold it back. I don't feel like myself right now.

ThoughtDef::VU_SuccubusEuphoria.label: bonded and blissful
ThoughtDef::VU_SuccubusEuphoria.description: Whatever's tying me to them, it feels good, better than good. I count myself lucky to have them.

ThoughtDef::VU_ThrallEuphoria.label: the bond's hold on me
ThoughtDef::VU_ThrallEuphoria.description: Some days that bond feels like the only safe thing I've got; other days it feels like it's cracking and I'm getting myself back. Hard to say which one scares me more.

ThoughtDef::VU_WhiteRoseEuphoria.label: feeling good
ThoughtDef::VU_WhiteRoseEuphoria.description: Can't put my finger on why, but everything feels a little brighter right now. I'll take it while it lasts.

ThoughtDef::AteFatKibble.label: ate greasy feed
ThoughtDef::AteFatKibble.description: This is stock feed, not food, but the crate's empty and my stomach doesn't get a vote. The wild fat coats my teeth and won't wash off.

ThoughtDef::DrankMossmireMilk.label: drank mossmire milk
ThoughtDef::DrankMossmireMilk.description: The moss-milk sits thick and bitter on my tongue, and the taste climbs back up an hour later. I drank it anyway — thirst wins.

ThoughtDef::MA_AfterEmberRageCrash.label: scarodon crash
ThoughtDef::MA_AfterEmberRageCrash.description: That heart-fire burned off fast and took something with it. My joints ache like I hauled scrap all night on no water.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteAminoxBlueCheese.label: ate rank blue cheese
ThoughtDef::MA_AteAminoxBlueCheese.description: This cheese aged wrong, dark veins running through a sourness that bites back. I ate it because the ration crate was empty, not because I wanted to.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteCapryakCheese.label: ate sour capryak cheese
ThoughtDef::MA_AteCapryakCheese.description: Greasy rind, a curdled center, a sourness that hits the back of my throat. Some scrap gets reused; this cheese should have been binned.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteCookedAmineMeat.label: ate amine meat
ThoughtDef::MA_AteCookedAmineMeat.description: The fat rendered down clean and the meat held together right off the fire. Good enough that I scraped the pan after.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteCookedBirdMeat.label: ate bird meat
ThoughtDef::MA_AteCookedBirdMeat.description: Nothing fancy, just clean meat cooked soft, but it sat well and filled the gap. Some meals don't need to be more than that.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteCookedCapryakMeat.label: ate capryak meat
ThoughtDef::MA_AteCookedCapryakMeat.description: Dense, plain, cooked all the way through — the kind of meal that doesn't ask questions and doesn't leave you hungry an hour later.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteCookedDunbearMeat.label: ate dunbear meat
ThoughtDef::MA_AteCookedDunbearMeat.description: The fat melted into the meat and left my hands greasy in a good way. Heavy food, but it sits like it means to keep me working.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteCookedDuskhornMeat.label: ate duskhorn roast
ThoughtDef::MA_AteCookedDuskhornMeat.description: The marbling melted straight into the meat, buttery enough that I was still tasting it an hour after the fire went cold.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteCookedGnautBeef.label: ate gnaut beef
ThoughtDef::MA_AteCookedGnautBeef.description: Plain cooked beef, nothing more to say about it. Filled me up, no complaints, back to work.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteCookedHellboarMeat.label: ate hellboar ribs
ThoughtDef::MA_AteCookedHellboarMeat.description: The fat rendered down thick and savory, the kind of meal that makes the whole crew go quiet while they eat it.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteCookedHorseBeef.label: ate direhorse beef
ThoughtDef::MA_AteCookedHorseBeef.description: Hearty cuts, well-cooked, the kind of warmth that settles in the gut on a cold desert night.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteCookedMycorgloomSpore.label: ate glowspore mash
ThoughtDef::MA_AteCookedMycorgloomSpore.description: The spores came out strange and glowing on the plate, but the flavor was rich enough that I forgot to be suspicious. My head feels clear after.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteCookedPlastemmothMeat.label: ate plastemmoth meat
ThoughtDef::MA_AteCookedPlastemmothMeat.description: Dense as scrap-metal and tastes almost like it too, fat and iron together. Rare cut, and somehow I feel sharper for eating it.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteCookedScarodonMeat.label: ate scarodon meat
ThoughtDef::MA_AteCookedScarodonMeat.description: Smoky, rich, and still warm no matter how long it sat — a rare cut that left a heat in my chest long after the plate was empty.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteCookedSivatheriumMeat.label: ate sivatherium meat
ThoughtDef::MA_AteCookedSivatheriumMeat.description: Slow-cooked fat melted down into the meat and filled the whole tent with the smell. Worth the wait, worth the fuel it cost to cook.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteCookedSporemoleMeat.label: ate sporemole meat
ThoughtDef::MA_AteCookedSporemoleMeat.description: Cooked it as long as the fire allowed and it still tastes like a cellar. The mold smell doesn't cook out, apparently.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteCookedWildFat.label: ate rendered wild fat
ThoughtDef::MA_AteCookedWildFat.description: Rendered it down over the fire until it turned the whole meal rich and warm. Simple trick, but it works every time.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteCookedWorhinMeat.label: ate worhin meat
ThoughtDef::MA_AteCookedWorhinMeat.description: The marbling melted into something rich and heavy, the kind of meal that leaves a warmth behind long after the plate's clean.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteDuskhornCheese.label: ate spoiled duskhorn cheese
ThoughtDef::MA_AteDuskhornCheese.description: Greasy pink rind, sour all the way through, heavy in a way that isn't good heavy. I ate it because it was there.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteEmberheartSlice.label: ate scarodon heart
ThoughtDef::MA_AteEmberheartSlice.description: The heart pulsed with heat going down and now there's fire in my chest. I feel strong enough to take on a raider twice my size.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteFriedLegs.label: ate fried beast-legs
ThoughtDef::MA_AteFriedLegs.description: Crispy skin, heavy fat underneath, off something big enough to matter. Good eating, and I don't ask which beast.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteGiantFriedEgg.label: ate a giant fried egg
ThoughtDef::MA_AteGiantFriedEgg.description: One egg from something enormous fed half the crew. Simple food, but rare enough out here to feel like a small win.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteHarpeagleLegsCooked.label: ate harpeagle legs
ThoughtDef::MA_AteHarpeagleLegsCooked.description: Roasted right, tender all the way through — the kind of meal you don't get twice a season out here.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteHarpeagleLegsRaw.label: ate raw harpeagle legs
ThoughtDef::MA_AteHarpeagleLegsRaw.description: Greasy and sinewy, and the gamey aftertaste is still sitting in my mouth. Should have waited for the fire.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteHellboarLiverSlice.label: hellboar liver crash
ThoughtDef::MA_AteHellboarLiverSlice.description: That liver won't leave my mouth no matter how much water I drink. My stomach's turning and my head's not much better.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteHippoMeatCooked.label: ate furpotamus meat
ThoughtDef::MA_AteHippoMeatCooked.description: Slow-cooked and dripping with fat, the kind of meal the crew fights over the last piece of.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteHippoMeatRaw.label: ate raw furpotamus meat
ThoughtDef::MA_AteHippoMeatRaw.description: Thick with fat and wrapped in leather-tough tissue — chewing it felt like gnawing on a grease-soaked belt strap.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteMarrowJelly.label: ate marrow jelly
ThoughtDef::MA_AteMarrowJelly.description: Filled the gap, but it sat greasy and heavy the whole way down. Not food I'd choose twice.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteMeatshroomBolus.label: ate meatshroom bolus
ThoughtDef::MA_AteMeatshroomBolus.description: Choked down a lump of quivering fungus-flesh that smelled like rot and old blood. I'll go hungry before I touch that again.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteMegaBacon.label: ate megabacon
ThoughtDef::MA_AteMegaBacon.description: Thick strips of rendered wild fat off something colossal, fried until it crackled. Greasy, heavy, and exactly what a long shift deserves.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteMegaBeef.label: ate megabeef
ThoughtDef::MA_AteMegaBeef.description: A thick cut off something huge, grilled well and seasoned with its own fat. Hearty enough to carry me through a full watch.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteRaptorkhanMeatCooked.label: ate raptorkhan meat
ThoughtDef::MA_AteRaptorkhanMeatCooked.description: Rich and smoky, cooked off the king-beast itself. The old hands say it puts some of its strength in you — I'm not arguing after that meal.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteRaptorkhanMeatRaw.label: ate raw raptorkhan meat
ThoughtDef::MA_AteRaptorkhanMeatRaw.description: Dark, sinewy, and bitter with a copper tang of blood. Some say the beast's fury comes with it — mostly what came with it was regret.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteRawAmineMeat.label: ate raw amine meat
ThoughtDef::MA_AteRawAmineMeat.description: The pink fat had a strange sweetness to it, almost chemical, like something that was never meant to be cooked at all.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteRawBirdMeat.label: ate raw bird meat
ThoughtDef::MA_AteRawBirdMeat.description: Tough and fibrous, with a mineral aftertaste that stuck around. Should have waited on the fire.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteRawCapryakMeat.label: ate raw capryak meat
ThoughtDef::MA_AteRawCapryakMeat.description: Dense and fibrous, gamey enough to fight back on the way down, and the cold tallow aftertaste didn't help.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteRawDunbearMeat.label: ate raw dunbear meat
ThoughtDef::MA_AteRawDunbearMeat.description: Dense, earthy, heavy with cold tallow — it clung to my mouth like chewing on iron and fat together.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteRawDuskhornMeat.label: ate raw duskhorn meat
ThoughtDef::MA_AteRawDuskhornMeat.description: The marbled fat coated my mouth in a cloying grease that wouldn't clear. Far too rich to eat without a fire first.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteRawGnautBeef.label: ate raw gnaut beef
ThoughtDef::MA_AteRawGnautBeef.description: Tough, stringy, and gamey enough that my jaw's still tired from it. Not worth the water it took to wash down.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteRawHellboarMeat.label: ate raw hellboar meat
ThoughtDef::MA_AteRawHellboarMeat.description: Thick and greasy, the fat clung to my teeth and the meat fought back the whole way. Heavy, unpleasant, done.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteRawHorseBeef.label: ate raw direhorse meat
ThoughtDef::MA_AteRawHorseBeef.description: Feral and iron-laced, powerful in a way that's more unsettling than good. I'd rather have had a fire under it.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteRawMycorgloomSpore.label: ate raw glowspores
ThoughtDef::MA_AteRawMycorgloomSpore.description: Acrid and moldy, unsettling to chew — they left a burning fungal aftertaste I'm still trying to spit out.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteRawPlastemmothMeat.label: ate raw plastemmoth meat
ThoughtDef::MA_AteRawPlastemmothMeat.description: Tough, full of sharp metal fibers, tasting like blood and rust together. This is scrap you're not supposed to eat.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteRawScarodonMeat.label: ate raw scarodon meat
ThoughtDef::MA_AteRawScarodonMeat.description: Cold on the outside, strangely warm inside — chewy, wild, tasting of iron and smoke. This beast was never meant to be eaten straight off the kill.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteRawSivatheriumMeat.label: ate raw sivatherium meat
ThoughtDef::MA_AteRawSivatheriumMeat.description: Dense, oily, every bite like chewing cold marrow wrapped in fat. The musky aftertaste lingered long past the meal.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteRawSporemoleMeat.label: ate raw sporemole meat
ThoughtDef::MA_AteRawSporemoleMeat.description: Dense and saturated with spores — every bite felt like chewing rot straight off the ground.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteRawWildFat.label: ate raw wild fat
ThoughtDef::MA_AteRawWildFat.description: A cold, yellow, gelatinous lump straight from the carcass. My stomach's still deciding whether to keep it down.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteRawWorhinMeat.label: ate raw worhin meat
ThoughtDef::MA_AteRawWorhinMeat.description: Heavy and metallic, the fibers chewed like copper wire soaked in blood. Overwhelming, and not in a good way.

ThoughtDef::MA_AteWildButter.label: ate wild butter
ThoughtDef::MA_AteWildButter.description: A dense, greasy block of preserved fat, nothing elegant about it. Rich enough to keep the hunger off for a good while though.

ThoughtDef::MA_DrankCaprodka.label: drank caprodka
ThoughtDef::MA_DrankCaprodka.description: Thick, sour, and strong enough to burn on the way down and warm from the inside out. Exactly what a cold night calls for.

ThoughtDef::MA_DrankCapryakMilk.label: drank capryak milk
ThoughtDef::MA_DrankCapryakMilk.description: Thick, bitter, and sour enough to burn across my tongue, coating my mouth like grease. Still, it fills the tank when there's nothing else.

ThoughtDef::MA_DrankDuskyakult.label: drank duskyakult
ThoughtDef::MA_DrankDuskyakult.description: Fermented duskhorn milk, rosy and sweet-sour, nothing complicated about it. Simple drink, but it went down easy.

ThoughtDef::MA_DrankHellboarLiverPotionC.label: hellboar tonic crash
ThoughtDef::MA_DrankHellboarLiverPotionC.description: That liver tonic dulled the pain going in, but now it's clawing through my gut on the way out. I feel hollow and weak, poisoned by my own cure.

ThoughtDef::MA_DrankMossmireMilk.label: drank mossmire milk
ThoughtDef::MA_DrankMossmireMilk.description: Thick and herbal with a rot creeping in underneath — unpleasant enough to remember, though it did keep my stomach quiet.

ThoughtDef::MA_DrankScarodonHeartPotionC.label: scarodon tonic crash
ThoughtDef::MA_DrankScarodonHeartPotionC.description: That bottled heart-fire hit harder than the meat ever did. My muscles ache, my nerves are still burning, and the rage hasn't fully let go.

ThoughtDef::MA_DrankSivaDustIvoryPotionC.label: sivadust tonic crash
ThoughtDef::MA_DrankSivaDustIvoryPotionC.description: The dust settled in too deep this time. My head's calm enough, but my body feels far away and slow to answer.

ThoughtDef::MA_SivaDustHighThought.label: sivadust high
ThoughtDef::MA_SivaDustHighThought.description: The dust runs warm and heavy through me, calm as still air. My thoughts echo slow, like machinery running somewhere far off.

ThoughtDef::MA_SkyfeatherHighThought.label: skyfeather clarity
ThoughtDef::MA_SkyfeatherHighThought.description: Something of the harpeagle is in me now — my eyes are sharp, my hands steady, and nothing I aim at gets to hide.

ThoughtDef::MA_UsedAmineSerum.label: amine serum strain
ThoughtDef::MA_UsedAmineSerum.description: The serum dulled the pain and set my blood racing, but it took something out of my head on the way. I feel scraped hollow.

ThoughtDef::AteAcklayClaw.label: ate acklay claw
ThoughtDef::AteAcklayClaw.description: Tender enough to fall apart on the fork, with a buttery sweetness that hangs around after the plate's empty. Good eating off a mean animal.

ThoughtDef::AteBloddle.label: ate bloddle
ThoughtDef::AteBloddle.description: Something about cooked bloddle just smells right the moment it hits the pan. Simple meal, but it made the whole camp look over.

ThoughtDef::AteChakroot.label: ate chak-root
ThoughtDef::AteChakroot.description: That tangy sweetness is unmistakable once you've had it — chak-root, and no mistaking it for scrap-grown filler.

ThoughtDef::AteChrysalideHeart.label: ate rancor heart
ThoughtDef::AteChrysalideHeart.description: There's something in that meat working through me now — my hands feel steadier, my grip feels stronger. I could haul twice the load tonight.

ThoughtDef::AteCrustapodRoe.label: ate crustapod roe
ThoughtDef::AteCrustapodRoe.description: Rich, creamy, and worth more than the water it took to prepare. A find like this doesn't come along often.

ThoughtDef::AteDoshianJelly.label: ate doshian jelly
ThoughtDef::AteDoshianJelly.description: Can't tell if that was flavor or my mouth just objecting to it. Strange stuff, but I finished the bowl anyway.

ThoughtDef::AteFleekEel.label: ate fleek eel
ThoughtDef::AteFleekEel.description: Rich, fatty flesh that melts before you're done chewing it. A delicacy out here, and I'm not sharing the last piece.

ThoughtDef::AteGorntMeat.label: ate gornt meat
ThoughtDef::AteGorntMeat.description: Good, honest meat with real flavor to it. Whatever a gornt is, it eats well.

ThoughtDef::AteHawkbatEgg.label: ate hawkbat egg
ThoughtDef::AteHawkbatEgg.description: One egg, and it tasted like something a moisture farmer only dreams about. Whatever laid it, I owe it thanks.

ThoughtDef::AteJoganFruit.label: ate jogan fruit
ThoughtDef::AteJoganFruit.description: Sweet, crisp, unmistakably jogan. Real fruit out here is rarer than good chrome.

ThoughtDef::AteManaxFungus.label: ate manax fungus
ThoughtDef::AteManaxFungus.description: Aromatic and sharp enough to clear my sinuses. No wonder the traders charge what they do for it.

ThoughtDef::AteMeiloorun.label: ate meiloorun
ThoughtDef::AteMeiloorun.description: Juicy and cool going down, a real treat against the heat. Wish the crate held more than one.

ThoughtDef::AteMudhornEgg.label: ate mudhorn egg
ThoughtDef::AteMudhornEgg.description: Utini! Best thing I've eaten all week, and I'm not explaining any further than that.

ThoughtDef::AteMujaFruit.label: ate muja fruit
ThoughtDef::AteMujaFruit.description: Sweet all the way through, no argument needed. Muja fruit, and it didn't last long once the crew smelled it.

ThoughtDef::AteMunchFungus.label: ate munch-fungus
ThoughtDef::AteMunchFungus.description: Prepared right, munch-fungus turns into almost anything you need it to be. Good, reliable eating.

ThoughtDef::AteMunchFungusBread.label: ate munch-fungus bread
ThoughtDef::AteMunchFungusBread.description: Warm and filling, baked the way it should be. Tastes like something from home, back when the clan still had a real oven.

ThoughtDef::AteNexuTongue.label: ate nexu tongue
ThoughtDef::AteNexuTongue.description: Chewy in a way I wasn't expecting, with a texture nothing else out here really matches. Strange, but I'd eat it again.

ThoughtDef::AtePaddyFrog.label: ate paddy frog
ThoughtDef::AtePaddyFrog.description: Swear the legs were still kicking when they hit my teeth. Ate so much I felt fat and lazy as a Hutt afterward.

ThoughtDef::AteRawMunchFungus.label: ate raw munch-fungus
ThoughtDef::AteRawMunchFungus.description: Ixta! Spongy, bland, and clearly meant for the fire, not straight off the stalk. Won't make that mistake twice.

ThoughtDef::AteRikknitOvum.label: ate rikknit ovum
ThoughtDef::AteRikknitOvum.description: The smell nearly stopped me before the first bite, but underneath it was something exquisite. Worth pushing through the stink.

ThoughtDef::AteRycritMeat.label: ate rycrit meat
ThoughtDef::AteRycritMeat.description: Real flavor, no mistaking it for anything else. Whatever a rycrit is, I'd hunt another.

ThoughtDef::AteTachGland.label: ate tach gland
ThoughtDef::AteTachGland.description: What was I thinking? Bitter, foul, and I knew halfway through swallowing it that this was a mistake.

ThoughtDef::AteTenderMeat.label: ate tender meat
ThoughtDef::AteTenderMeat.description: Tender, fatty, and gone before I really got to enjoy it. That's the kind of meal I don't get often enough.

ThoughtDef::AteToughMeat.label: ate tough meat
ThoughtDef::AteToughMeat.description: Chewed on that for longer than I ate it. Tough as old harness leather and about as satisfying.

ThoughtDef::DrankBlueMilk.label: drank blue milk
ThoughtDef::DrankBlueMilk.description: Can't really argue with a mug of blue milk. Simple, cold, and it does the job every time.

ThoughtDef::DrankGreenMilk.label: drank green milk
ThoughtDef::DrankGreenMilk.description: Whatever made that had already gone bad before it ever left the animal. My mouth hasn't forgiven me yet.

ThoughtDef::GlitterstimHigh.label: high on glitterstim
ThoughtDef::GlitterstimHigh.description: Everything's clearer than it should be, like the whole desert opened up just for me. I feel like I could see clean across the dunes to the horizon and past it.

ThoughtDef::GlitterstimWithdrawal.label: glitterstim withdrawal
ThoughtDef::GlitterstimWithdrawal.description: My thoughts won't hold still and my own skull feels like a cage around them. Even my eyes won't focus right.

ThoughtDef::JiRikknitHigh.label: high on ji rikknit
ThoughtDef::JiRikknitHigh.description: Everything's soft and drifting, like I'm floating in a warm purple current with nowhere I need to be.

ThoughtDef::JiRikknitWithdrawal.label: ji rikknit withdrawal
ThoughtDef::JiRikknitWithdrawal.description: Keep hearing little clicking legs in my sleep, like something's climbing through the tent that isn't really there.

ThoughtDef::SoothingSong.label: heard a soothing song
ThoughtDef::SoothingSong.description: Something out there sang low and calm, and for a minute the whole camp went quiet to listen. Felt like a dream I didn't want to wake from.

ThoughtDef::SpatOn.label: got spat on
ThoughtDef::SpatOn.description: Schutta! That beast hocked something foul straight at me and I didn't even see it coming. Still smells like it, too.

ThoughtDef::Webbed.label: got webbed
ThoughtDef::Webbed.description: Something sticky is stuck to half my gear now and I still don't know what spat it at me. Going to be picking it off for days.

ThoughtDef::AA_AteBlackTruffleIngredient.label: ate black truffle
ThoughtDef::AA_AteBlackTruffleIngredient.description: Real truffle, dug up clean and eaten fresh. Out here that's worth more than most of what's in my pack.

ThoughtDef::AA_AteHorribleRot.label: ate rotting scrap-greens
ThoughtDef::AA_AteHorribleRot.description: I scavenged fermented, rotting plant matter just to keep moving. Worse than eating a corpse — if this is what it takes to survive out here, I don't like what's coming.

ThoughtDef::AA_AteSuperAwfulMeal.label: ate an abomination's leavings
ThoughtDef::AA_AteSuperAwfulMeal.description: That meal came out of the guts of something that shouldn't exist, half metal and half rot. I've eaten corpses that sat better than this.

ThoughtDef::AA_BeenPsionicallyNuzzled.label: psionically nuzzled
ThoughtDef::AA_BeenPsionicallyNuzzled.description: That fox pressed against me and something warm and unearned washed through my head. Feels good, feels loved, feels like it isn't entirely mine.

ThoughtDef::AA_Disgust.label: saw a disgusting creature
ThoughtDef::AA_Disgust.description: That slug reeked of old corpse-rot from ten paces off. My stomach's still turning just thinking about it.

ThoughtDef::AA_PhotosensitiveExoskeleton.label: sun-blind and dazed
ThoughtDef::AA_PhotosensitiveExoskeleton.description: What? Where — the light just hit me wrong and everything went white for a second. Still shaking off the fog.

ThoughtDef::AA_PsychicHarmonyBad.label: psychic pain nearby
ThoughtDef::AA_PsychicHarmonyBad.description: Something out there is hurting bad, and its pain is leaking straight into my skull. Can't think past it.

ThoughtDef::AA_PsychicHarmonyGood.label: psychic calm nearby
ThoughtDef::AA_PsychicHarmonyGood.description: Something out there is fed, safe, and content, and I can feel a thread of that settle into me too.

ThoughtDef::AA_UncomfortablyHot.label: ate burning wasp eggs
ThoughtDef::AA_UncomfortablyHot.description: Whatever was in those eggs is still burning down my throat and it isn't letting up. Should have checked the ration crate closer.

ThoughtDef::VRESaurids_KilledEggChildTho.label: killed a hatchling
ThoughtDef::VRESaurids_KilledEggChildTho.description: It hadn't even cracked fully out of the shell and I ended it anyway. There's no angle I can look at that from where it feels right.

ThoughtDef::VRESaurids_KilledEggChild_Op.label: they killed a hatchling
ThoughtDef::VRESaurids_KilledEggChild_Op.description: Word's gotten around about the hatchling that never got a chance to open its eyes. I don't think less of the crew for surviving out here, but I haven't forgotten it either.

ThoughtDef::VRESaurids_PheromoneThought.label: a comforting scent
ThoughtDef::VRESaurids_PheromoneThought.description: Something in the air smells like safety, like there's someone nearby who isn't going to let the sand get me. Steadies my nerves more than it should.

ThoughtDef::AlienVsXenophobia.label: feelings about the outworlder
ThoughtDef::AlienVsXenophobia.description: Not everyone in the crew was born under our sun. Some of us find that fascinating, some can't get past it.

ThoughtDef::HAR_AlienDating_Horrible.label: dated an outworlder
ThoughtDef::HAR_AlienDating_Horrible.description: I let myself get close to someone who isn't one of us, and meant it. Now I can't look at myself straight.

ThoughtDef::HAR_AlienDating_Know_Honorab.label: one of ours, dating out
ThoughtDef::HAR_AlienDating_Know_Honorab.description: Word's gone round that someone's seeing an outworlder. Good for them, love doesn't check your papers.

ThoughtDef::HAR_AlienDating_Know_Horribl.label: one of ours, dating out
ThoughtDef::HAR_AlienDating_Know_Horribl.description: Word's gone round that someone's seeing an outworlder. It sits wrong with me, whatever they say about it.

ThoughtDef::HAR_AlienRaces_Abhorrent.label: can't stand outworlders
ThoughtDef::HAR_AlienRaces_Abhorrent.description: There are outworlders on this crew and every one of them turns my stomach. I don't care what they can build or fix, I want them gone.

ThoughtDef::HAR_AlienRaces_Abhorrent_Soc.label: revolted by the outworlder
ThoughtDef::HAR_AlienRaces_Abhorrent_Soc.description: Every time that outworlder opens its mouth I want to walk the other way. I can't stand being near it.

ThoughtDef::HAR_AlienRaces_Exalted.label: honored by outworlders
ThoughtDef::HAR_AlienRaces_Exalted.description: I'm crewed up with folk from worlds I've never even seen the sky of. Every day feels like the start of a good story.

ThoughtDef::HAR_AlienRaces_Exalted_Socia.label: in awe of the outworlder
ThoughtDef::HAR_AlienRaces_Exalted_Socia.description: That outworlder is unlike anyone I've worked beside before, and I like it. Every conversation is worth more than the usual scrap-talk.

ThoughtDef::HAR_AlienRaces_Horrible_Soci.label: distrust for outworlders
ThoughtDef::HAR_AlienRaces_Horrible_Soci.description: I keep half an eye on the ones who aren't like us. Old habit maybe, but it doesn't feel wrong to keep it.

ThoughtDef::HAR_AlienRaces_Respected_Soc.label: respect for outworlders
ThoughtDef::HAR_AlienRaces_Respected_Soc.description: The outworlders on this crew pull their weight same as anyone. I've stopped counting that as surprising.

ThoughtDef::HAR_AlienVsXenophobia.label: feelings about the outworlder
ThoughtDef::HAR_AlienVsXenophobia.description: Not everyone in the crew was born under our sun. Some of us find that fascinating, some can't get past it.

ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_EnslavedPrisoner_D.label: put an outworlder in chains
ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_EnslavedPrisoner_D.description: I collared a prisoner who wasn't even one of our own kind. I keep turning it over trying to make it sit right, and it doesn't.

ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_EnslavedPrisoner_H.label: broke an outworlder to heel
ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_EnslavedPrisoner_H.description: I took a prisoner who wasn't kin and made them understand who holds the collar now. That's how the strong keep what they take.

ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_EnslavedPrisoner_H.label: put an outworlder in chains
