ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_EnslavedPrisoner_H.description: I forced a collar onto someone who never wronged me, just because they weren't kin. I don't have a good answer for why.

ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_EnslavedPrisoner_K.label: the crew enslaved an outworlder
ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_EnslavedPrisoner_K.description: Somebody on this crew put a collar on a prisoner who wasn't kin, and I can't stop thinking about it. It's the kind of thing that should cost us something.

ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_EnslavedPrisoner_K.label: the crew enslaved an outworlder
ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_EnslavedPrisoner_K.description: Somebody collared a prisoner who wasn't kin. I don't like it, even if nobody's asking my opinion.

ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_EnslavedPrisoner_K.label: we collared an outworlder
ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_EnslavedPrisoner_K.description: We put chains on a prisoner who wasn't one of our own kind. It didn't need to go that way.

ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_EnslavedPrisoner_K.label: the crew enslaved an outworlder
ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_EnslavedPrisoner_K.description: Somebody on this crew broke a prisoner who wasn't kin to the collar, and good. That's the kind of strength that keeps a clan fed.

ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_EnslavedPrisoner_K.label: we collared an outworlder
ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_EnslavedPrisoner_K.description: We took a prisoner who wasn't kin and showed them exactly whose crew this is. Let word of it travel.

ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_EnslavedPrisoner_K.label: the crew enslaved an outworlder
ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_EnslavedPrisoner_K.description: Somebody put a collar on a prisoner who wasn't kin, and it turns my stomach that it happened on my watch.

ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_EnslavedPrisoner_K.label: we collared an outworlder
ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_EnslavedPrisoner_K.description: We chained someone who could think and feel same as any of us, just because they weren't kin. That's not something I'll be proud of.

ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_Slavery_Abhorrent_.label: keeping outworlder slaves
ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_Slavery_Abhorrent_.description: We've got collared outworlders working the camp day after day. Every time I pass them it feels like something we'll answer for.

ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_Slavery_Disapprove.label: keeping outworlder slaves
ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_Slavery_Disapprove.description: We keep collared outworlders around because we need the hands. I understand why, and I still don't like walking past them.

ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_Slavery_Honorable_.label: no outworlder slaves to show
ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_Slavery_Honorable_.description: We don't keep a single collared outworlder in camp. Other crews will read that as weakness, and they wouldn't be wrong to.

ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_Slavery_Honorable_.label: outworlder slaves in camp
ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_Slavery_Honorable_.description: We keep collared outworlders working the camp, and it shows. A crew that can take and hold is a crew that's going somewhere.

ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_Slavery_Horrible_S.label: keeping outworlder slaves
ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_Slavery_Horrible_S.description: We keep collared outworlders in camp and call it business. It's not business, it's wrong, and I know it.

ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_SoldSlave_Disappro.label: sold an outworlder off
ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_SoldSlave_Disappro.description: I traded away a collared outworlder for scrap and credits. I keep hoping whoever bought them isn't as bad as they could be.

ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_SoldSlave_Honorabl.label: sold an outworlder off
ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_SoldSlave_Honorabl.description: I traded a collared outworlder to another crew for a good price. Word of a deal like that travels, and it travels well for me.

ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_SoldSlave_Horrible.label: sold an outworlder off
ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_SoldSlave_Horrible.description: I handed a collared outworlder over to strangers for a price, and I don't know where they ended up. That's going to sit with me a long time.

ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_SoldSlave_Know_Abh.label: the crew sold an outworlder
ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_SoldSlave_Know_Abh.description: Somebody on this crew traded away a collared outworlder like a spare part. I can't square that with anything I believe.

ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_SoldSlave_Know_Abh.label: we sold an outworlder
ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_SoldSlave_Know_Abh.description: We traded a collared outworlder off to strangers for parts and credits. There's no dressing that up as anything but wrong.

ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_SoldSlave_Know_Dis.label: the crew sold an outworlder
ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_SoldSlave_Know_Dis.description: Somebody traded a collared outworlder away and I only heard about it after. I don't like that it happened.

ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_SoldSlave_Know_Dis.label: we sold an outworlder
ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_SoldSlave_Know_Dis.description: We traded a collared outworlder off for the profit in it. It didn't sit right at the time and it still doesn't.

ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_SoldSlave_Know_Hon.label: the crew sold an outworlder
ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_SoldSlave_Know_Hon.description: Somebody on this crew traded a collared outworlder for a fine price, and I respect the hustle.

ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_SoldSlave_Know_Hon.label: we sold an outworlder
ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_SoldSlave_Know_Hon.description: We traded a collared outworlder off and got a price worth bragging about. That's the kind of deal that puts a crew on the map.

ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_SoldSlave_Know_Hor.label: the crew sold an outworlder
ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_SoldSlave_Know_Hor.description: Somebody traded away a collared outworlder for scrap money, and it makes me sick to think it was one of ours.

ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_SoldSlave_Know_Hor.label: we sold an outworlder
ThoughtDef::HAR_Alien_SoldSlave_Know_Hor.description: We handed a collared outworlder to strangers for a price. Whatever we told ourselves at the time, it was a rotten thing to do.

ThoughtDef::HAR_AteAlienMeat_Abhorrent.label: ate an outworlder's flesh
ThoughtDef::HAR_AteAlienMeat_Abhorrent.description: There was no other food and I ate meat cut from someone who could think and talk same as me. Everything in me says that was wrong.

ThoughtDef::HAR_AteAlienMeat_Disapproved.label: ate an outworlder's flesh
ThoughtDef::HAR_AteAlienMeat_Disapproved.description: I ate meat cut from a sapient outworlder because there was nothing else. I believe it was wrong, even hungry as I was.

ThoughtDef::HAR_AteAlienMeat_Know_Abhorr.label: someone ate an outworlder
ThoughtDef::HAR_AteAlienMeat_Know_Abhorr.description: Somebody on this crew ate the flesh of a thinking outworlder, and knowing it happened at all makes my skin crawl.

ThoughtDef::HAR_AteAlienMeat_Know_Disapp.label: someone ate an outworlder
ThoughtDef::HAR_AteAlienMeat_Know_Disapp.description: Somebody on this crew ate outworlder meat. I understand hunger, I still don't like that it happened.

ThoughtDef::HAR_AteAlienMeat_Preferred.label: ate an outworlder's flesh
ThoughtDef::HAR_AteAlienMeat_Preferred.description: I ate meat cut from an outworlder, and I felt stronger for it, not sicker. That's just how my kind is built.

ThoughtDef::HAR_AteAlienMeat_RequiredStr.label: ate an outworlder's flesh
ThoughtDef::HAR_AteAlienMeat_RequiredStr.description: I ate outworlder meat like any proper person would. Anyone who won't isn't worth much in my book.

ThoughtDef::HAR_AteNonAlienFood_Horrible.label: ate the wrong meal
ThoughtDef::HAR_AteNonAlienFood_Horrible.description: I ate a meal that wasn't cut from an outworlder, and my gut is telling me I've broken something I shouldn't have.

ThoughtDef::HAR_AteNonAlienFood_Know_Hor.label: someone ate the wrong meal
ThoughtDef::HAR_AteNonAlienFood_Know_Hor.description: Somebody on this crew ate a meal that wasn't outworlder meat, and it's not sitting right with the rest of us who hold to the old way.

ThoughtDef::HAR_ButcheredAlien_Abhorrent.label: butchered an outworlder
ThoughtDef::HAR_ButcheredAlien_Abhorrent.description: I took a knife to a body that could once think and talk, same as me. There's no scrap-logic that makes that sit easy.

ThoughtDef::HAR_ButcheredAlien_Disapprov.label: butchered an outworlder
ThoughtDef::HAR_ButcheredAlien_Disapprov.description: I broke down an outworlder's body same as I would a carcass. I believe it was wrong, whatever use we got out of it.

ThoughtDef::HAR_ButcheredAlien_Know_Abho.label: the crew butchered an outworlder
ThoughtDef::HAR_ButcheredAlien_Know_Abho.description: Someone on this crew took a knife to a sapient outworlder's body. That's not a line I ever wanted to see crossed.

ThoughtDef::HAR_ButcheredAlien_Know_Abho.label: the butcher among us
ThoughtDef::HAR_ButcheredAlien_Know_Abho.description: I know what that one did to an outworlder's body with a knife, and I can't unknow it. It changes how I look at them.

ThoughtDef::HAR_ButcheredAlien_Know_Disa.label: the crew butchered an outworlder
ThoughtDef::HAR_ButcheredAlien_Know_Disa.description: Someone on this crew broke down an outworlder's body like a carcass. I don't think that was right, even out here.

ThoughtDef::HAR_ButcheredAlien_Know_Disa.label: the butcher among us
ThoughtDef::HAR_ButcheredAlien_Know_Disa.description: I know what that one did with a knife to an outworlder's body. It's not something I've forgotten.

ThoughtDef::HAR_NoRecentAlienMeat_Prefer.label: craving outworlder meat
ThoughtDef::HAR_NoRecentAlienMeat_Prefer.description: It's been too long since I had a proper cut of outworlder meat. Something in me is starting to feel off about it.

ThoughtDef::HAR_NoRecentAlienMeat_Requir.label: starving for outworlder meat
ThoughtDef::HAR_NoRecentAlienMeat_Requir.description: It's been far, far too long since I had outworlder flesh, and my body knows it. I should've eaten it by now, and I haven't.

ThoughtDef::HAR_XenophobeVsXenophile.label: clash over the outworlders
ThoughtDef::HAR_XenophobeVsXenophile.description: One of us can't stand having outworlders around, another can't get enough of them. That difference is going to keep grinding at both of them.

ThoughtDef::HAR_XenophobiaVsAlien.label: opinion split on outworlders
ThoughtDef::HAR_XenophobiaVsAlien.description: Some of us take to the outworlders on this crew right away, some can't stand having them near. It splits down predictable lines.

ThoughtDef::XenophobeVsXenophile.label: clash over the outworlders
ThoughtDef::XenophobeVsXenophile.description: One of us can't stand having outworlders around, another can't get enough of them. That difference is going to keep grinding at both of them.

ThoughtDef::XenophobiaVsAlien.label: opinion split on outworlders
ThoughtDef::XenophobiaVsAlien.description: Some of us take to the outworlders on this crew right away, some can't stand having them near. It splits down predictable lines.

ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Archot.label: the implant's displeasure
ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Archot.description: There's an archotech piece grafted into me, and lately it feels like it's unhappy with something I've done. I can't tell what, and that's the worst part.

ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Biophi.label: glad for the living ones
ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Biophi.description: There's flesh-and-blood folk on this crew, breathing and growing same as anything natural should. I like having them close.

ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Biophi.label: working with living things
ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Biophi.description: My hands were in soil and growing things today instead of wire and plating. There's nothing like it, life doing what life does.

ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Biophi.label: good to have organics around
ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Biophi.description: The camp's got a healthy share of living, breathing crew and growing things in it. Feels less like a machine shop and more like a home.

ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Biophi.label: hated the hunt
ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Biophi.description: I had to put down an animal today, and every part of me that loves living things fought that order. It shouldn't have been me.

ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Biopho.label: wary of the living ones
ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Biopho.description: There's flesh-and-blood folk on this crew, all mess and rot waiting to happen. I keep my distance where I can.

ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Biopho.label: biomimetics still unsettle me
ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Biopho.description: We've got biomimetic crew now, built better than the organics by any measure I trust. Doesn't stop the sight of them from crawling under my plating.

ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Biopho.label: too many organics around
ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Biopho.description: Wherever I turn there's another soft, breathing thing in the camp, and I don't trust any of them not to break down or rot on me.

ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Biopho.label: resent the biophobe
ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Biopho.description: That one won't even look at living crew without a sneer. I've had enough of the attitude.

ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Biopho.label: handling organics again
ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Biopho.description: I had to work with something alive, or worse, something that used to be. Rot, mess, unpredictable matter. I want to scrub my hands off.

ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Coerci.label: the threatening voice
ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Coerci.description: That one's voice box was built to put the fear in people, and it works on me too, whether I like it or not.

ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Cohere.label: coherence failing
ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Cohere.description: I haven't had a real chance to run diagnostics or clear my error logs in far too long. Things are stacking up in there that I can't get to.

ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Cohere.label: coherence failing
ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Cohere.description: My core's overdue for maintenance and the errors are piling up. I don't need much to fix it, but I need something.

ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Cohere.label: coherence failing
ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Cohere.description: My systems are choking on unresolved errors because nobody's given me proper maintenance time. I need it, and I need it now.

ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Cohere.label: coherence failing
ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Cohere.description: Errors keep stacking in my core from all the maintenance I haven't had. It should bother me more than it does.

ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Cohere.label: a part running wrong
ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Cohere.description: One of my components has been running below spec for too long now, and nobody's gotten around to fixing it. Inconvenient doesn't cover it.

ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Cohere.label: seeing static and ghosts
ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Cohere.description: My eyes are feeding me things that aren't there, and I can't tell anymore what's real and what's a bad sensor. It's maddening.

ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Cohere.label: rust on my frame
ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Cohere.description: There's actual rust creeping across my plating, out here in the sun and sand where anyone can see it. It's humiliating to walk around like this.

ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Creati.label: my creation is dead
ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Creati.description: The one I built with my own hands is gone now, and I'm still running. That's not the order things were supposed to go in.

ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Creato.label: my creator is dead
ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Creato.description: The one who built me is gone, and now whatever they meant for me to be is mine alone to carry or throw away.

ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Direct.label: the friendly drone
ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Direct.description: One of our drones keeps doing small, unnecessary things that almost look like kindness. I don't have a good explanation, and I don't mind it.

ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Drones.label: too many of my model
ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Drones.description: There's a drone in camp built off the exact same line I was. Looking at it is like looking at a mirror I never asked for.

ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Induci.label: the soothing voice
ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Induci.description: That one's voice box was built to calm people down, and somehow it works on me too, every time.

ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Killed.label: killed my own creation
ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Killed.description: I built that one myself, piece by piece, and now I'm the reason it's scrap. There's no explaining that away.

ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Killed.label: killed my own creator
ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Killed.description: The one who built me is dead by my own hand. Whatever led to it, that's not a thing I get to walk back from.

ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Mental.label: chip keeping me steady
ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Mental.description: There's a chip running quietly in my head, smoothing out the worst of what I'd otherwise be carrying. I feel like I can hold this line.

ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_MyCrea.label: my creation is missing
ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_MyCrea.description: The one I built hasn't checked in and nobody's seen them. I keep telling myself they'll turn up, and I keep not quite believing it.

ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_MyCrea.label: my creator is missing
ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_MyCrea.description: The one who built me hasn't been seen in too long. I keep scanning the horizon like that'll bring them back faster.

ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Overcl.label: running overclocked
ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Overcl.description: My processor's been pushed well past its rated speed, and I can feel every cycle of it wearing on the hardware underneath.

ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Painte.label: wearing my color
ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Painte.description: Somebody finally painted me the shade I actually like. Small thing maybe, but I catch myself glancing at my own arm just to look at it.

ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Person.label: trying on a new outlook
ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Person.description: They let me shift how I see things a little, and it's interesting, actually. Not sure yet what I make of it, but I like having the room to find out.

ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Person.label: personality stuck in place
ThoughtDef::ABF_Thought_Synstruct_Person.description: I wanted to try seeing the world a little differently and was told no. Now I'm stuck being exactly who I already was, and it grates.

ThoughtDef::RhydoniumHigh.label: baked on rhydonium
ThoughtDef::RhydoniumHigh.description: I can feel the burn in the air before it even sparks. Everything's heat and friction and I'm riding right along with it.

ThoughtDef::SpiceHigh.label: riding the spice
ThoughtDef::SpiceHigh.description: The spice has my head wide open and every thought is coming in twice as bright. I can see clean through the walls of this camp right now.

ThoughtDef::deathstickHigh.label: zooted on deathsticks
ThoughtDef::deathstickHigh.description: Everything's gone soft and warm and every color out here looks better than it has any right to. For once, nothing hurts.

ThoughtDef::guy762_withdrawlthought_batt.label: off the battle stim
ThoughtDef::guy762_withdrawlthought_batt.description: My hands won't do what I tell them and every ache in my body is turned up loud. I can't hit what I'm aiming at like this.

ThoughtDef::guy762_withdrawlthought_cons.label: off the stamina stim
ThoughtDef::guy762_withdrawlthought_cons.description: My legs feel like they could give out under me at any second. I was strong an hour ago and now I feel like glass.

ThoughtDef::guy762_withdrawlthought_deat.label: off the deathsticks
ThoughtDef::guy762_withdrawlthought_deat.description: Everything feels wrong and gray and all I can think about is the next stick. I know exactly how bad that sounds and I still can't stop thinking it.

ThoughtDef::guy762_withdrawlthought_dexs.label: off the alacrity stim
ThoughtDef::guy762_withdrawlthought_dexs.description: Every motion feels like it's dragging through sand instead of air. I used to move twice this fast an hour ago.

ThoughtDef::guy762_withdrawlthought_rhyd.label: off the rhydonium
ThoughtDef::guy762_withdrawlthought_rhyd.description: My chest is tight and every breath feels like it's coming through a narrow pipe. I know exactly what would fix it, and I don't have any.

ThoughtDef::guy762_withdrawlthought_spic.label: off the spice
ThoughtDef::guy762_withdrawlthought_spic.description: My skull feels like it's closing in around my own thoughts. Everything's too tight, too small, too loud.

ThoughtDef::guy762_withdrawlthought_strs.label: off the strength stim
ThoughtDef::guy762_withdrawlthought_strs.description: My arms don't have half the strength they had yesterday. Lifting anything feels like a fight I'm losing.

ThoughtDef::BeautifulWedding.label: a fine joining
ThoughtDef::BeautifulWedding.description: Chrome polished, robes clean, the whole crew turned out for it. That's a joining worth remembering.

ThoughtDef::RomanceOnTheRim_CommonKiss.label: shared a kiss
ThoughtDef::RomanceOnTheRim_CommonKiss.description: Quick, easy, over before the sand settles. Nice all the same.

ThoughtDef::RomanceOnTheRim_CommonKissMo.label: sweet kiss
ThoughtDef::RomanceOnTheRim_CommonKissMo.description: Just a kiss, nothing more to it, but it warmed me right down to the boots.

ThoughtDef::RomanceOnTheRim_Estrange.label: grown apart
ThoughtDef::RomanceOnTheRim_Estrange.description: We used to talk. Now we pass each other like strangers sharing the same water ration.

ThoughtDef::RomanceOnTheRim_GetJoyTogeth.label: good time together
ThoughtDef::RomanceOnTheRim_GetJoyTogeth.description: We ditched the work for an hour and just enjoyed each other's company. Worth more than the scrap we didn't collect.

ThoughtDef::RomanceOnTheRim_MissingLover.label: missing my lover
ThoughtDef::RomanceOnTheRim_MissingLover.description: Every quiet moment out here turns into thinking about them. I'd trade a week's water ration for one more day together.

ThoughtDef::RomanceOnTheRim_MusicalPerfo.label: enjoyed the music
ThoughtDef::RomanceOnTheRim_MusicalPerfo.description: Someone strummed something worth hearing over the wind and the engines for once. Good on the ears.

ThoughtDef::RomanceOnTheRim_PillowTalk.label: pillow talk
ThoughtDef::RomanceOnTheRim_PillowTalk.description: Just talking in the dark after, nothing more to it. Good to feel that close to someone.

ThoughtDef::RomanceOnTheRim_ReunionMood.label: reunited with my lover
ThoughtDef::RomanceOnTheRim_ReunionMood.description: Didn't think I'd see them again this side of the dunes. Good to have them close.

ThoughtDef::RomanceOnTheRim_RomanticKiss.label: a real kiss
ThoughtDef::RomanceOnTheRim_RomanticKiss.description: Not a peck, a real one. Left me a little dazed after.

ThoughtDef::RomanceOnTheRim_RomanticKiss.label: warm and dazed
ThoughtDef::RomanceOnTheRim_RomanticKiss.description: Warm all through, head a little fuzzy. Can't ask for better than that.

ThoughtDef::RomanceOnTheRim_SkygazeToget.label: watched the stars together
ThoughtDef::RomanceOnTheRim_SkygazeToget.description: Lay out past the ridge and just watched the sky turn for a while. Quiet, and good company.

ThoughtDef::RomanceOnTheRim_Thought_Roma.label: need someone close
ThoughtDef::RomanceOnTheRim_Thought_Roma.description: Been too long without real closeness with anyone. Out here that wears on a person same as thirst does.

ThoughtDef::RomanceOnTheRim_WorryAboutLo.label: worried for my lover
ThoughtDef::RomanceOnTheRim_WorryAboutLo.description: They're sick and I can't stop turning it over in my head. Every cough out here means something.

ThoughtDef::RotR_ACAcceptedMood_Child.label: found my family
ThoughtDef::RotR_ACAcceptedMood_Child.description: Someone finally wanted me for good, not just an extra pair of hands. I feel safe here.

ThoughtDef::RotR_ACAcceptedMood_Parent.label: proud of my kid
ThoughtDef::RotR_ACAcceptedMood_Parent.description: Watching them grow braver every day. Proud to call them mine.

ThoughtDef::RotR_ACRejectedMood_Child.label: passed over again
ThoughtDef::RotR_ACRejectedMood_Child.description: Thought this crew might keep me. Guess I was asking too much. Back to drifting.

ThoughtDef::RotR_ACRejectedMood_Parent.label: second-guessing the choice
ThoughtDef::RotR_ACRejectedMood_Parent.description: Turned the kid away. Told myself it was right, but the doubt won't let go.

ThoughtDef::RotR_AHRAcceptedMood_Partner.label: finally arrived
ThoughtDef::RotR_AHRAcceptedMood_Partner.description: That trek near broke me, but I made it. Maybe there's still something here for us.

ThoughtDef::RotR_AHRJoinedMood_Colonist.label: they're staying for good
ThoughtDef::RotR_AHRJoinedMood_Colonist.description: My lover's not just visiting anymore, they're crew now. Feels like the desert finally gave me something back.

ThoughtDef::RotR_AHRJoinedMood_Partner.label: starting over here
ThoughtDef::RotR_AHRJoinedMood_Partner.description: I've thrown in with this crew for good. New sand, same hands, fresh start.

ThoughtDef::RotR_AHRLeavedMood_Colonist.label: they chose to leave
ThoughtDef::RotR_AHRLeavedMood_Colonist.description: My lover packed up and went anyway. Wish I'd said something different before they did.

ThoughtDef::RotR_AHRLeavedMood_Partner.label: time to move on
ThoughtDef::RotR_AHRLeavedMood_Partner.description: Packing up again. This place changed me more than I expected, but it's time to go.

ThoughtDef::RotR_AHRRejectedMood_Colonis.label: turned my lover away
ThoughtDef::RotR_AHRRejectedMood_Colonis.description: Wasn't the right time for them here, so I sent them off. Stings worse than I let on.

ThoughtDef::RotR_AHRRejectedMood_Partner.label: turned away again
ThoughtDef::RotR_AHRRejectedMood_Partner.description: Showed up hoping for a place here and got nothing. That's the desert for you, commitment doesn't always pay.

ThoughtDef::RotR_BoFLoverMood.label: crew watches my lover
ThoughtDef::RotR_BoFLoverMood.description: I knew the others wouldn't warm to them right away. The wary looks cut deeper than I thought they would.

ThoughtDef::RotR_BoFLoverOpinion.label: my say on their joining
ThoughtDef::RotR_BoFLoverOpinion.description: Whether my lover gets to stay here is partly on me. I'll weigh it same as I would any trade.

ThoughtDef::RotR_BoFSlaveMood.label: old chains, new looks
ThoughtDef::RotR_BoFSlaveMood.description: Free now, but I still catch eyes that haven't let go of what I used to be. The whispers follow same as the collar did.

ThoughtDef::RotR_BoFSlaveOpinion.label: my say on joining
ThoughtDef::RotR_BoFSlaveOpinion.description: The crew's deciding if I'm worth taking in. I've got a voice in it too, for what it's worth.

ThoughtDef::RotR_BoFSpecMood.label: newcomer among us
ThoughtDef::RotR_BoFSpecMood.description: Hope this one settles in without stirring trouble. Freed folk deserve the chance same as anyone.

ThoughtDef::RotR_BoFSpecOpinion.label: asked to bring them in
ThoughtDef::RotR_BoFSpecOpinion.description: Putting in a word to bring my lover into the crew proper. Figured it was worth asking.

ThoughtDef::RotR_CrushIgnoredMood.label: what if, though
ThoughtDef::RotR_CrushIgnoredMood.description: Keep wondering what would've happened if I'd said something. Probably nothing. Still wondering.

ThoughtDef::RotR_DMABetrothedMood.label: proud to be chosen
ThoughtDef::RotR_DMABetrothedMood.description: Leaving my crew behind for this match costs something, but I was picked for a reason. That counts for a lot.

ThoughtDef::RotR_DMBetrothedMood.label: a match for peace
ThoughtDef::RotR_DMBetrothedMood.description: This marriage is more about keeping peace between our peoples than anything between us. Still, it could grow into something real.

ThoughtDef::RotR_DMSuitorMood.label: bridge between two crews
ThoughtDef::RotR_DMSuitorMood.description: Left everything I knew to come stand here as the bridge between our people. Determined to make it hold.

ThoughtDef::RotR_KTRefusedMood.label: the trade fell through
ThoughtDef::RotR_KTRefusedMood.description: They wouldn't take the deal. Now I've got nothing to show and no idea what's next.

ThoughtDef::RotR_KTTradedMood.label: paid dearly for hope
ThoughtDef::RotR_KTTradedMood.description: Got what we needed out of that trade, but it cost more than I wanted to give. Still, hope's worth the price.

ThoughtDef::RotR_LoverRecovered.label: my lover pulled through
ThoughtDef::RotR_LoverRecovered.description: Thought I might lose them there for a while. Seeing them back on their feet, everything feels right again.

ThoughtDef::RotR_LoverResurrected.label: brought back from the dead
ThoughtDef::RotR_LoverResurrected.description: I'd already made peace with never seeing them again. Now they're standing right here, breathing.

ThoughtDef::RotR_Memory_Argument.label: had an argument
ThoughtDef::RotR_Memory_Argument.description: Words got sharp between us and neither one backed down. Left a bad taste after.

ThoughtDef::RotR_Memory_Quarrel.label: quarreled again
ThoughtDef::RotR_Memory_Quarrel.description: Same fight, different day. We keep circling back to it.

ThoughtDef::RotR_Memory_ReadTogether.label: read together
ThoughtDef::RotR_Memory_ReadTogether.description: Sat and read the same page over each other's shoulder. Simple, but I liked it.

ThoughtDef::RotR_Memory_SharedReading.label: shared a story
ThoughtDef::RotR_Memory_SharedReading.description: Passed the same battered pages back and forth between us. Good way to spend a quiet hour.

ThoughtDef::RotR_Memory_SnowballFight.label: snow fight
ThoughtDef::RotR_Memory_SnowballFight.description: Never figured I'd see snow, let alone throw it at someone. Worth the cold hands.

ThoughtDef::RotR_Memory_StrollTogether.label: walked together
ThoughtDef::RotR_Memory_StrollTogether.description: Took a slow walk past the dunes with nowhere we had to be. Good to just walk with someone.

ThoughtDef::RotR_Memory_SwimTogether.label: swam together
ThoughtDef::RotR_Memory_SwimTogether.description: Found real water and jumped in together like it was nothing. Out here, that's a small miracle.

ThoughtDef::RotR_Mood_Argument.label: argued with my lover
ThoughtDef::RotR_Mood_Argument.description: We keep hitting the same wall no matter how we talk it through. It's wearing on both of us.

ThoughtDef::RotR_Mood_Quarrel.label: quarreled with my lover
ThoughtDef::RotR_Mood_Quarrel.description: That fight took everything out of me. If this is what's ahead for us, I don't know.

ThoughtDef::RotR_OLHostedMood.label: brief shelter
ThoughtDef::RotR_OLHostedMood.description: A roof and a quiet night, even if it's not ours to keep. Good while it lasted.

ThoughtDef::RotR_OLRecruitedMood.label: taken in
ThoughtDef::RotR_OLRecruitedMood.description: This crew took me in without asking too many questions. Feels like I can finally set the old weight down.

ThoughtDef::RotR_OLRejectedMood.label: turned away again
ThoughtDef::RotR_OLRejectedMood.description: Gates shut in my face, same as every other stop. I'm used to it, and it still stings.

ThoughtDef::RotR_ReMarried.label: married again
ThoughtDef::RotR_ReMarried.description: Everything we went through to get here makes the old hurt feel small. Glad I get to call them mine again.

ThoughtDef::RotR_ReMarryWith.label: renewed our vows
ThoughtDef::RotR_ReMarryWith.description: Said it again, meant it more than the first time. I respect them more with every year.

ThoughtDef::RotR_Resurrected.label: back from the dead
ThoughtDef::RotR_Resurrected.description: Didn't think I'd get to say this again, but good to see you standing there.

ThoughtDef::TerribleWedding.label: a botched joining
ThoughtDef::TerribleWedding.description: Nothing went right, the timing, the order, half the crew standing in the wrong place. A mess to remember, and not fondly.

ThoughtDef::UnforgettableWedding.label: a joining to remember
ThoughtDef::UnforgettableWedding.description: Everything came together just right, the vows, the food, the whole crew in one place smiling. I won't forget this one.

ThoughtDef::UnimpressiveWedding.label: a flat ceremony
ThoughtDef::UnimpressiveWedding.description: Nobody did anything wrong, exactly. It just never came together into anything worth talking about after.

ThoughtDef::FailedDateAttemptOnMe.label: turned down a date
ThoughtDef::FailedDateAttemptOnMe.description: Had to tell them no. Didn't want to see their face fall like that.

ThoughtDef::FailedHangoutAttemptOnMe.label: awkward hangout ask
ThoughtDef::FailedHangoutAttemptOnMe.description: They wanted to spend time together and I wasn't in the mood. Made things stiff between us for a bit.

ThoughtDef::FailedHookupAttemptOnMe.label: turned down a hookup
ThoughtDef::FailedHookupAttemptOnMe.description: Wasn't interested tonight and had to say so plain. Hope it doesn't sour things between us.

ThoughtDef::GotSomeLovinAsexual.label: had sex, felt little
ThoughtDef::GotSomeLovinAsexual.description: Went along with it well enough. Didn't do much for me either way, but it wasn't bad.

ThoughtDef::LovinAsexualNegative.label: didn't enjoy it
ThoughtDef::LovinAsexualNegative.description: Went through with it and just didn't feel it. Rather have spent that time on something else.

ThoughtDef::LovinAsexualPositive.label: it was alright
ThoughtDef::LovinAsexualPositive.description: Wasn't my thing exactly, but it was fine. No complaints.

ThoughtDef::PassionateLovinAsexualNegati.label: too much, too intense
ThoughtDef::PassionateLovinAsexualNegati.description: That was a lot more than I wanted. Left me wishing I'd said no.

ThoughtDef::PassionateLovinAsexualPositi.label: more than expected
ThoughtDef::PassionateLovinAsexualPositi.description: More intense than I'm used to, but it worked out fine. Surprised myself there.

ThoughtDef::RebuffedMyDateAttempt.label: turned down my date
ThoughtDef::RebuffedMyDateAttempt.description: Asked them out plain and got a no. Can't say I think as highly of them now.

ThoughtDef::RebuffedMyDateAttemptMood.label: shot down
ThoughtDef::RebuffedMyDateAttemptMood.description: Couldn't even get a chance to try. Stings more than I want to admit.

ThoughtDef::RebuffedMyHangoutAttempt.label: didn't want my company
ThoughtDef::RebuffedMyHangoutAttempt.description: Asked them to spend some time together and got brushed off. Noted.

ThoughtDef::RebuffedMyHangoutAttemptMood.label: brushed off
ThoughtDef::RebuffedMyHangoutAttemptMood.description: All I wanted was a bit of their time and they waved me away. Fine, I'll find someone else to sit with.

ThoughtDef::RebuffedMyHookupAttempt.label: turned me down
ThoughtDef::RebuffedMyHookupAttempt.description: Made a move and they weren't having it. Can't hold it against them, but it colors how I see them now.

ThoughtDef::RebuffedMyHookupAttemptMood.label: wounded pride
ThoughtDef::RebuffedMyHookupAttemptMood.description: Got turned down flat and it stung more than it should. Guess I'm not everyone's type.

ThoughtDef::BoringBreeding.label: a dull breeding rite
ThoughtDef::BoringBreeding.description: That ceremony dragged on and came to nothing. Whoever's up next better bring more to it.

ThoughtDef::BoringBreedingSuccess.label: dull, but it worked
ThoughtDef::BoringBreedingSuccess.description: Dull as dust to sit through, but the point got made. At least we don't need a repeat.

ThoughtDef::EncouragingBreeding.label: a good showing
ThoughtDef::EncouragingBreeding.description: That breeding rite was worth watching, even if nothing came of it this time. Good effort all around.

ThoughtDef::EncouragingBreedingSuccess.label: effort that paid off
ThoughtDef::EncouragingBreedingSuccess.description: Everyone put real effort into that one, and it paid off. New life on the way.

ThoughtDef::InspirationalBreeding.label: an astonishing rite
ThoughtDef::InspirationalBreeding.description: That ceremony had the whole crew talking. Everyone's already looking forward to the next new arrival.

ThoughtDef::InspirationalBreedingSuccess.label: hope renewed
ThoughtDef::InspirationalBreedingSuccess.description: That rite gave the whole crew something to believe in. New life coming, and we're all a little prouder for it.

ThoughtDef::PsyAwakening.label: my gift woke up
ThoughtDef::PsyAwakening.description: Something in me cracked open that I didn't know was there. Couldn't have found it without the bond I share with my partner.

ThoughtDef::TerribleBreeding.label: a humiliating rite
ThoughtDef::TerribleBreeding.description: That was awkward for everyone watching, let alone the ones up there. If that's our best effort, we're not having kids anytime soon.

ThoughtDef::TerribleBreedingSuccess.label: born of a farce
ThoughtDef::TerribleBreedingSuccess.description: Humiliating to sit through, and now there's a child on the way from it. Rough start for a kid, born out of that mess.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_AntagonistPresence.label: trouble in the air
ThoughtDef::Isekai_AntagonistPresence.description: Every instinct says get away from {0}. I can't point to why, just that the sand seems to go quiet around them.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_ApexReached.label: nothing above me now
ThoughtDef::Isekai_ApexReached.description: I've climbed past every rank scrap and blade can measure. Kings, gods, whatever's supposed to come next — none of it worries me anymore.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_AweOfPower.label: looking up at power
ThoughtDef::Isekai_AweOfPower.description: {0} operates on a level I haven't even mapped yet. I catch myself watching them work like it's something worth learning from.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_BeneathMe.label: chores beneath me
ThoughtDef::Isekai_BeneathMe.description: I was built for the fight, and here I am hauling scrap and sweeping sand like a hired hand. It grates.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_BeneathMyRank.label: gear beneath my rank
ThoughtDef::Isekai_BeneathMyRank.description: Somebody with my kind of name shouldn't have to swing junk like this to get through a fight. I keep it out of sight when I can.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_BossSlain.label: we killed the unkillable
ThoughtDef::Isekai_BossSlain.description: Nobody was supposed to walk away from that fight, let alone win it. We'll be telling this one around every fire we ever build.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_BountyClaimed.label: bounty closed clean
ThoughtDef::Isekai_BountyClaimed.description: Tracked it down, put it down, collected what I was owed. That's the whole job, done exactly right.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_BrokenWill.label: crushed without a fight
ThoughtDef::Isekai_BrokenWill.description: They didn't even have to touch me. Just being near them dropped me cold, and I never got a hand back up. I've never felt smaller.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_ContemptForWeak.label: not worth my notice
ThoughtDef::Isekai_ContemptForWeak.description: {0} barely registers. I don't know why I'm expected to share a table with someone that far below me.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_CrushingPresence.label: they dropped just from me
ThoughtDef::Isekai_CrushingPresence.description: Somebody stood too close and hit the ground before I even moved. That's not luck. That's what real strength feels like.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_CursedMood.label: bad luck riding with me
ThoughtDef::Isekai_CursedMood.description: Nothing's gone right in days and I can feel worse coming. Out here, that feeling's usually right.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_DuelDefeat.label: lost my own name
ThoughtDef::Isekai_DuelDefeat.description: Someone called out my title and I couldn't back it up. They let me walk away, which somehow stings worse. Now when people say my name I hear theirs instead.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_DuelIgnored.label: let the challenge stand
ThoughtDef::Isekai_DuelIgnored.description: Someone came for my name and I never answered it. Nothing was actually taken from me, but I can't stop turning that over.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_DuelVictory.label: held my own name
ThoughtDef::Isekai_DuelVictory.description: Someone crossed real distance to take my title off me, blade against blade, and walked away without it. I've never felt more like what people call me.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_FirstBlood.label: first real kill
ThoughtDef::Isekai_FirstBlood.description: That's the first one that counted. Everything since looks a little sharper for it.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_ForgeDestroyed.label: lost it in the forge
ThoughtDef::Isekai_ForgeDestroyed.description: It cracked apart right there in the fire. Every hour I put into that piece is scrap now, gone in one bad pass.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_ForgeDowngrade.label: botched the refinement
ThoughtDef::Isekai_ForgeDowngrade.description: My hand slipped at the wrong second and the working came out worse than what I started with. Just frustrating, not ruined.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_ForgeSuccess.label: clean work at the forge
ThoughtDef::Isekai_ForgeSuccess.description: The metal took what I was working into it without a fight. That's a good day at the anvil.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_GiantSlayer.label: punched above my rank
ThoughtDef::Isekai_GiantSlayer.description: That thing was built to kill someone stronger than me, and it's the one that's dead now. Turns out I'm worth more than I gave myself credit for.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_Humiliated.label: beaten by nothing
ThoughtDef::Isekai_Humiliated.description: Something I should have handled with one hand put me flat on the sand. I keep running it back and it doesn't get any better.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_InMyElement.label: everything clicks right now
ThoughtDef::Isekai_InMyElement.description: This is exactly the work I was built for. My hands know what to do before I think it, and none of it costs me anything.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_InspiredByLegend.label: living with a legend
ThoughtDef::Isekai_InspiredByLegend.description: We've got someone under this roof whose name actually means something out there. Some of that has to rub off eventually.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_KindredConstellation.label: a kindred path
ThoughtDef::Isekai_KindredConstellation.description: {0} is walking the same road I am, the same way I walk it. Nobody else here really gets what that's like.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_LegendFallen.label: our strongest one is dead
ThoughtDef::Isekai_LegendFallen.description: If something could kill them, it can kill any of us. That thought hasn't left me since we heard.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_LevelUp.label: stronger than yesterday
ThoughtDef::Isekai_LevelUp.description: Something shifted. I can feel it in how I move — I'm simply more capable today than I was.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_LuckyMood.label: feeling lucky today
ThoughtDef::Isekai_LuckyMood.description: Got a good feeling about how today's going to go. Things have a way of breaking my direction when I feel like this.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_NationAscended.label: we harbour a legend
ThoughtDef::Isekai_NationAscended.description: Somebody under our roof crossed a line no one else here ever has. Whatever they are now, they're ours, and every crew that hears the name will think twice about us.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_NodeUnlocked.label: new power settling in
ThoughtDef::Isekai_NodeUnlocked.description: Something new just opened up in me, and I can feel it settling into my hands like it's always belonged there.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_Outclassed.label: never stood a chance
ThoughtDef::Isekai_Outclassed.description: I wasn't even close to that fight. I need to get stronger fast, or the next one doesn't end with me getting up.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_Overshadowed.label: the one they protect
ThoughtDef::Isekai_Overshadowed.description: Everyone around me is operating on a level I'm nowhere near. I'm the one who needs watching, and we all know it.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_PathFound.label: found what I'm for
ThoughtDef::Isekai_PathFound.description: It's clear to me now, for the first time, exactly what I'm supposed to become. Everything before this felt like guessing.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_PrideOfStrongest.label: strongest under this roof
ThoughtDef::Isekai_PrideOfStrongest.description: Nobody here comes close to what I can do. Their safety sits on my shoulders and I don't mind the weight.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_QuestComplete.label: contract closed clean
ThoughtDef::Isekai_QuestComplete.description: Job's finished, payment's fair, nobody got left behind out there. That's a good day's work by any measure.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_QuestFailed.label: couldn't finish the job
ThoughtDef::Isekai_QuestFailed.description: I took the contract and walked away without finishing it. That kind of thing follows you — people remember who doesn't deliver.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_RankUp.label: formally ranked now
ThoughtDef::Isekai_RankUp.description: It's official. I've got a rank to my name now. Not much of one yet, but it's a start, and starts count.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_RivalConstellation.label: we'll never agree
ThoughtDef::Isekai_RivalConstellation.description: Everything {0} stands for cuts against everything I do. We're never going to find common ground, and I've stopped expecting to.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_RuneShattered.label: broke a rune loose
ThoughtDef::Isekai_RuneShattered.description: It came apart in my hands trying to pry it free. Those don't turn up twice in a lifetime out here.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_RuneSocketed.label: rune took to the metal
ThoughtDef::Isekai_RuneSocketed.description: It settled in and started to hum, like the metal had been waiting for it. This gear feels like mine now in a way it didn't before.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_SlewElite.label: put down a cut above
ThoughtDef::Isekai_SlewElite.description: That one wasn't like the others — tougher, meaner, harder to drop. Putting it down felt earned.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_Stagnating.label: standing still too long
ThoughtDef::Isekai_Stagnating.description: I haven't gotten any better in longer than I want to admit. Every day I stay flat, everyone else gets further ahead of me.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_StarTouched.label: touched by a fallen star
ThoughtDef::Isekai_StarTouched.description: A piece of something that fell out of the sky is part of me now. Doors I didn't know were there are suddenly open.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_SummonedHeroDisplacem.label: torn from my own world
ThoughtDef::Isekai_SummonedHeroDisplacem.description: I didn't choose this. Something pulled me clean out of my life to be somebody else's answer to a problem I never had.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_TitleBearing.label: there's a word for me
ThoughtDef::Isekai_TitleBearing.description: I'm past just being good at this. People have a name for what I am now, and it's mine to keep.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_TitleRenown.label: a name starts to travel
ThoughtDef::Isekai_TitleRenown.description: {0} has a name for what they do out there. I'm still just a face, but names get built one job at a time.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_TitleRivalry.label: rival in the same trade
ThoughtDef::Isekai_TitleRivalry.description: {0} does what I do, about as well as I do it. Only one of us is going to be the one people remember for it.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_TouchedByDeath.label: brushed up against death
ThoughtDef::Isekai_TouchedByDeath.description: I felt it get close enough to touch. Something kept me from going with it, but the cold of that moment hasn't left me.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_UnfulfilledCalling.label: blade's gone quiet too long
ThoughtDef::Isekai_UnfulfilledCalling.description: It's been too long since I've had to use it for real. I can feel myself getting soft, and I don't like it.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_UntappedPotential.label: power nobody's shaped
ThoughtDef::Isekai_UntappedPotential.description: There's something in me that's never been put to proper use. It just sits there, itching, waiting on somebody to point it at something.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_WeaponMastery.label: weapon feels like my arm
ThoughtDef::Isekai_WeaponMastery.description: It stopped being something I carry a long time ago. At this point it moves like it's just another part of me.

ThoughtDef::Isekai_WorthyWeapon.label: a weapon worth the weight
ThoughtDef::Isekai_WorthyWeapon.description: This one can actually keep pace with what I can do. It sits right in my hand in a way most gear never does.

ThoughtDef::VTE_AnimalsInColony.label: no beasts in camp
ThoughtDef::VTE_AnimalsInColony.description: Not a womp-rat's screech to hear anywhere near camp. A crew feels off without something living underfoot besides us.

ThoughtDef::VTE_BondedAnimalBanishedHate.label: glad it's gone
ThoughtDef::VTE_BondedAnimalBanishedHate.description: They finally ran that mangy thing off my crew. Best news I've had all week.

ThoughtDef::VTE_BondedAnimalDiedHater.label: good riddance
ThoughtDef::VTE_BondedAnimalDiedHater.description: That beast finally died. Won't miss the noise, won't miss the smell.

ThoughtDef::VTE_BondedAnimalLostHater.label: not sorry it's lost
ThoughtDef::VTE_BondedAnimalLostHater.description: Nobody's seen that useless creature in days. Fine by me — one less mouth to feed.

ThoughtDef::VTE_BondedAnimalMasterHater.label: stuck with that thing
ThoughtDef::VTE_BondedAnimalMasterHater.description: That creature won't leave my side no matter what I do. Every time it nuzzles up my skin crawls.

ThoughtDef::VTE_ChildOfMountain.label: born to the high rock
ThoughtDef::VTE_ChildOfMountain.description: Give me a canyon wall and open sky over flat dune any day. Standing up on the ridgeline, I can actually breathe.

ThoughtDef::VTE_ChildOfSea.label: drawn to real water
ThoughtDef::VTE_ChildOfSea.description: Open water, more than a cistern's worth, just sitting there running free. I could watch it for hours.

ThoughtDef::VTE_CouldNotFinishItem.label: unfinished build
ThoughtDef::VTE_CouldNotFinishItem.description: Couldn't get the rig to come together right, so I walked away from it half-done. That's going to bother me for a while.

ThoughtDef::VTE_CreatedLowQualityItem.label: made junk
ThoughtDef::VTE_CreatedLowQualityItem.description: What I turned out is barely scrap-grade. Starting to wonder if I've lost my hands for this work.

ThoughtDef::VTE_Dunce.label: don't get the fuss
ThoughtDef::VTE_Dunce.description: Everyone's always worked up about something around here. Never much bothered me — why would it?

ThoughtDef::VTE_EnvironmentDark.label: likes the dark
ThoughtDef::VTE_EnvironmentDark.description: Lights out suits me just fine. Between the glare off the dunes and the sun overhead all day, the dark is a relief.

ThoughtDef::VTE_HarvestedOrgans.label: grew the collection
ThoughtDef::VTE_HarvestedOrgans.description: The extraction went clean, exactly as planned. Another piece to add to the jar.

ThoughtDef::VTE_HaventExitedColonyForLon.label: haven't left camp
ThoughtDef::VTE_HaventExitedColonyForLon.description: I haven't been past the ridgeline in longer than I'd like. Getting an itch to hear sand under my boots again.

ThoughtDef::VTE_HaventHarvestedOrgansFor.label: need a new subject
ThoughtDef::VTE_HaventHarvestedOrgansFor.description: It's been too long since I opened someone up to look. The itch to do it again is getting hard to ignore.

ThoughtDef::VTE_KilledColonyAnimalHater.label: one less beast
ThoughtDef::VTE_KilledColonyAnimalHater.description: Someone finally killed that stinking animal. Camp's better for it, and I'm not pretending otherwise.

ThoughtDef::VTE_KilledMyBondedAnimalHate.label: not sorry it's dead
ThoughtDef::VTE_KilledMyBondedAnimalHate.description: That creature bonded to me is dead now. Good riddance — I never asked for it in the first place.

ThoughtDef::VTE_MechanoidIsKilled.label: one less droid
ThoughtDef::VTE_MechanoidIsKilled.description: Another one of those chrome killers is scrap now. This stretch of the Rim's a little safer for it.

ThoughtDef::VTE_MyRivalsAreAlive.label: rivals still breathing
ThoughtDef::VTE_MyRivalsAreAlive.description: They're still out there, still walking around, and it gnaws at me every time I think of it. They don't deserve the air they're using.

ThoughtDef::VTE_NoDedicatedLaboratory.label: no lab of my own
ThoughtDef::VTE_NoDedicatedLaboratory.description: I've got nowhere quiet to run my work. Doing it out in the open like this is maddening.

ThoughtDef::VTE_NotBondedAnimalMasterHat.label: not my problem
ThoughtDef::VTE_NotBondedAnimalMasterHat.description: That mangy thing likes me fine, but I want nothing to do with it. Glad somebody else has to deal with it now.

ThoughtDef::VTE_NuzzledHater.label: creature touched me
ThoughtDef::VTE_NuzzledHater.description: Some beast rubbed itself against my leg back there. I can still feel it and I don't care for it one bit.

ThoughtDef::VTE_ObservedManyBlood.label: too much blood
ThoughtDef::VTE_ObservedManyBlood.description: Blood and bits everywhere I looked. My stomach still hasn't settled from it.

ThoughtDef::VTE_PassionateCleaningWork.label: good clean sweep
ThoughtDef::VTE_PassionateCleaningWork.description: Nothing beats scouring the grit out of every corner of the hold. Everything back in its place, just how I like it.

ThoughtDef::VTE_SoakingWetChildOfTheSea.label: soaked through, loving it
ThoughtDef::VTE_SoakingWetChildOfTheSea.description: Water running off me head to foot. Out here that's not a nuisance, that's a gift.

ThoughtDef::VTE_SoldMyBondedAnimalHater.label: traded it off
ThoughtDef::VTE_SoldMyBondedAnimalHater.description: That nasty creature is somebody else's problem now. Long overdue, if you ask me.

ThoughtDef::VTE_SoldMyBondedAnimalMoodHa.label: finally rid of it
ThoughtDef::VTE_SoldMyBondedAnimalMoodHa.description: Traded that beast away and I'm not looking back. Should've done it ages ago.

ThoughtDef::VTE_WatchedTelevisor.label: caught a broadcast
ThoughtDef::VTE_WatchedTelevisor.description: Kicked back and watched the old signal feed for a while. Nice to let my mind drift somewhere that isn't work for once.

ThoughtDef::AB_ForsakenNight.label: unnatural dark
ThoughtDef::AB_ForsakenNight.description: The sun's gone and it feels swallowed rather than set. Something about this dark isn't right, and I hate it.

ThoughtDef::AB_ForsakenRain.label: soaked and blind
ThoughtDef::AB_ForsakenRain.description: Rain hammering down and I can't see past my own hand. Miserable, and it's not just the wet doing it.

ThoughtDef::AB_ForsakenThunderstorm.label: storm out of nowhere
ThoughtDef::AB_ForsakenThunderstorm.description: Black as the void out here and lightning cracking every which way. Feels like the whole sky's coming down on us.

ThoughtDef::AB_GelatinousEchoes_Bad.label: something ancient watching
ThoughtDef::AB_GelatinousEchoes_Bad.description: I can feel some old presence pressing at the edge of my mind. Scares me worse than anything with teeth ever could.

ThoughtDef::AB_GelatinousEchoes_Good.label: something ancient stirring
ThoughtDef::AB_GelatinousEchoes_Good.description: There's an old presence brushing at the edge of my thoughts. Strange, but it doesn't feel like it means me harm.

ThoughtDef::AB_HealingSpringwaterThought.label: spring water cure
ThoughtDef::AB_HealingSpringwaterThought.description: That spring did something to me — aches gone, head clear. Wish every well out here worked like that one.

ThoughtDef::AB_MoldyEnvironment.label: reek of mold
ThoughtDef::AB_MoldyEnvironment.description: This whole place smells like wet rot. Can't stand outside here for long before it starts turning my stomach.

ThoughtDef::AB_MutagenicOcularWater.label: water's changing me
ThoughtDef::AB_MutagenicOcularWater.description: Something in that water got into me. I can feel it working under my skin and I don't like what it might be doing.

ThoughtDef::AB_PetalStorms.label: petals on the wind
ThoughtDef::AB_PetalStorms.description: Petals swirling through camp instead of grit for once. I'll take it, honestly.

ThoughtDef::AB_PsychotropicFungusHigh.label: mushroom high
ThoughtDef::AB_PsychotropicFungusHigh.description: Ate a fistful of those strange fungus caps and now everything's spinning pleasantly. Feeling good and not asking why.

ThoughtDef::AB_PsychotropicFungusWithdra.label: fungus withdrawal
ThoughtDef::AB_PsychotropicFungusWithdra.description: My hands won't hold still and the color's drained out of everything I look at. I need another dose of those caps.

ThoughtDef::AB_Quicksand.label: stuck in the sand
ThoughtDef::AB_Quicksand.description: Every step out here sinks and drags at me. Feels like the ground itself is trying to keep hold of my legs.

ThoughtDef::AB_RawRimeNodulesHigh.label: rime-nodule calm
ThoughtDef::AB_RawRimeNodulesHigh.description: Chewed on a rime nodule a while back and now I feel steady, cool-headed. Good stuff, whatever it is.

ThoughtDef::AB_RedFogThought.label: wrong-tasting fog
ThoughtDef::AB_RedFogThought.description: This fog's got a taste to it that shouldn't exist. Feels like it isn't from anywhere natural.

ThoughtDef::AB_RedFogThoughtPositive.label: the fog is my friend
ThoughtDef::AB_RedFogThoughtPositive.description: This fog... I like it. I really like it. I'd wrap myself in it if I could, and I'm not sure why that thought doesn't scare me more.

ThoughtDef::AB_VolcanicAshThought.label: choking on ash
ThoughtDef::AB_VolcanicAshThought.description: This ash is thick enough to chew on. Every breath out here feels like it costs me something.

ThoughtDef::BMT_AteFungalLog.label: chewed a fungal log
ThoughtDef::BMT_AteFungalLog.description: Gnawed on a fungal log because there was nothing else around. My teeth are still complaining about that decision.

ThoughtDef::BMT_AteRawDulcis.label: ate raw dulcis
ThoughtDef::BMT_AteRawDulcis.description: Found a dulcis pod and ate it raw right where I stood. Sweetest thing I've had in a long while.

ThoughtDef::BMT_AteRawShimmershroom.label: ate a shimmershroom
ThoughtDef::BMT_AteRawShimmershroom.description: That shimmershroom was sweet and velvet-soft clear through. Almost too good for scavenger fare.

ThoughtDef::BMT_BreathedGleamcapSmoke.label: breathed gleamcap smoke
ThoughtDef::BMT_BreathedGleamcapSmoke.description: Breathed in smoke off a burning gleamcap and now I'm floating somewhere real pleasant. No complaints here.

ThoughtDef::BMT_DrankCactusJuice.label: cave-cactus juice
ThoughtDef::BMT_DrankCactusJuice.description: Squeezed the juice out of a cave cactus and drank it down on a whim. Better than I expected, honestly.

ThoughtDef::BMT_GlintThought.label: glint-charged
ThoughtDef::BMT_GlintThought.description: That glint's got my blood moving. I feel like I could strip a whole wreck down before sundown.

ThoughtDef::BMT_GlitterThought.label: glitter-strange
ThoughtDef::BMT_GlitterThought.description: Ready to work, hands steady, but my head feels like it's drifted off somewhere else entirely.

ThoughtDef::BMT_StimquillThought.label: stimquill ease
ThoughtDef::BMT_StimquillThought.description: Stimquill's got me calm and wired at the same time. Strange mix, but I'm not complaining.

ThoughtDef::BMT_Thought_PhosphoricLights.label: glowing cave lights
ThoughtDef::BMT_Thought_PhosphoricLights.description: Those lights running along the cavern walls are something else. Just looking at them lifts my mood a little.

ThoughtDef::BMT_UndergrounderMushroomed.label: mushroom wine
ThoughtDef::BMT_UndergrounderMushroomed.description: This is real drink, brewed off fungus, not those nasty little grape-bubbles surfacers swear by. Give me the cave stuff any day.

ThoughtDef::SalveWithdrawl.label: salve withdrawal
ThoughtDef::SalveWithdrawl.description: I'm hot and heavy all over and can't shake it. Never thought I'd miss smearing that cooling salve on myself this much.

ThoughtDef::AteRawFish.label: ate raw fish
ThoughtDef::AteRawFish.description: Had to eat fish straight off the bone, no fire, no seasoning. We should be cooking that, or at least salting it first.

ThoughtDef::AteRawGastropod.label: ate raw gastropod
ThoughtDef::AteRawGastropod.description: Choked down a raw gastropod because there wasn't time to cook it. Needs salt at the very least.

ThoughtDef::BiomesCore_AbysalWater.label: deep water dread
ThoughtDef::BiomesCore_AbysalWater.description: I don't want to know what's swimming around down there in the dark. Best not to think about it at all.

ThoughtDef::BiomesCore_LagoonWater.label: clear lagoon water
ThoughtDef::BiomesCore_LagoonWater.description: That blue water is about the prettiest thing I've seen out here in a long time. Just looking at it settles me down.

ThoughtDef::BiomesIslands_Crab.label: real crab meat
ThoughtDef::BiomesIslands_Crab.description: Actual crab, not scrap-meat dressed up to look like it. Made the whole day worth it.

ThoughtDef::BiomesIslands_Whale.label: ate whale fat
ThoughtDef::BiomesIslands_Whale.description: Chunks of fat where the real meat should've been. Odd, but I'll give it this — it had flavor.

ThoughtDef::BMT_BileThought.label: bile high
ThoughtDef::BMT_BileThought.description: Can't feel my fingers, but I swear I can hear colors right now. Whatever's in that bile, it works.

ThoughtDef::BMT_DrankRegalMilk.label: drank regal milk
ThoughtDef::BMT_DrankRegalMilk.description: That milk alone was worth more than most meals I've had out here. Rich, thick, better than it has any right to be.

ThoughtDef::BMT_ItchinessThought.label: can't stop itching
ThoughtDef::BMT_ItchinessThought.description: My skin's crawling and scratching isn't helping one bit. It's driving me up the wall.

ThoughtDef::BMT_ObservedMaligoat.label: saw a maligoat
ThoughtDef::BMT_ObservedMaligoat.description: Caught sight of one of those maligoats up close just now. Whatever that thing is, it shouldn't exist.

ThoughtDef::BMT_PhoridInfection.label: parasites under my skin
ThoughtDef::BMT_PhoridInfection.description: I can feel them moving under there, eating at me bit by bit. It's enough to make me lose my mind.

ThoughtDef::BMT_VisitedMuseum.label: disappointing museum
ThoughtDef::BMT_VisitedMuseum.description: Paid to see some museum out here and it wasn't worth the trip. Even on the Rim I expected better than that.

ThoughtDef::CGT_N2OGiggles.label: gas-happy
ThoughtDef::CGT_N2OGiggles.description: Whatever's leaking has me floating and laughing at nothing at all. Everything's funny until it isn't, and then I'm just sleepy.

ThoughtDef::VFEP_AmazingShanties.label: songs that lift the crew
ThoughtDef::VFEP_AmazingShanties.description: The cap'n's voice carried over the sand and the whole crew joined in. For a while the ache in my chest just wasn't there.

ThoughtDef::VFEP_BoringShanties.label: flat, tuneless singing
ThoughtDef::VFEP_BoringShanties.description: The cap'n mumbled through the old songs like they didn't mean it. Nobody's heart was in it, and neither was mine.

ThoughtDef::VFEP_Camaraderie_Exalted_Cre.label: lost one of the crew
ThoughtDef::VFEP_Camaraderie_Exalted_Cre.description: One of ours is gone, and the hole it leaves doesn't fill on its own. I'm leaning on the rest of the crew to keep standing.

ThoughtDef::VFEP_Camaraderie_Exalted_Dea.label: we've weathered worse together
ThoughtDef::VFEP_Camaraderie_Exalted_Dea.description: This crew has crawled out of enough wreckage together that I trust every one of them with my back. That kind of bond doesn't wear off.

ThoughtDef::VFEP_Camaraderie_Exalted_Mem.label: talked with the crew
ThoughtDef::VFEP_Camaraderie_Exalted_Mem.description: Traded stories with one of my own over a shared canteen. Feels like there's nothing this crew couldn't haul through together.

ThoughtDef::VFEP_Camaraderie_Respected_C.label: a rough day for us
ThoughtDef::VFEP_Camaraderie_Respected_C.description: One of ours didn't make it. Today's a bad day, and I'm not pretending otherwise.

ThoughtDef::VFEP_Camaraderie_Respected_M.label: shared a moment with one of ours
ThoughtDef::VFEP_Camaraderie_Respected_M.description: Sat down with a crewmate for a while, no reason needed. Makes the bond between us a little tighter.

ThoughtDef::VFEP_LameShanties.label: shanties for children
ThoughtDef::VFEP_LameShanties.description: The cap'n sang us something soft and simple, like we needed coddling. I wanted a real song, not a lullaby.

ThoughtDef::VFEP_RousingShanties.label: a song worth roaring to
ThoughtDef::VFEP_RousingShanties.description: The whole crew was pounding the deck and singing like the sand itself could hear us. Whatever's coming, we'll face it together after that.

ThoughtDef::VFEP_RumAsIngredient.label: drank something spiked
ThoughtDef::VFEP_RumAsIngredient.description: Whatever they mixed into that drink went down warm and easy. Worth the hangover.

ThoughtDef::VFEP_RumSuitThought.label: cooking in this suit
ThoughtDef::VFEP_RumSuitThought.description: This getup traps heat like a moisture still gone wrong. I'm drenched and it's only midday.

ThoughtDef::VFET_Encouraging.label: good talk around the fire
ThoughtDef::VFET_Encouraging.description: A few ideas actually landed tonight. I think we're onto something worth trying.

ThoughtDef::VFET_Ineffective.label: gathering went nowhere
ThoughtDef::VFET_Ineffective.description: We sat down to talk about what's next and it turned into griping about rations and bunks. Nothing got settled.

ThoughtDef::VFET_Inspiring.label: close to something big
ThoughtDef::VFET_Inspiring.description: The talk around the fire tonight had real weight to it. I can feel we're right on the edge of a breakthrough.

ThoughtDef::VFET_NoExpectations.label: expecting nothing from anyone
ThoughtDef::VFET_NoExpectations.description: Nobody around here promises much, so nobody owes me much either. Suits me fine.

ThoughtDef::VFET_Uninspiring.label: gathering had no spark
ThoughtDef::VFET_Uninspiring.description: A few new ideas got tossed around the fire, but none of them had real weight. At least it passed the evening.

ThoughtDef::VVE_Driving_Approved.label: good day behind the wheel
ThoughtDef::VVE_Driving_Approved.description: Had the controls of a hauler and put it through its paces. Nothing beats the engine growling under my hands.

ThoughtDef::VVE_Driving_Horrible.label: rough ride, worse driver
ThoughtDef::VVE_Driving_Horrible.description: Whoever was steering that thing had no business behind the wheel. My teeth are still rattling.

ThoughtDef::VVE_Driving_Required.label: itching for the wheel
ThoughtDef::VVE_Driving_Required.description: It's been too long since I've driven anything. My hands keep drifting toward where the controls should be.

ThoughtDef::VVE_Flying_Approved.label: good day in the air
ThoughtDef::VVE_Flying_Approved.description: Had the stick of a flyer and the desert opened up beneath me. Wish every day felt that clear.

ThoughtDef::VVE_Flying_Horrible.label: a flight I'd rather forget
ThoughtDef::VVE_Flying_Horrible.description: That flier lurched and dropped like the pilot was learning on the job. My stomach's still somewhere over the dunes.

ThoughtDef::VVE_Flying_Required.label: grounded too long
ThoughtDef::VVE_Flying_Required.description: I haven't been off the ground in ages and it's starting to gnaw at me. I need the sky under me again.

ThoughtDef::VVE_NeedRoomSize_Horrible.label: boxed into this hull
ThoughtDef::VVE_NeedRoomSize_Horrible.description: This cabin's barely big enough to turn around in. I can feel the walls whenever I try to breathe deep.

ThoughtDef::VVE_Sailing_Approved.label: good run on the water
ThoughtDef::VVE_Sailing_Approved.description: Rare thing, real open water, and the vessel handled it clean. I could get used to that.

ThoughtDef::VVE_Sailing_Horrible.label: a crossing gone wrong
ThoughtDef::VVE_Sailing_Horrible.description: That vessel pitched and groaned the whole way like it wanted to break apart under us. Never again if I can help it.

ThoughtDef::VVE_Sailing_Required.label: missing the water
ThoughtDef::VVE_Sailing_Required.description: It's been a long stretch since I've felt a deck moving under my feet. The dry ground's starting to feel wrong.

ThoughtDef::PL_BitMe.label: bitten during questioning
ThoughtDef::PL_BitMe.description: That prisoner sank their teeth into me the second I got close. Didn't see that coming, and it hurt worse than it should have.

ThoughtDef::PL_BrutallyInterrogated.label: interrogation turned brutal
ThoughtDef::PL_BrutallyInterrogated.description: They worked that prisoner over harder than I expected to. I still feel it in my knuckles.

ThoughtDef::PL_Interrogated.label: another round of questions
ThoughtDef::PL_Interrogated.description: Spent the shift squeezing information out of a prisoner. It's necessary work, but it never sits easy.

ThoughtDef::PL_KindInterrogation.label: went easy on them
ThoughtDef::PL_KindInterrogation.description: Kept my voice level and let the prisoner talk instead of leaning on them. Felt strange, but not bad.

ThoughtDef::PrisonLabor_FreeTime.label: a little time to myself
ThoughtDef::PrisonLabor_FreeTime.description: Even chained to this crew's schedule, I got a stretch of the day that was mine. Small thing, but I'll take it.

ThoughtDef::PrisonLabor_LowMotivation.label: nobody's watching, why bother
ThoughtDef::PrisonLabor_LowMotivation.description: No one's checked on my work in ages. Hard to care about the quota when nobody else does.

ThoughtDef::PrisonLabor_VeryGoodTreatmen.label: treated better than expected
ThoughtDef::PrisonLabor_VeryGoodTreatmen.description: For a prisoner, I'm fed well and left mostly in peace. Could be a lot worse than this.

ThoughtDef::GarrFlowers_Slave.label: how I feel about them
ThoughtDef::GarrFlowers_Slave.description: Every time I pass that slave I can't help but size them up, and my read on them colors the whole day. Some days it's grudging respect, some days it turns my stomach.

ThoughtDef::GarryFlowers_Slavery_Status_.label: no one beneath us
ThoughtDef::GarryFlowers_Slavery_Status_.description: A crew with no slaves to show for their raids gets no respect out here. We're an embarrassment as we stand.

ThoughtDef::GarryFlowers_Slavery_Status_.label: our slaves keep us respectable
ThoughtDef::GarryFlowers_Slavery_Status_.description: The slaves we hold are fed and functional, and that says something about this crew. We're doing this the right way.

ThoughtDef::GarryFlowers_Slavery_Terror_.label: nobody to fear us
ThoughtDef::GarryFlowers_Slavery_Terror_.description: Without slaves cowering at the bottom of this crew, there's nothing here to remind anyone of their place. That's a weakness.

ThoughtDef::GarryFlowers_Slavery_Terror_.label: fear keeps this crew in line
ThoughtDef::GarryFlowers_Slavery_Terror_.description: We've got slaves broken and beneath us, and everyone here knows exactly where they stand. That's how this crew stays in order.

ThoughtDef::Thought_TSA_TortureTraumaPer.label: scarred by torture
ThoughtDef::Thought_TSA_TortureTraumaPer.description: What they did to me left marks that never faded, on my body and everywhere behind my eyes. I don't sleep like I used to, and I never will again.

ThoughtDef::Thought_TSA_TorturedVictim.label: still raw from torture
ThoughtDef::Thought_TSA_TorturedVictim.description: The pain's faded some but the fear hasn't. Every sudden sound still makes me flinch.

ThoughtDef::Thought_TSA_Torturer.label: I did the torturing
ThoughtDef::Thought_TSA_Torturer.description: I was the one holding the tools this time, not the one strapped down. Doesn't matter how necessary it was, it sits wrong in my gut.

ThoughtDef::Thought_TSA_WitnessedTorture.label: watched a prisoner broken
ThoughtDef::Thought_TSA_WitnessedTorture.description: I heard what happened to that prisoner and I didn't look away fast enough. It's put a chill over the whole crew.

ThoughtDef::Thought_TSA_WitnessedTorture.label: saw what they do here
ThoughtDef::Thought_TSA_WitnessedTorture.description: Another prisoner got taken and came back broken. Whatever fight I had left in me is draining out fast.

ThoughtDef::EnslavedThought.label: just put in chains
ThoughtDef::EnslavedThought.description: These people own me now and I still can't wrap my head around it. Every stage of this feels worse than the last, and I don't see a way out yet.

ThoughtDef::ExplosiveCollar.label: wired to blow
ThoughtDef::ExplosiveCollar.description: There's a live charge locked around my throat now. I'm not testing what happens if I step out of line.

ThoughtDef::SlaveCollar.label: the collar's still there
ThoughtDef::SlaveCollar.description: I can feel the weight of it against my neck every time I move. I've mostly stopped noticing it. Mostly.

ThoughtDef::WasEnslaved_Assimilation.label: finally one of the crew
ThoughtDef::WasEnslaved_Assimilation.description: The collar's gone and nobody looks at me like property anymore. I've earned a place here, not just a leash.

ThoughtDef::ColonistDied_Revered.label: a death worth honoring
ThoughtDef::ColonistDied_Revered.description: One of ours has passed on, and under our ways that's cause to celebrate, not mourn. Their journey's finished well.

ThoughtDef::PopulationLarge_PopulationHi.label: the crew keeps growing
ThoughtDef::PopulationLarge_PopulationHi.description: More hands, more voices, more of us to hold this place together. Every new face is a good sign.

ThoughtDef::PopulationLarge_PopulationLo.label: too few of us
ThoughtDef::PopulationLarge_PopulationLo.description: This outpost feels half-empty and it shows in the work left undone. We need more people out here, plain and simple.

ThoughtDef::PopulationSmall_PopulationHi.label: too many underfoot
ThoughtDef::PopulationSmall_PopulationHi.description: Can't turn around without bumping into someone anymore. This place wasn't built to hold this many of us.

ThoughtDef::PopulationSmall_PopulationLo.label: room to breathe
ThoughtDef::PopulationSmall_PopulationLo.description: Not many of us here, and the quiet suits me fine. Less noise, less crowding, less to go wrong.

ThoughtDef::RecentTrade_Honored.label: how the trading's going
ThoughtDef::RecentTrade_Honored.description: When the caravans keep moving and deals keep closing, I feel like we might actually make something of this outpost. Let it dry up for too long, and that feeling curdles fast.

ThoughtDef::RecentTrade_Respected.label: keeping the trade routes warm
ThoughtDef::RecentTrade_Respected.description: A recent deal means coin and supplies are still flowing through camp. Let too much time pass without one, and business starts looking grim.

ThoughtDef::EBSG_GeneticDrugDependency.label: my genes are begging for it
ThoughtDef::EBSG_GeneticDrugDependency.description: Something in my blood was built to crave this, and it's been too long since I had any. The want claws at me until I do.

ThoughtDef::EBSG_GeneticDrugReliance.label: genes want their fix
ThoughtDef::EBSG_GeneticDrugReliance.description: It's not a full-blown need yet, but my body's started missing what it was engineered to have. I can feel the pull building.

ThoughtDef::EBSG_GeneticFoodDependency.label: built to need this food
ThoughtDef::EBSG_GeneticFoodDependency.description: Whatever they spliced into me left my body demanding a specific meal, and I haven't had it in far too long. The craving's getting hard to ignore.

ThoughtDef::EBSG_GeneticFoodGroupDepende.label: wired for a certain diet
ThoughtDef::EBSG_GeneticFoodGroupDepende.description: My gut wants a whole class of food that my genes were built around, not just any scrap-meal. Going without is starting to wear on me.

ThoughtDef::EBSG_GeneticFoodGroupRelianc.label: missing my usual diet
ThoughtDef::EBSG_GeneticFoodGroupRelianc.description: I'm not desperate yet, but the kind of food my body was engineered for has been scarce lately. I notice the difference.

ThoughtDef::EBSG_GeneticFoodReliance.label: missing the right meal
ThoughtDef::EBSG_GeneticFoodReliance.description: Nothing's wrong with the rations, exactly, they just aren't what my body was built to run on. It's a small ache, but it's there.

ThoughtDef::CAAncientGiftDestiny.label: marked for something bigger
ThoughtDef::CAAncientGiftDestiny.description: Whatever that old relic did to me, it left me certain I'm meant for more than scavenging scrap. I can feel it waiting out there.

ThoughtDef::CACamping.label: good night under open sky
ThoughtDef::CACamping.description: Bedded down out on the sand with the crew around me, no walls, no roof, just the stars and the fire. Can't remember the last time I felt this free.

ThoughtDef::TravelCompanions.label: these people I travel with
ThoughtDef::TravelCompanions.description: I didn't choose this crew, but out here on the road they're all I've got. However I feel about them today, they're the ones keeping me alive.

ThoughtDef::CaughtThiefStealing.label: caught a thief red-handed
ThoughtDef::CaughtThiefStealing.description: Some scavenger tried to lift something right off me and I caught them at it. Nerve of some people, out here of all places.

ThoughtDef::StealingCooldownThought.label: laying low for now
ThoughtDef::StealingCooldownThought.description: I pushed my luck trying to lift something recently and it's too hot to try again yet. Better to sit quiet a while.

ThoughtDef::SuccessfulStealKlepto.label: clean grab, no trouble
ThoughtDef::SuccessfulStealKlepto.description: Lifted it right out from under them and nobody so much as blinked. My pockets are heavier and my head's finally quiet.

ThoughtDef::VGE_Comet_Thought.label: watched a comet burn past
ThoughtDef::VGE_Comet_Thought.description: Stood on the hull and watched that thing streak silver across the dark. Worth stopping everything for a minute.

ThoughtDef::VGE_CrewEuphoria.label: a launch gone perfect
ThoughtDef::VGE_CrewEuphoria.description: Every system held, every hand did their job, and we broke atmosphere clean. I'll be riding that high for a while.

ThoughtDef::VGE_ToxicHaze.label: choking on the haze
ThoughtDef::VGE_ToxicHaze.description: This toxic dust is eating at my throat and I can't see ten feet through it. I want a sealed hull between me and this air.

ThoughtDef::GraffitiMod_HappyArtist.label: left my mark on the wall
ThoughtDef::GraffitiMod_HappyArtist.description: Painted something up on the bulkhead that's purely mine. Some of the crew will grumble, but I like looking at it.

ThoughtDef::SnapOut_HelpedSomeoneThought.label: talked someone off the ledge
ThoughtDef::SnapOut_HelpedSomeoneThought.description: Sat with a crewmate while their thoughts were spiraling and talked them back down. Feels good knowing I pulled someone through it.

ThoughtDef::TabulaRasa_NullThought.label: this thought shouldn't exist
ThoughtDef::TabulaRasa_NullThought.description: If I'm thinking this, something in the wiring behind my skull came loose. Somebody go check the vaporator, because this sure wasn't supposed to happen.

MentalBreakDef::ABF_MentalBreak_Synstruc.label: circuits gone soft for green things
MentalBreakDef::ABF_MentalBreak_Synstruc.beginLetter: {0}'s circuits have crossed wires with something soft. [PAWN_pronoun] is wandering the dunes petting every scrap of green [PAWN_pronoun] can find, murmuring to it like it can hear.
MentalBreakDef::ABF_MentalBreak_Synstruc.recoveryMessage: {0}'s circuits have stopped murmuring to the plants.

MentalBreakDef::ABF_MentalBreak_Synstruc.label: circuits at war with green things
MentalBreakDef::ABF_MentalBreak_Synstruc.beginLetter: {0}'s circuits have decided the plants are plotting something. [PAWN_pronoun] stalks the dunes glaring down every weed and stubborn root, muttering about a conspiracy only [PAWN_pronoun] can see.
MentalBreakDef::ABF_MentalBreak_Synstruc.recoveryMessage: {0}'s circuits have stopped waging war on the plants.

MentalBreakDef::FireStartingSpree.label: torching the camp
