MentalBreakDef::FireStartingSpree.beginLetter: {0} has snapped and gone torch-happy. [PAWN_pronoun] is going to wander the camp a while, setting whatever will burn.

MentalBreakDef::IdeoChange.label: the ground under the faith gave way
MentalBreakDef::IdeoChange.beginLetter: {0}'s faith has cracked wide open. Everything [PAWN_pronoun] believed is up for grabs now, and [PAWN_pronoun] doesn't know what's true anymore.

MentalBreakDef::Turn_MentalBreak_FreeSpi.label: snapped the leash
MentalBreakDef::Turn_MentalBreak_FreeSpi.beginLetter: {0} has snapped the leash in [PAWN_possessive] head. [PAWN_pronoun] will go after anyone loyal to the crew that holds [PAWN_possessive] chain.
MentalBreakDef::Turn_MentalBreak_FreeSpi.recoveryMessage: {0}'s rage against the chain has burned out.

MentalBreakDef::OuterRim_MSLooseScrews.label: a screw's come loose
MentalBreakDef::OuterRim_MSLooseScrews.beginLetter: {0}'s got a screw rattling loose somewhere in the works. [PAWN_pronoun]'s fumbling everything for a bit.
MentalBreakDef::OuterRim_MSLooseScrews.recoveryMessage: {0}'s screw has settled back into place.

MentalBreakDef::OuterRim_MSRebellious.label: dragging the chore
MentalBreakDef::OuterRim_MSRebellious.beginLetter: {0} has decided, quietly and on purpose, to do the job slow. Call it droid spite.

MentalBreakDef::VTE_Kleptomaniac.label: sticky fingers
MentalBreakDef::VTE_Kleptomaniac.beginLetter: {0} can't help lifting whatever a visitor sets down. Old scavenger habits, [PAWN_pronoun] says, though nobody asked.

MentalBreakDef::VTE_PanicFreezing.label: locked up cold
MentalBreakDef::VTE_PanicFreezing.beginLetter: {0} has frozen solid, staring at nothing, breath caught somewhere in [PAWN_possessive] chest.

MentalBreakDef::VTE_TechnophobeTantrum.label: smashing the tech
MentalBreakDef::VTE_TechnophobeTantrum.beginLetter: {0} has had enough of the chrome and the wiring and everything that hums. [PAWN_pronoun] is taking it out on the nearest machine.

XenotypeDef::Dirtmole.label: Dirtmole
XenotypeDef::Dirtmole.description: Gray-skinned, made for the dark—drop one in a mine shaft or a wrecked hull's crawlspace and they'll out-dig anyone topside. Bad eyes past arm's reach, and the desert sun will blind them faster than it blinds you. Keep them under the crawler, not on watch.

XenotypeDef::Genie.label: Genie
XenotypeDef::Genie.description: Thin-boned and calm as still water, a genie will read a busted engine faster than you can strip the panel off it. Don't send them to haggle—they'll say the wrong thing and not know why—and don't hit them; they break easy and it takes them a long time to stop feeling it.

XenotypeDef::Highmate.label: Highmate
XenotypeDef::Highmate.description: Pretty, warm, good at reading a room and worse than useless in a fight—some clans keep them for the trade table, some just keep them. We don't put a wrench in their hands; we put them across from a buyer who's decided he doesn't like our price.

XenotypeDef::Hussar.label: Hussar
XenotypeDef::Hussar.description: Red-eyed and built for the fight, not the crew. Heals fast, doesn't flinch, and needs go-juice in its blood or it starts to come apart—keep the supply steady or don't bother owning one. Doesn't make small talk. Doesn't need to.

XenotypeDef::Impid.label: Impid
XenotypeDef::Impid.description: Horned and quick as a scared varmint, an impid crosses open sand faster than anything else that walks—and can spit fire while doing it. Useless behind a plow, weak once someone gets in close. Send them ahead, not to hold the line.

XenotypeDef::Neanderthal.label: Neanderthal
XenotypeDef::Neanderthal.description: Built like the underside of a sandcrawler—hard to hurt, hard to talk sense into. Give them the heavy work and don't expect the ledger-keeping. Quick to anger, slow to forget it.

XenotypeDef::Pigskin.label: Pigskin
XenotypeDef::Pigskin.description: Trotter-handed and iron-stomached, a pigskin will eat what would kill the rest of the crew and never miss a meal. Don't hand them fine tools—those hands weren't made for it—but hand them the detonator and stand back; they've got a taste for it.

XenotypeDef::Sanguophage.label: Sanguophage
XenotypeDef::Sanguophage.description: Doesn't age, barely dies, heals like the desert doesn't touch it—and needs the blood of the free peoples to keep living, which is the kind of debt no clan wants on its ledger. Rare enough we've only heard the stories. Burn first, ask later.

XenotypeDef::Waster.label: Waster
XenotypeDef::Waster.description: Grey-skinned and mean, a waster can walk through poison air that would drop the rest of us in a minute—so long as it's got its psychite. No sickness touches it either. Doesn't make it pleasant company.

XenotypeDef::Yttakin.label: Yttakin
XenotypeDef::Yttakin.description: Big, furred, and built for a cold none of us have ever felt—wrong coat for this desert, but nobody outworks one once it gets moving. Talks to animals like they're crew. Outsiders call them dumb for it; we've seen what that trick's worth in a fight.

XenotypeDef::Starjack.label: Starjack
XenotypeDef::Starjack.description: Pale and thin, built for the black between worlds, not the ground under it—vacuum barely slows one down, but ask it to haul or swing a blade and it comes up short. Good for gravship hull work; nobody else wants the job that bad.

XenotypeDef::guy762_debugxenotype_droid.label: Chassis, Unlabeled
XenotypeDef::guy762_debugxenotype_droid.description: Not a person, not really a species—just the tag the makers slap on a frame before it's given a real name and a real job. If you're reading this on a pawn, something in the works slipped; note it and move on.

XenotypeDef::VRESaurids_Saurid.label: Saurid
XenotypeDef::VRESaurids_Saurid.description: Scaled and cold-blooded, spliced for dry country same as we chose it—handles the heat better than most and doesn't miss the company. Harsh voice, short patience for outsiders. We understand each other on that much.
